q.en: The motor vehicle registration shall be renewed:
q.zh: 车牌重新注册的时限是
q.why: 新泽西州的车辆注册 (registration) 每年 (every year) 续期一次。
q.why_en: In New Jersey, vehicle registration is renewed every year.

q.en: If your license is lost or stolen, you should:
q.zh: 如果你的牌照遗失或被偷，你应该
q.why: 驾照或车牌 (license / license plates) 遗失或被盗，应立即报告当地警察 (police)，再到 MVC 办理补发。
q.why_en: If your license or license plates are lost or stolen, report it to the local police right away, then get a replacement from the MVC.
q.tip_en: Lost something? Call the police first

q.en: When you got a new license plate, what must you do with the old one?
q.zh: 当你拿到新车牌照之后旧的怎么处理？
oz: 交予交通局，并要一张收据
q.why: 更换新车牌后，旧车牌必须交还给汽车监理机构 (Motor Vehicle / MVC)，不能丢弃、出售或转借。
q.tip: 车牌是州的财产，要交回
q.why_en: When you get new plates, the old ones must be turned in to Motor Vehicle (the MVC); you can't throw them away, sell them or lend them out.
q.tip_en: Plates belong to the state: turn them in

q.en: Your car must be inspected at either a state inspection station or a state licensed private garage:
q.zh: 你的车在州检站或被州授权的私人车行车检的时限或行车里数是
q.why: 新泽西乘用车每两年 (every two years) 须在州检站或州授权私人检测站验车（新车首次可延至5年）。
q.why_en: New Jersey passenger vehicles must be inspected every two years at a state inspection station or a state-licensed private inspection facility (a new car's first inspection can wait up to 5 years).

q.en: At the time of your Road Test, you must present:
q.zh: 你在路考时，必须提供
q.why: 路考时须出示有效的考试许可证 (permit)、车辆注册 (registration) 和保险卡 (insurance I.D. card)，三者都要，所以选 all of the above。
q.why_en: At the road test you must present a valid examination permit, vehicle registration and insurance I.D. card. All three are required, so the answer is "all of the above".
q.tip_en: Road test trio: permit, registration, insurance

q.en: Unless otherwise posted, you should travel at ____ when driving through school zones, business or residential districts.
q.zh: 除非另有说明，学校、商业区和住宅区的限速是 ____。
q.why: 除非另有标示，学校区、商业区和住宅区的限速是 25 mph。
q.why_en: Unless otherwise posted, the speed limit in school zones, business districts and residential districts is 25 mph.

q.en: Getting a driver’s license illegally may result in a:
q.zh: 以非法途径得到驾照会导致
oe: a fine of $200 to $500 and or imprisonment from 30-90 days
q.why: 非法取得驾照属违法行为，可处 $200–$500 罚款和/或 30–90 天监禁。
q.why_en: Getting a license illegally is an offense punishable by a $200–$500 fine and/or 30–90 days in jail.

q.en: You cannot take your road test in a vehicle with any obstruction or consoles between the driver and examiner because:
q.zh: 在参加路试的车辆内，你和考官之间不准有障碍物是因为
oe: console takes up too much space
q.why: 路考车辆中驾驶员与考官之间不能有中控台等障碍物，因为考官必须能在紧急时踩到刹车 (reach the brakes)。
q.why_en: The road test vehicle can't have a console or other obstruction between the driver and examiner, because the examiner must be able to reach the brakes in an emergency.

q.en: The minimum age for a basic driver license is:
q.zh: 获取驾照最小年龄为
q.why: 新泽西取得基本驾照 (basic license，先发 probationary license) 的最低年龄是 17 岁；16 岁只能拿学习许可。
q.why_en: The minimum age for a basic driver license in New Jersey is 17 (issued first as a probationary license); at 16 you can only get a permit.

q.en: If you lose your license for drunk driving or any other violation, you:
q.zh: 如果你因为喝酒或其它原因而失去驾照，你将
oe: can obtain a special work license
cannot drive for any reason until the period of suspension ends and license is restored
oz: 只可以驾驶搭有乘客的车辆
不能以任何理由开车，直到吊销期限结束并重新得到驾照
q.why: 驾照被吊销 (suspended) 期间任何理由都不得驾车，新泽西没有“工作专用驾照”，须等吊销期满并恢复驾照。
q.why_en: While your license is suspended you cannot drive for any reason. New Jersey has no "work-only license"; you must wait until the suspension ends and your license is restored.

q.en: If your driver license is lost or stolen, you should immediately notify:
q.zh: 如果你的驾照遗失或被偷，你应该马上通知
q.why: 驾照遗失或被盗应立即通知当地警察局 (local police)，再到 MVC 补办。
q.why_en: If your driver license is lost or stolen, notify your local police station immediately, then get a replacement from the MVC.

q.en: Special Driver Examination Permit may be issued at age 16 when:
q.zh: 在什么情况下，16岁时可以被授予“特别驾驶考试许可证”？
oe: the applicant is enrolled in a Behind the Wheel Driver Education Course of Department of Education
the applicant is enrolled in a Commercial Driving Education Course
purchased by an Approved Driving Instructor
oz: 申请者参加由教育部门举办的“特别驾驶教育课程”
B.申请者参加“商用驾驶教育课程”
C. 合格的驾驶教练准许
q.why: 16 岁可获“特别学习许可” (special learner permit)，条件是参加经教育部认可的驾校实车培训课程 (behind-the-wheel driver education course)。
q.tip: 16 岁 = 必须上驾校实车课
q.why_en: At 16 you can get a special learner permit, provided you are enrolled in a behind-the-wheel driver education course approved by the Department of Education.

q.en: Your driver license is a:
q.zh: 你的驾照是一种
q.why: 驾照是一种特权 (privilege)，不是权利；违规可被暂停或吊销。
q.why_en: A driver license is a privilege, not a right; it can be suspended or revoked for violations.

q.en: 6.If a person gets drunk in your home and has a motor vehicle accident, after leaving your home you could:
q.zh: 如果某人在你家喝醉酒，且在离开你家后发生车祸，你将
q.why: 根据社交东道主责任 (social host liability)，在你家喝醉的客人离开后出车祸，你可能被卷入民事诉讼 (lawsuit)。
q.why_en: Under social host liability, if a guest gets drunk at your home and crashes after leaving, you could become involved in a lawsuit.

q.en: The first signs of alcohol impairment are usually:
q.zh: 饮酒后的直接损害表现于
oe: unconsciousness, no reflexes, lack of circulation
loss of balance, wild mood changes, slurred speech
increased reaction time, impaired memory, some muscular incoordination
oz: 多说多话，增加自信，减少判断力
失去意识反映，缺乏应变能力
失去平衡性情狂变口齿不清
反应迟钝，有损记忆力和控制力
q.why: 题库答案认为饮酒后最先出现的影响是反应时间变长、记忆受损及部分肌肉协调失调；B、C 是醉酒程度较重时才出现的症状。
q.why_en: The question bank treats increased reaction time, impaired memory and some muscular incoordination as the first effects of drinking; B and C are symptoms of heavier intoxication.

q.en: If you drink beyond a BAC of ____05%, the risk of your causing a motor vehicle accident doubles and at .10%, the risks increase to:
q.zh: 如果喝酒导致你的血液酒精浓度为 0.05%，你出车祸的几率增加一倍，如果血液酒精浓度为 0.1%，出车祸的几率便升至为 ____。
q.why: 手册数据：BAC 达 0.05% 时肇事风险加倍，达 0.10% 时风险约为 6 倍 (six times)。
q.why_en: Per the manual: at a BAC of .05% the risk of causing a crash doubles, and at .10% it is about six times as great.

q.en: You can get alcohol out of your blood by:
q.zh: 能使你血液中酒精排泄的是
q.why: 只有时间 (time) 能让肝脏代谢掉血液中的酒精；咖啡、冷水澡、运动都无效。
q.why_en: Only time lets the liver remove alcohol from the blood; coffee, cold showers and exercise don't work.

q.en: After two to four drinks alcohol begins to impair your:
q.zh: 饮两到四杯酒后，将会影响你的
q.why: 两到四杯酒后，反应时间、协调与平衡、判断力都会受到影响，故选 all of the above。
q.why_en: After two to four drinks, reaction time, coordination and balance, and judgment are all impaired, so the answer is "all of the above".

q.en: Studies show the great number of people arrested for drunk driving had been drinking:
q.zh: 统计所有酒醉被捕案例大多因饮
q.why: 研究显示，因酒驾被捕的人大多数喝的是啤酒 (beer)——很多人误以为啤酒“不算酒”。
q.why_en: Studies show most people arrested for drunk driving had been drinking beer; many wrongly think beer "doesn't count".

q.en: The best way to reduce your chances of having an alcohol related accident is to:
q.zh: 最佳减少饮饮酒导致事故的方法是
oe: not drive at all after drinking
q.why: 降低酒驾事故风险的最好方法是喝酒后完全不开车；“少喝”或“知道自己的量”都不可靠。
q.why_en: The best way to reduce the risk of an alcohol-related crash is not to drive at all after drinking; "drinking less" or "knowing your limits" isn't reliable.

q.en: If you drink four 12 ounce bottles of beer you will have about as much alcohol in your system as if you drank:
q.zh: 饮四瓶 12 盎司容量啤酒，相当于其他的酒是
q.why: 一瓶 12 盎司啤酒 ≈ 1.5 盎司烈酒 ≈ 5 盎司葡萄酒，酒精量相同。所以四瓶啤酒应相当于四杯威士忌/金酒 (4 drinks of whiskey or gin)。
q.tip: 一杯就是一杯，种类不同酒精相同
q.flag: 答案疑似应为 C：4 瓶啤酒 = 4 份标准饮品 = 4 杯威士忌或金酒，题库给的 B（1 杯）不对。
q.why_en: A 12 oz beer ≈ 1.5 oz liquor ≈ 5 oz wine in alcohol content. So four beers should equal "4 drinks of whiskey or gin".
q.tip_en: A drink is a drink, whatever the type
q.flag_en: Answer likely should be C: 4 beers = 4 standard drinks = 4 drinks of whiskey or gin. The bank's B (1 drink) is wrong.

q.en: Which of the following safe driving skills are affected by alcohol:
q.zh: 饮酒后驾车，你受影响的因素是
q.why: 酒精会影响警觉性 (alertness)、判断力 (judgment) 和反应 (reaction)，故选全部。
q.why_en: Alcohol affects alertness, judgment and reaction, so the answer is all of them.

q.en: New Jersey law states that you may or may not be under the influence if your blood alcohol content is:
q.zh: 新泽西法律规定，你血液中酒精含量在什么范围内可能不受酒精影响
q.why: 此题基于新泽西旧法：BAC 介于 0.05% 与 0.10% 之间时，“可能是也可能不是”处于酒精影响下。注意现行法律以 0.08% 为法定上限（21 岁以下为 0.01%）。
q.why_en: This question reflects older New Jersey law: with a BAC between .05% and .10%, you "may or may not" be under the influence. Note that current law sets the legal limit at 0.08% (0.01% for drivers under 21).

q.en: A 5-ounce glass of wine contains the same amount of alcohol as:
q.zh: 与一杯5盎司的葡萄酒酒精含量相同的是
q.why: 一杯 5 盎司葡萄酒与一罐 12 盎司啤酒（以及 1.5 盎司烈酒）所含酒精量大致相同。
q.why_en: A 5 oz glass of wine has about the same alcohol as a 12 oz can of beer (or 1.5 oz of liquor).

q.en: If a driver has a BAC of ____.15%, he or she is ____ times more likely to cause a crash.
q.zh: 如果一名司机的血液酒精含量为 0.15%，其造成交通事故的可能提高 倍。
q.why: 手册数据：BAC 达 0.15% 的司机肇事可能性约为清醒时的 25 倍。
q.why_en: Per the manual, a driver with a BAC of .15% is about 25 times more likely to cause a crash than when sober.

q.en: Which is a tell-tale sign of a drunk driver?
q.zh: 什么是司机酒后驾车的迹象？
q.why: 左右摇摆 (weaving)、急停、超速等都是酒驾的典型迹象，故选全部。
q.why_en: Weaving, quick stops and speeding are all typical signs of a drunk driver, so the answer is all of them.

q.en: Implied Consent Law means:
q.zh: 默认法则的含义是
oe: permission for another to move your car in emergencies
you sign an agreement to give blood
when you drive a motor vehicle you automatically agree to take a breath test following an arrest for a suspected drunk driving offense
oz: 同意别人在紧急情况下移动你的车辆
当你被怀疑饮酒驾车时，你自动同意接受呼吸测试
q.why: 默示同意法 (Implied Consent Law)：在新泽西开车即视为同意，在因涉嫌酒驾被捕后接受呼气测试 (breath test)；拒绝会受处罚。
q.why_en: Implied Consent Law: by driving in New Jersey you automatically agree to take a breath test after an arrest for suspected drunk driving; refusing is penalized.

q.en: A twelve-ounce can of beer has as much alcohol in it as:
q.zh: 与一罐12盎司的啤酒具有相同酒精含量的是
q.why: 一罐 12 盎司啤酒的酒精量相当于 1.5 盎司 86 度 (86 proof) 威士忌。
q.why_en: A 12 oz can of beer has as much alcohol as 1.5 oz of 86 proof whiskey.

q.en: Which of the following drinks contain about the highest alcohol content?
q.zh: 以下哪一种饮料酒精含量最高？
oe: all of the above are about equal in content
oz: 以上各种在含量上相当
q.why: 5 盎司葡萄酒、1.5 盎司烈酒和 12 盎司啤酒的酒精含量大致相等，所以选“都差不多”。
q.why_en: 5 oz of wine, 1.5 oz of liquor and 12 oz of beer contain about the same alcohol, so the answer is "all of the above are about equal in content".

q.en: In New Jersey, you must be at least ____ years old to register a motor vehicle?
q.zh: 在新泽西州，你必须年满 岁才有资格登记开车？
q.why: 在新泽西须年满 17 岁才能登记 (register) 车辆，与取得驾照的最低年龄一致。
q.why_en: In New Jersey you must be at least 17 to register a vehicle, the same as the minimum licensing age.

q.en: 23.For driving purpose you are on legal limit when amount of alcohol in your blood (BAC) reached what level?
q.zh: 根据驾车安全法规驾车者血液中的酒精限量是多少？
q.why: 新泽西成年司机的法定酒精上限是 BAC 0.08%；21 岁以下为 0.01%。
q.why_en: New Jersey's legal BAC limit for adult drivers is 0.08%; for drivers under 21 it is 0.01%.

q.en: A person who refuses a Breathalyzer Test in conjunction with a first offense for driving under  the influence is subject to:
q.zh: 拒绝酒精测试的第一次后果是
oe: A fine of $50 and six months loss of license
Loss of license for 2 years and a fine of $250-$400
Loss of license for 6 months and fine of $250-$400
oz: 罚款$50 及吊销驾照6个月
q.why: 按题库所依据的旧法，首次拒绝呼气测试 (refusal) 处罚为吊销驾照 6 个月及罚款 $250–$400（现行法规已改为罚款 $300–$500 并须安装点火联锁装置 ignition interlock）。
q.tip: 拒测 ≈ 初次酒驾处罚
q.why_en: Under the older law the bank is based on, a first-offense refusal to take a breath test carried a 6-month license loss and a $250–$400 fine (current law: a $300–$500 fine plus an ignition interlock device).

q.en: In the state of New Jersey, a habitual offender is a driver whose license has been suspended or more times in three years.
q.zh: 在新泽西州，习惯性犯法是指一个司机在三年内被吊销驾照几次或以上。
q.why: 新泽西“惯犯” (persistent/habitual offender)：3 年内驾照被吊销 3 次或以上。
q.why_en: A New Jersey habitual (persistent) offender is a driver whose license has been suspended 3 or more times within 3 years.

q.en: You can reduce your chances of being involved in an accident by knowing and using the standard accident prevention formula:
q.zh: 知道并应用以下哪些原则将减少你的事故概率？
q.why: 事故预防公式：保持警觉 (be alert)、做好准备 (be prepared)、及时行动 (act in time)，三者都要。
q.why_en: The accident prevention formula: be alert, be prepared, act in time. All three are needed.

q.en: To regain control while in a skid, you should:
q.zh: 当车辆打滑时，为重新控制车辆需
oe: keep tight grip on the steering wheel
turn in the same direction the back of the car is skidding
make a fast turn in the direction of the skid and lock the brakes
oz: 向车尾打滑的方向打方向盘
踩住刹车的同时，迅速向车辆转动的同方向转弯
q.why: 车辆打滑 (skid) 时，松油门，并朝车尾滑动的同一方向转方向盘；急转或锁死刹车会让打滑更严重。
q.tip: 尾巴往哪滑，方向盘往哪打
q.why_en: In a skid, ease off the gas and turn in the same direction the back of the car is skidding; sharp turns or locked brakes make the skid worse.
q.tip_en: Steer where the rear is sliding

q.en: If a vehicle is passing you, you should:
q.zh: 如果后面有人超车，你应该
oe: speed up so he will not complete the pass
flash your lights and sound your horn to warn the car passing you that is unsafe
Slow down to make it easier for the driver to complete the pass in time
q.why: 被超车时应保持车道、稍微减速，让对方安全完成超车；加速阻挡或闪灯鸣笛都危险且不当。
q.why_en: When being passed, stay in your lane and slow down slightly so the other driver can finish the pass safely; speeding up to block, flashing lights or honking is dangerous and improper.

q.en: If your wheels drift onto the dirt shoulder of the road and you want to return to the paved road, you should:
q.zh: 当你的车辆压上泥质路肩时，你如何将车开会非泥质的铺设路面上来
oe: slow down, turn back onto the pavement slowly
drive along the shoulder until you are going as fast as the traffic
drive along the shoulder until you get to an acceleration lane
move slowly along shoulder and wave traffic around you
oz: 减速，缓慢开回铺设路面
继续在泥质路肩上开，直到你的速度跟上其它车辆时开回
继续在泥质路肩上开，直到你开上加速车道
继续在泥质路肩上开，并向周围车辆挥手示意
q.why: 车轮驶上泥土路肩时，先松油门减速，确认安全后再慢慢转回路面；急打方向盘容易失控或冲入对向车道。
q.why_en: If your wheels drift onto the dirt shoulder, ease off the gas to slow down, then turn back onto the pavement slowly when safe; jerking the wheel can cause loss of control or send you into oncoming traffic.
q.tip_en: Slow down first, then ease back

q.en: If you are involved in a motor vehicle accident resulting in injuries while your driving privileges are suspended, you are subject to:
q.zh: 在驾照被吊销期间，因驾车导致车祸或人员受伤，你将被处以
oe: fine, suspension of your driving privileges and mandatory jail sentence
additional 1 year suspension of your driving privileges
q.why: 驾照被吊销期间开车并发生致人受伤的事故，将被罚款、延长吊销期并强制监禁 (mandatory jail)。
q.why_en: Causing an injury crash while your driving privileges are suspended brings a fine, further suspension and a mandatory jail sentence.

q.en: The penalty for driving after your license has been suspended due to an alcohol or drug conviction is:
q.zh: 当你因饮酒或使用毒品驾车被停牌后仍继续驾车，则
oe: $500 fine, a 90-day jail sentence and an additional loss of license for 5 years
$500 and or imprisonment up to one year
oz: 罚款$500，坐牢90 天并额外吊销驾照5年
q.why: 按题库答案为罚款 $500 和/或最长一年监禁。
q.flag: 答案存疑：NJ 手册规定因酒驾被吊销期间开车，处罚为 $500 罚款、额外吊销 1–2 年及 10–90 天监禁，各选项均不完全吻合，题库给 C；如按罚款+监禁+额外吊销的结构，A 更接近（但年限不符）。
q.why_en: Per the question bank: a $500 fine and/or imprisonment up to one year.
q.flag_en: Answer questionable: the NJ manual says driving while suspended for DWI brings a $500 fine, an additional 1–2 year suspension and 10–90 days in jail. No option matches exactly; the bank gives C. By structure (fine + jail + extra suspension), A is closer, though its years don't match.

q.en: Under the New Jersey Point System, a person having a license over two years, after how many points will get a notice of license suspension:
q.zh: 新泽西州罚分系统规定，驾车两年以上者，多少罚分将被暂吊驾照
q.why: 新泽西积分制 (Point System)：累计 12 分或以上会收到暂吊驾照通知。
q.why_en: Under New Jersey's Point System, accumulating 12 or more points triggers a notice of license suspension.

q.en: A person who hold a probationary drive license is subject to:
q.zh: 一个持有观察类驾照的人可能被
oe: an advisory notice upon being convicted of their first moving violation
mandatory attendance at a driver education program in lieu of suspension for a second violation resulting 4 or more points
any violation after attending school will result in suspension
oz: 第一次违规，处以书面劝告
第二次违规，将强制参加学习班代替4罚分导致的暂时吊销驾照
参加学习教育后的任何违规，均将导致吊销驾照
q.why: 持试用驾照 (probationary license) 者：第一次违规收警告通知；第二次违规（4 分以上）须参加驾驶改进课程代替吊销；上课后再违规将被吊销。故选全部。
q.why_en: Probationary license holders: the first violation brings an advisory notice; a second violation (4+ points) requires a driver improvement program in lieu of suspension; any violation after that program results in suspension. So the answer is "all of the above".

q.en: If you are driving an uninsured vehicle you are subject to this fine:
q.zh: 如果你的车没有保险的话，你会被罚
oe: $300 a term of community service determined by the court a one year license suspension
oz: $300及由法院决定时间的社区服务，并吊销驾照一年。
q.why: 驾驶无保险车辆（初犯）：罚款（$300 起）、法院判定的社区服务 (community service)，并吊销驾照一年。
q.tip: 无保险 = 罚款 + 社区服务 + 停牌一年
q.why_en: Driving an uninsured vehicle (first offense): a fine (from $300), court-determined community service, and a one-year license suspension.

q.en: If a student driver commits a traffic offense, responsibility will be with:
q.zh: 如果一个学习驾车者违规，负责的应是
q.why: 学员驾驶违规时，学员和陪同的教练/持照人都要负责 (both)。
q.why_en: When a student driver commits a traffic offense, both the student and the supervising instructor/licensed driver are responsible.

q.en: The first conviction penalty for driving while under the influence of alcohol or drug is:
q.zh: 饮酒或吸毒驾车的初犯处罚是
oz: $250-$400罚款并可能坐牢30 天（被取消驾照3个月至 1 年）
q.why: 初次酒驾/药驾 (DWI，BAC 0.08%–0.10%) 处罚为罚款 $250–$400，并可能监禁最多 30 天（另须安装点火联锁装置）。
q.why_en: A first DWI conviction (BAC 0.08%–0.10%) carries a $250–$400 fine and possible imprisonment up to 30 days (plus an ignition interlock device).

q.en: Altering a driver’s license, or showing an altered driver’s license, may result in:
q.zh: 篡改驾照或使用篡改的驾照，会导致
q.why: 篡改驾照或出示篡改过的驾照，可导致丧失驾驶资格 (loss of driving privileges)。
q.why_en: Altering a driver license, or showing an altered one, can result in loss of your driving privileges.

q.en: Which of the following will increase your chances of having an accident even if you only had one or two drinks:
q.zh: 即使只饮一杯酒，以下哪些因素与增加车祸可能性有关
oe: use of medication or other drugs
q.why: 即使只喝一两杯，情绪、驾驶经验、同时服药或用药都会进一步增加事故风险，故选全部。
q.why_en: Even after one or two drinks, your mood, driving experience, and use of medication or other drugs all further raise crash risk, so the answer is "all of the above".

q.en: The hand and arm upward signal means:
q.zh: 手臂向上的信号表示什么
q.why: 手势信号：左臂向上弯曲 (hand and arm upward) = 右转 (right turn)；平伸 = 左转；向下 = 减速/停车。
q.why_en: Hand signals: hand and arm upward = right turn; straight out = left turn; downward = slow or stop.
q.tip_en: Up right, out left, down stop

q.en: If a passenger in the front seat (over 18 years of age) is caught not wearing a seat belt, who is held responsible?
q.zh: 如果前排乘客（超过 18 岁）因没系安全带而被抓住，谁负责？
q.why: 18 岁及以上的乘客未系安全带，由乘客本人负责并被罚款。
q.why_en: A passenger 18 or older who isn't wearing a seat belt is responsible and fined themselves.

q.en: If a passenger in the front seat of a car, who is 17 years old, is caught not wearing a seat belt, who is held responsible?
q.zh: 如果前排乘客 17 岁以下，因没系安全带而被抓住，谁负责？
q.why: 18 岁以下乘客未系安全带，由驾驶员 (driver) 负责。
q.why_en: If a passenger under 18 isn't wearing a seat belt, the driver is responsible.

q.en: You may drive on public or private property to avoid a traffic or signal:
q.zh: 你可以驾车于公共或私人产地以避开交通信号，条件是
oe: only if the driver stops the vehicle before crossing the sidewalk
only with permission of the property owner
when directed to do so by police officer
oz: 只有在人行横道线前停下
只有在私人产地主人准许之下
q.why: 不得借道公私产业（如加油站、停车场）绕开交通信号；只有在警察指挥 (police officer directs) 时才可以。
q.why_en: You may not cut through public or private property (gas stations, parking lots) to avoid a traffic signal, except when directed to do so by a police officer.
q.tip_en: Cutting through to dodge a light = illegal

q.en: When you move into New Jersey from another state, you must have your vehicle inspected within:
q.zh: 从外州搬到新泽西州，你必须在多少天之内去验车
q.why: 新居民须在搬入后 60 天内注册车辆，并在注册后 14 天内验车 (inspection)。
q.why_en: New residents must register their vehicle within 60 days of moving in and have it inspected within 14 days after registering it.

q.en: What is a speed limit in a business district in New Jersey?
q.zh: 在新泽西商业街道驾车时速是多少？
q.why: 除非另有标示，新泽西商业区 (business district) 限速为 25 mph。
q.why_en: Unless otherwise posted, the speed limit in a New Jersey business district is 25 mph.

q.en: How close to stop sign are you permitted to park?
q.zh: 泊车应离停止信号多远？
q.why: 新泽西规定车辆不得停在停车标志 (stop sign) 50 英尺以内。
q.why_en: New Jersey prohibits parking within 50 feet of a stop sign.

q.en: MVS may terminate your road before it starts because of:
q.zh: 汽车监理所会停止你的路试，因为
oe: a center console or other equipment in your vehicle that obstructs the examiner’s access to brake pedal
oz: 你车里与考官之间的障碍物引致考官不能使用刹车
q.why: 车辆不安全、中控台阻挡考官踩刹车、缺少安全带等都会让考官取消路考，故选全部。
q.why_en: An unsafe vehicle, a console blocking the examiner's access to the brake pedal, or missing seat belts can each end the road test, so the answer is "all of the above".

q.en: When parking uphill on a street with a curb on your right, your car wheels should be:
q.zh: 当你在上坡且右边有路沿的街上停车时，你的车轮应该
oz: 转离路沿（转左）（下坡转向路沿，转右）
q.why: 上坡且右侧有路缘 (curb) 时，车轮应转离路缘（向左），让车后溜时前轮抵住路缘。
q.why_en: Parking uphill with a curb on your right, turn your wheels away from the curb (to the left), so if the car rolls back the front wheel catches the curb.

q.en: Steady yellow light means:
q.zh: 固定的黄灯表示
oe: traffic should stop before entering the intersection or crosswalk
wait for the light to change
oz: 在汽车进入人行横道前就停下
q.why: 固定黄灯 (steady yellow) 表示红灯将至，若能安全停车，应在进入路口或人行横道前停下。
q.why_en: A steady yellow light means red is coming; if you can stop safely, stop before entering the intersection or crosswalk.

q.en: A flashing red traffic light means:
q.zh: 闪光的红灯意为
oe: slow, yield to traffic on the right
use caution when entering an intersection
oz: 减速，让右边的车辆先行
q.why: 闪烁红灯 (flashing red) 等同停车标志：先完全停车，确认安全后再小心通行。
q.why_en: A flashing red light is the same as a stop sign: come to a full stop, then proceed with caution when safe.

q.en: Driver approaching a flashing red traffic signal must:
q.zh: 驾车接近闪光红灯信号时必须
q.why: 接近闪烁红灯时必须在进入路口前完全停车 (stop)，再小心通行。
q.why_en: At a flashing red signal you must stop completely before entering the intersection, then proceed carefully.

q.en: The most common type of parking on city streets is:
q.zh: 在城市最常见的停车方式是
q.why: 城市街道最常见的停车方式是平行停车 (parallel parking)。
q.why_en: The most common type of parking on city streets is parallel parking.

q.en: When parking on a hill, facing up or down, and there are no curbs, your wheels should be turned:
q.zh: 你将车停在小坡上，车头朝上或朝下，边上没有路沿时，你的轮子应该朝向
oe: towards the edge of the road (your right)
q.why: 坡道上无路缘时，无论上坡还是下坡，车轮都应转向路边（右侧），使车滑动时离开车道。
q.why_en: On a hill with no curb, uphill or downhill, turn your wheels toward the edge of the road (right) so the car rolls away from traffic.

q.en: In New Jersey, studded snow tires can be legally used between:
q.zh: 在新泽西何时可以合法使用“钉状雪胎”？
q.why: 新泽西允许使用钉状雪胎 (studded tires) 的时间是 11 月 15 日至次年 4 月 1 日。
q.why_en: New Jersey allows studded snow tires from November 15 to April 1.

q.en: When driving a motor vehicle you are required to have your driver’s license and your ?
q.zh: 驾车时你除了需要有驾照外，还要有什么？
oe: Title to the vehicle and registration
Insurance identification card and certificate of ownership
Title to the vehicle and insurance identification card
oz: 保险卡及车辆所有权证明
q.why: 开车时必须随身携带驾照、车辆注册证 (registration) 和保险卡 (insurance ID card)。
q.tip: 驾照 + 注册 + 保险
q.why_en: When driving you must carry your driver license, registration and insurance identification card.

q.en: Any changes of address must be reported to the Division of Motor Vehicles Services within what time period?
q.zh: 任何地址的变更必须在多长时间内报告给汽车监理所？
q.why: 地址变更必须在一周 (1 week) 内通知 MVC。
q.why_en: A change of address must be reported to the MVC within 1 week.

q.en: Dim your headlights to low beam when:
q.zh: 何时使用近光灯
oe: a car is approaching on a two-lane road
oz: 车辆接近双向车道时（只可用近光灯不可用远光灯）
q.why: 双车道上有对向来车时须切换到近光灯 (low beam)，以免远光晃到对方（对向车 500 英尺内）。
q.why_en: On a two-lane road with oncoming traffic, switch to low beam so your high beams don't blind the other driver (within 500 feet of an oncoming car).

q.en: You cannot park within how many feet of a crosswalk at an intersection?
q.zh: 你不可将车停泊在离人行横道多远？
q.why: 新泽西规定不得停在路口人行横道 25 英尺以内。
q.why_en: New Jersey prohibits parking within 25 feet of a crosswalk at an intersection.

q.en: If you sell your car (and do not buy another) what should you do with the license plates?
q.zh: 如果你卖掉你的车（而不买另一辆），你该如何处理你的车牌？
oe: turn them into a Motor Vehicle Inspection Facility or agency and ask for a receipt
give them to a friend to use
oz: 把它交给车辆检验站并要一张收据
q.why: 卖车后不再买车时，应把车牌交回 MVC 机构并索取收据 (receipt)，作为已交还的凭证。
q.why_en: If you sell your car and don't buy another, turn the plates in to an MVC agency and ask for a receipt as proof.
q.tip_en: Turn in plates, get a receipt

q.en: If two cars begin to enter an uncontrolled intersection at the same time:
q.zh: 如果两辆车同时进入一个无任何信号的交叉路口时
oe: the driver to the right must yield to the drive on the left
the driver to the left must yield to the drive on the right
the driver entering the intersection must yield
the driver going straight through goes first
oz: 右车道的司机应让左车道的司机
左车道的司机应让右车道的司机
进入路口的司机必须让路
q.why: 两车同时进入无信号控制路口时，左侧车辆须让行 (yield) 右侧车辆。
q.why_en: When two cars enter an uncontrolled intersection at the same time, the driver on the left must yield to the driver on the right.

q.en: When a school bus has stopped at a school to pick up or let off children, you may pass from either direction at a speed of no more than:
q.zh: 如果有一辆校车停在学校门口接送小孩，你不论从哪个方向超过它，最高的车速是
q.why: 校车停在学校门口上下学生时，任一方向经过的车速不得超过 10 mph。
q.why_en: When a school bus is stopped at a school loading or unloading children, you may pass from either direction at no more than 10 mph.

q.en: When you see police cars, fire trucks or ambulances with sirens and red lights?
q.zh: 当你看到警车、消防车或救护车闪着红灯并鸣笛行驶，你应怎样?
oe: You must yield to emergency vehicles when you hear a siren of see a flashing red light
Drive over to the extreme right of roadway and stop
oz: 你必须让紧急车辆先开过去
q.why: 听到警笛或看到闪红灯的紧急车辆时，必须让行，靠道路最右侧停车，等其通过。故选全部。
q.why_en: When you hear a siren or see an emergency vehicle's flashing red lights, you must yield, pull over to the extreme right of the roadway, stop, and wait for it to pass. So the answer is "all of the above".
q.tip_en: Pull right, stop, let it pass

q.en: It is a good practice to keep a space cushion to:
q.zh: 保持一定的缓冲空间有利于
oe: give you a clear view of the road
oz: 使你对道路有清晰的视野
q.why: 保持安全缓冲距离 (space cushion) 是为了给自己留出反应时间；它不会缩短反应时间本身（C 是陷阱）。
q.why_en: A space cushion gives you time to react; it does not decrease your reaction time itself (C is the trap).

q.en: When you are approaching a school bus it shows a flashing light signaling a stop, you must:
q.zh: 当你的车接近闪灯示意停车的校车时，你应该
q.why: 校车闪红灯停车时，必须在距校车至少 25 英尺处停车。
q.why_en: When a school bus is stopped with flashing red lights, you must stop at least 25 feet away.

q.en: An acceleration lane is:
q.zh: 加速车道是
oe: the left lane of a two-lane on highway
an extra lane at a highway entrance
an extra lane at a highway exit
oz: 双车道高速公路上的左侧车道
一条通向高速公路的车道
高速公路出口处的附加车道
q.why: 加速车道 (acceleration lane) 是高速公路入口处的额外车道，用来加速汇入车流。
q.why_en: An acceleration lane is an extra lane at a highway entrance, used to speed up and merge into traffic.

q.en: In order to steer the car while moving backward, you should turn:
q.zh: 你如果想倒车应如何转动方向盘
oe: The steering wheel in the direction opposite the way you want the rear of the car to go
the steering wheel in the direction you want the rear of the car to go
the steering wheel clockwise for the rear of the car to go to the left
the steering wheel in the direction you want the front of the car to go
oz: 将方向盘转向倒车的相反方向
顺时针转向倒车方向之左边
转向车前方你要去的方向
q.why: 倒车时，想让车尾往哪边去，就把方向盘往哪边转。
q.why_en: When backing, turn the steering wheel in the direction you want the rear of the car to go.

q.en: A legal name change due to marriage, divorce or court action must be reported to Motor Vehicle Services with time period?
q.zh: 因为结婚、离婚或上法庭等原因而更改姓名，必须在多长时间内向汽车监理所报告
q.why: 因结婚、离婚或法院判决更改法定姓名，须在两周 (2 weeks) 内通知 MVC。
q.why_en: A legal name change due to marriage, divorce or court action must be reported to the MVC within 2 weeks.

q.en: To obtain a moped license , you must also have:
q.zh: 要申请电单车拍照，你必须持有
q.why: 新泽西驾驶轻便摩托车 (moped) 须持 moped 驾照，或持有基本汽车驾照。
q.flag: 题干疑似错乱：选项 B 与题干重复（申请 moped 驾照还需 moped 驾照）。实际规定是持基本驾照 (basic license) 即可驾驶 moped，否则需单独申请 moped license（15 岁起）。原题意可能为“驾驶 moped 需要什么”。
q.why_en: To ride a moped in New Jersey you need a moped license or a basic automobile license.
q.flag_en: Stem looks garbled: option B repeats the stem (getting a moped license requires a moped license). Actual rule: a basic license is enough to ride a moped; otherwise you need a separate moped license (from age 15). The intended question is probably "what do you need to ride a moped".

q.en: If you are going 30 miles per hour, your total stopping distance on a dry road should be:
q.zh: 如果你以每小时30 英里的速度行驶，要在路上完全停止的缓冲距离为：
q.why: 按手册停车距离表，以 30 mph 在干燥路面行驶，总停车距离（反应+刹车）约 88 英尺。
q.why_en: Per the manual's stopping distance table, at 30 mph on a dry road the total stopping distance (reaction + braking) is about 88 feet.

q.en: If you are going 50 miles per hour, your total stopping distance on a dry road should be about:
q.zh: 如果你以每小时 50 英里的速度行驶，在干燥的路面上完全停止的距离大概是
q.why: 按手册停车距离表，以 50 mph 在干燥路面行驶，总停车距离约 243 英尺。
q.why_en: Per the manual's stopping distance table, at 50 mph on a dry road the total stopping distance is about 243 feet.

q.en: If you go into a skid:
q.zh: 如果车子打滑
oe: turn in the opposite direction the back of the car is skidding
brake at once and steer in the direction the front end of your car is skidding
keep a light grip on the steering wheel and brake
take your foot off the gas pedal and turn in the same direction the back end of the car is skidding
oz: 转向车后部打滑的反方向
马上刹车并转向车前部滑行方向
把你的脚从油门踏板上移开，向汽车后端打滑的同一方向转弯
q.why: 打滑时先松油门，并朝车尾滑动的同一方向转方向盘；不要猛踩刹车。
q.tip: 尾巴往哪滑，方向盘往哪打
q.why_en: In a skid, take your foot off the gas and turn in the same direction the back end of the car is skidding; don't slam the brakes.
q.tip_en: Steer where the rear is sliding

q.en: New Jersey law requires that a child must be seated in a child restraint device while riding a car if:
q.zh: 新泽西州法律规定，孩童坐车时必须被安置于儿童保护装置内，此法适用的情况是
oe: the child is under 5 years of age and is riding in the front seat
the child is under 18 months of age and riding in the front seat
the child is under 18 months of age and riding in the back seat
oz: 小于18个月孩童坐在前座
小于18个月孩童坐在后座
q.why: 题库按旧法：列出的情形均须使用儿童安全座椅，故选全部。现行法规更严格：8 岁以下且身高不足 57 英寸的儿童须坐安全座椅/增高垫，并尽量坐后座。
q.why_en: Per the bank's older law, all the listed cases require a child restraint, so the answer is "all of the above". Current law is stricter: children under 8 and shorter than 57 inches must ride in a car seat or booster seat, in the back seat when possible.

q.en: Using both safety belts and shoulder belts is important because they:
q.zh: 使用安全带之所以重要是因为
oe: increase your chance of surviving in a collision
are required by the Division of Motor Vehicles
oz: 撞车时会增加生命机会
q.why: 同时使用腰带和肩带的主要原因是提高在碰撞中的生存机会；守法只是附带原因。
q.why_en: The main reason to wear both lap and shoulder belts is to increase your chance of surviving a collision; being required by law is secondary.

q.en: In city driving you should:
q.zh: 在城市开车，你应该
oz: 注意至少保持至少12秒的车距
q.why: 城市驾驶应放慢车速、注意行人，并至少观察前方 12 秒的路况，故选全部。
q.why_en: In city driving, slow down, watch for pedestrians, and look at least 12 seconds ahead, so the answer is "all of the above".

q.en: Driving in the city at night you should use:
q.zh: 晚间在城市开车，你应该
q.why: 城市夜间街道有照明且车多，应使用近光灯 (low beam)，远光会晃到他人。
q.why_en: City streets at night are lit and busy, so use low beam; high beams would blind others.

q.en: If you are driving through a railroad crossing:
q.zh: 如果你要通过铁路平交道时
q.why: 通过铁路道口时须减速、观察、聆听，小心通行 (proceed with care)；有火车或信号时则必须停车。
q.why_en: At a railroad crossing, slow down, look and listen, and proceed with care; if a train is coming or signals are active, you must stop.

q.en: The hand and arm downward palm facing to the rear signal means?
q.zh: 手臂向下手掌向后的手势意为
q.why: 手臂向下、掌心向后 (downward, palm to rear) 表示减速或停车。
q.why_en: Hand and arm downward, palm facing to the rear, means slow down or stop.
q.tip_en: Up right, out left, down stop

q.en: The shape of a yield sign is: “
q.zh: 让路”的交通标志图形为
q.why: 让行标志 (yield sign) 是倒三角形 (triangle)；八角形是停车标志。
q.why_en: A yield sign is a triangle (pointing down); the eight-sided sign is a stop sign.

q.en: If you run off the pavement, the first thing you should do is?
q.zh: 如果驶离铺设路面首先应怎么做？
oe: slow down and turn back on to the pavement slowly
oz: 减速，慢慢驶回铺设路面
q.why: 驶出路面时，先松油门减速，再慢慢转回路面；急刹车或急打方向盘都可能失控。
q.why_en: If you run off the pavement, ease off the gas to slow down, then turn back onto the pavement slowly; braking hard or jerking the wheel can cause loss of control.
q.tip_en: Slow down first, then ease back

q.en: When making a left turn from a two-way road into a four lane highway, the proper way to turn is:
q.zh: 当你从双向车道向左转至四条平行车道时，正确的转向路线是
oe: approach the turn as close to the centerline of the road of the intersection
make the turn before reaching the center of the intersection
turn into the left lane of the road going in your direction
oz: 尽可能转至靠近中央分隔线的车道
在靠近交叉路口之前先转向
转至与你同向的左车道
q.why: 从双向道路左转时，应靠近中心线进入路口，并转入同方向的最左车道；B 提前在路口中心前转弯属于抄近路，是错误做法。
q.why_en: When turning left from a two-way road, approach the turn as close to the centerline as possible and turn into the leftmost lane going your direction; B (turning before reaching the center of the intersection) cuts the corner and is wrong.
q.tip_en: Left turn: hug the centerline, enter the left lane

q.en: Motorists must use headlights:
q.zh: 车头灯必须用于
oe: One-half hour after sunset to one-half hour before sunrise and anytime in bad weather when visibility is less than 500 feet
One-half hour before sunset to one-half hour after sunrise and anytime in bad weather
oz: 日落与日出前半小时及天气不佳，能见度仅 500 英尺
日落前半小时至日出后半小时及恶劣天气的任何时候
q.why: 新泽西规定日落后半小时至日出前半小时，以及能见度低于 500 英尺的恶劣天气时，必须开车头灯。
q.tip: 日落后半小时到日出前半小时 + 500 尺
q.why_en: New Jersey requires headlights from one-half hour after sunset to one-half hour before sunrise, and in bad weather when visibility is less than 500 feet.
q.tip_en: Half hour after sunset to half hour before sunrise + 500 ft

q.en: On a two-lane road not near a school when a school bus is stopped and its red lights are flashing:
q.zh: 在一条不靠近学校的有两条车道的路上，当一辆校车停在路旁并亮着红灯时
oe: you may pass the bus with caution
you may pass the bus at speed of 10m.p.h. or less
you may pass the bus from either direction
oz: 你可以小心地超过校车
你可以以低于10英里每小时的速度超过校车
你可以从任一方向超过校车
q.why: 在非学校区域的道路上，校车停车并闪红灯时，双向车辆都必须停车（至少距校车 25 英尺）。
q.why_en: On a road not near a school, when a school bus is stopped with red lights flashing, traffic in both directions must stop (at least 25 feet from the bus).

q.en: New Jersey law allows up to 3 points to be subtracted from your driving record if you have no moving traffic violations:
q.zh: 新泽西法律允许从驾驶记录减去3分，你须多长时间没有违规
oe: for one year from the date of the last violation
for six months from the date of the last violation
for 18 months from the date of the last violation
for two years from the date of the last violation
q.why: 一年内无交通违规及吊销记录，可从驾驶记录中扣减 3 分。
q.why_en: One year with no moving violations or suspensions lets you have 3 points subtracted from your driving record.

q.en: Crossing center lines on a two-way roadway for passing is legal when:
q.zh: 双向道上如何合法通过两条道路的中心线
oe: both lines are solid with no traffic visible in the opposite direction
the solid line is on your side of the highway
the broken line is on your side of the highway
oz: 两条中心线都是实线且对面方向无可见车辆
虚线须在中心靠你的一边
q.why: 双向道路超车时，只有虚线 (broken line) 在你这一侧才可越过中心线；实线在你一侧时禁止超车。
q.why_en: On a two-way road, you may cross the centerline to pass only when the broken line is on your side; passing is prohibited when the solid line is on your side.
q.tip_en: Pass only with the broken line on your side

q.en: A deceleration lane is:
q.zh: 减速道即是
oe: an extra lane at highway exit
oz: 高速公路出口出的附加车道
q.why: 减速车道 (deceleration lane) 是高速公路出口处的额外车道，用来减速驶出。
q.why_en: A deceleration lane is an extra lane at a highway exit, used to slow down as you leave.

q.en: Motorists should switch on the turn signal at least ____ before turning to let the other drivers know their intentions.
q.zh: 转弯前，你必须在至少 ____ 之前打信号灯以示意其他司机。
q.why: 转弯前至少 100 英尺打转向灯，让其他驾驶者知道你的意图。
q.why_en: Signal at least 100 feet before turning so other drivers know your intentions.

q.en: Blood Alcohol concentration (BAC) in the body is related to:
q.zh: 体内的酒精浓度与什么有关？
oe: the amount of alcohol he drinks
the time he takes to drink the alcohol
q.why: 血液酒精浓度 (BAC) 与体重、饮酒量及饮酒时间长短都有关，故选全部。
q.why_en: Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) depends on body weight, how much you drink and how long you take to drink it, so the answer is "all of the above".

q.en: A single, solid white line across a road at an intersection means:
q.zh: 在交叉路口的横向单条白色实线意味着
oe: stop behind the line for a traffic sign or light
oz: 在此线后停车等待交通信号
q.why: 路口横跨车道的单条白色实线是停止线 (stop line)，遇停车标志或红灯须停在线后。
q.why_en: A single solid white line across the lanes at an intersection is a stop line; for a stop sign or red light, stop behind it.

q.en: If you have a blowout while driving:
q.zh: 如果你的车辆爆胎，你应
oe: Drive to the shoulder of the road immediately, then apply brakes to stop
keep the car going straight, slow down gradually and then pull off the road
apply brakes for a quick stop
hold the steering wheel loosely and steer to the shoulder immediately
oz: 立刻驶向路边然后刹车
松握方向盘，并立即转向路边
q.why: 爆胎 (blowout) 时车会被拉向一侧，应双手握紧方向盘保持直行，松开油门让车逐渐减速，再驶离道路。急刹车 (C) 或立即猛转向路边 (A/D) 容易失控。
q.tip: 爆胎：握稳、直行、慢慢松油门，不急刹
q.why_en: A blowout pulls the car to one side. Hold the steering wheel firmly with both hands, keep the car going straight, ease off the gas so the car slows gradually, then pull off the road. Braking hard (C) or steering to the shoulder immediately (A/D) can make you lose control.
q.tip_en: Blowout: hold firm, go straight, ease off the gas, no hard braking

q.en: You may pass on the right when:
q.zh: 什么情况下可以从右侧超车
oe: there is a slow moving vehicle ahead
the driver ahead is making or about to make a left turn and there is proper lane on the right
oz: 前面的车要左转或正在左转且右边有合适的车道
q.why: 只有当前车正在或即将左转、且右侧有足够的合法车道时，才可从右侧超车 (pass on the right)。前车慢 (A) 不是从右超车的理由。
q.why_en: You may pass on the right only when the driver ahead is making or about to make a left turn and there is a proper lane on the right. A slow vehicle ahead (A) is not a reason to pass on the right.
q.tip_en: Pass on the right only around a left-turner

q.en: When nearing a steady yellow or amber traffic signal, you should:
q.zh: 在接近持续黄灯时，你应该
oe: Slow down and continue with caution through the intersection
speed up and continue through the intersection before the light changes to red
Come to an immediate stop/stop if it is safe; the signal will soon turn red
Stop immediately, do not continue through the intersection
oz: 减速，小心通过交叉路口
加速，在变成红灯前通过交叉路口
如果安全则立即停车/停车， 信号灯马上变为红灯
立即停车，不要通过交叉路口
q.why: 稳定黄灯 (steady yellow) 表示即将变红：如能安全停下就应停车；若已太近无法安全停车，则小心通过。加速抢灯 (B) 是错误的。
q.why_en: A steady yellow light means the signal is about to turn red: stop if you can do so safely; if you are too close to stop safely, proceed with caution. Speeding up to beat the light (B) is wrong.
q.tip_en: Yellow = get ready to stop, not speed up

q.en: In order to drive in New Jersey, your car must be insured for:
q.zh: 新泽西州驾车必须有的保险是
oz: 他人生命的第三责任险
q.why: 新泽西州法律要求所有注册车辆必须购买责任险 (liability insurance)，赔付你对他人造成的人身伤害和财产损失。盗窃、火灾、碰撞险都是可选的。
q.tip: 必买的是“赔别人”的责任险
q.why_en: New Jersey law requires every registered vehicle to carry liability insurance, which pays for injuries and property damage you cause to others. Theft, fire and collision coverage are optional.
q.tip_en: The required coverage is the one that pays others: liability

q.en: It is important to slow down:
q.zh: 以下哪种情况慢驶非常重要
oe: when the road is wet or slippery
oz: 十字路口或火车平交道
q.why: 窄路或弯路、路口和铁路道口、湿滑路面都需要减速，所以选“以上皆是” (all of the above)。
q.why_en: You should slow down on narrow or winding roads, at intersections and railroad crossings, and when the road is wet or slippery, so the answer is "all of the above."

q.en: When it is legal to turn right on red, before turning, you must:
q.zh: 在红灯时右转，你必须做什么动作然后转弯
oe: slow down and check for traffic
make a full stop, check traffic
oz: 完全停车，观察交通情况
q.why: 新泽西允许红灯右转 (right on red)，但必须先完全停车 (full stop)，让行行人和来车后才能转，除非有“No Turn on Red”标志。仅减速 (A) 不够。
q.why_en: New Jersey allows a right turn on red, but you must first come to a full stop and yield to pedestrians and traffic before turning, unless a "No Turn on Red" sign is posted. Just slowing down (A) is not enough.
q.tip_en: Right on red: full stop first, then look

q.en: Railroad Crossing sight is:
q.zh: 铁路和公路交叉的指示牌是什么颜色的
q.why: 铁路道口提前警告标志 (railroad advance warning sign) 是黄底黑字的圆形标志（画 X 和 RR）。圆形是铁路道口专用的形状。
q.why_en: The railroad advance warning sign is a round yellow sign with black markings (an X and "RR"). The round shape is used only for railroad crossing warnings.

q.en: What is an acceleration lane is:
q.zh: 什么是加速车道
oe: an extra lane at an entrance to an expressway
q.why: 加速车道 (acceleration lane) 是进入高速公路 (expressway) 入口处额外的车道，用来加速到与主路车流相近的速度再并入。
q.why_en: An acceleration lane is an extra lane at an entrance to an expressway, used to speed up to roughly the speed of highway traffic before merging.

q.en: Driving on a curve:
q.zh: 车在弯曲的道路上应该
q.why: 弯道上离心力会把车往外甩，应在进入弯道前减速 (slow down)，保持在本车道内行驶。
q.why_en: On a curve, centrifugal force pushes the car outward. Slow down before entering the curve and stay in your lane.

q.en: If you fail the road test, how long before you can take the test over?
q.zh: 如果你路考没通过，需要过多久才能参加重考？
q.why: 新泽西路考 (road test) 未通过的，至少要等两周 (minimum 2 weeks) 才能重考。
q.why_en: If you fail the New Jersey road test, you must wait a minimum of 2 weeks before retaking it.

q.en: You cannot park:
q.zh: 你不能停车在
oe: in front of a fire hydrant
q.why: 消防栓前、公交车站、私人车道出入口 (driveway) 前都禁止停车，所以选“以上皆是”。
q.why_en: Parking is prohibited in front of a fire hydrant, in a bus stop and in front of a driveway, so the answer is "all of the above."

q.en: Yellow lines down the center of the road:
q.zh: 路中间的黄线表示
oz: 分开相反方向的交通车辆
q.why: 路中央的黄线 (yellow center lines) 用来分隔相反方向的车流；虚黄线允许安全时超车，实黄线禁止超车。白线则分隔同方向车道。
q.tip: 黄线分对向，白线分同向
q.why_en: Yellow center lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions; a broken yellow line allows passing when safe, a solid yellow line prohibits it. White lines separate lanes moving in the same direction.
q.tip_en: Yellow = opposite directions, white = same direction

q.en: You should always yield to:
q.zh: 你应该让路的是
oe: other vehicles already in the intersections
oz: 其它已经进入路口的车辆
q.why: 应让行 (yield) 紧急车辆、行人以及已进入路口的车辆，故选“以上皆是”。
q.why_en: You should yield to emergency vehicles, pedestrians and vehicles already in the intersection, so the answer is "all of the above."

q.en: When making a left turn from a two-way street you should get into the:
q.zh: 同向双程道上你要左转，你应该驶向
oe: left side nearest to the left curb
left lane nearest to the left curb
Lane nearest to the center of the roadway
right lane, or the lane nearest to the right curb
oz: 最靠近左侧路沿的左面
最靠近左侧路沿的左车道
路中央靠近中心线的车道
右侧车道或最靠近右侧路沿的车道
q.why: 在双向道路上左转，应从最靠近道路中心线 (center line) 的车道开始转弯。靠左侧路沿 (A/B) 适用于单行道左转。
q.tip: 双向道左转靠中线，单行道左转靠左边
q.why_en: When turning left from a two-way street, start from the lane nearest to the center of the roadway. Using the lane nearest the left curb (A/B) applies to left turns from a one-way street.
q.tip_en: Two-way street: turn left from near the center line; one-way street: from the left side

q.en: If you are going 40 miles per hour, your total stopping distance on a dry road should be:
q.zh: 如果你以每小时 40 英里的速度行驶，在干燥的路上完全停车的距离大概是
q.why: 按新泽西驾驶手册的停车距离表，时速 40 英里在干燥路面上的总停车距离（反应距离+制动距离）约为 149 英尺。
q.why_en: According to the stopping distance table in the NJ Driver Manual, the total stopping distance (reaction distance + braking distance) at 40 mph on a dry road is about 149 feet.

q.en: An eight-sided sign means:
q.zh: 八角形的标志意为
q.why: 八角形 (octagon) 只用于停车标志 (STOP)，必须完全停车。
q.why_en: The octagon (eight-sided shape) is used only for STOP signs; you must come to a full stop.

q.en: Laws of New Jersey require you to keep to the right except:
q.zh: 新泽西州法律规定你行车时保持右侧行驶，除非
oe: when impractical to travel on that side of the roadway
oz: 当右边车道不适宜行驶
q.why: 新泽西要求靠右行驶，例外包括：右侧无法通行时、超车时、在单行道上，所以选“以上皆是”。
q.why_en: New Jersey law requires you to keep to the right, with exceptions: when it is impractical to travel on that side of the roadway, when passing, and on a one-way street. So the answer is "all of the above."

q.en: At night, you should drive slow enough to be able to stop within:
q.zh: 夜间驾车你与前车的安全车距应是
oe: 10 seconds from the time you apply the brake
the distance ahead lighted by your headlights
the time it takes for a light to change from yellow to red
oz: 车距保持在车头灯照到的范围内
信号灯由黄灯转为红灯的时间
q.why: 夜间应控制车速，使你能在车头灯 (headlights) 照亮的范围内停下来，否则来不及对灯光外的障碍物作出反应。
q.why_en: At night, drive slowly enough that you can stop within the distance lighted by your headlights; otherwise you cannot react in time to obstacles beyond your lights.
q.tip_en: Don't overdrive your headlights at night

q.en: The written test pass grade is:
q.zh: 笔试的合格分数线是
q.why: 新泽西笔试 (knowledge test) 共 50 题，须答对 80%（40 题）才能通过。
q.why_en: The New Jersey knowledge test has 50 questions, and you must get 80% (40 questions) right to pass.

q.en: An articulated vehicle endorsement allows the operation of:
q.zh: 能连接拖车的车辆其装备要求必须是
oe: a commercial vehicle registered over 18,000 lbs. Gross weight and joined by a coupling device with a drawn vehicle (trailer)
oz: 注册的毛重在 18000 磅以上（能连接拖车）的商用车辆
q.why: 铰接车辆附加签注 (articulated vehicle endorsement) 允许驾驶注册总重超过 18,000 磅、并通过连接装置拖挂车辆（拖车）的商用车。
q.why_en: An articulated vehicle endorsement allows operation of a commercial vehicle registered over 18,000 lbs. gross weight and joined by a coupling device with a drawn vehicle (trailer).

q.en: On a two-lane road if you are being followed very closely by another vehicle, you should:
q.zh: 在变平道上如你被后面车辆跟得过近时
oe: slow down gradually and encourage the driver to pass
stop vehicle suddenly to warn the other driver
pull over to the shoulder and stop
oz: 逐渐减速，鼓励后者先行
突然停车以警告其他驾驶员
q.why: 被后车紧跟 (tailgating) 时，应逐渐减速，让对方有机会超车。闪灯或突然刹车 (B/C) 会激怒对方并可能导致追尾。
q.tip: 被跟太近：慢下来让他走
q.why_en: If you are being tailgated, slow down gradually and encourage the driver to pass. Flashing your lights or stopping suddenly (B/C) can provoke the other driver and may cause a rear-end collision.
q.tip_en: Tailgater: slow down and let them pass

q.en: Roads are most slippery:
q.zh: 道路最滑的时候是
oe: during the first few minutes of rainfall
q.why: 刚下雨的头几分钟路面最滑，因为雨水与路面上的油污混合。
q.why_en: Roads are most slippery during the first few minutes of rainfall, because the rain mixes with oil on the road surface.

q.en: Emotions can have a great effect on your driving, if you are angry or excited you should:
q.zh: 情绪会影响驾车，如果你在生气激动时，你应该
oe: give yourself time to cool off
blow your horn to warn other drivers
q.why: 生气或激动时会影响判断，应先让自己冷静下来再开车。
q.why_en: Anger or excitement affects your judgment; give yourself time to cool off before driving.

q.en: High beam lights are used for:
q.zh: 远光灯是用在
q.why: 远光灯 (high beams) 用于空旷的乡村道路且前方无车时；雾天应使用近光灯，因为远光会被雾反射回来。
q.why_en: High beams are for open country driving when no vehicles are ahead. In fog, use low beams, because high beams reflect back off the fog.

q.en: Car inspection must be performed:
q.zh: 执行车辆检验必须
q.why: 新泽西的乘用车每两年 (every 2 years) 检验一次（新车首次检验为 5 年）。
q.why_en: Passenger vehicles in New Jersey are inspected every 2 years (a new vehicle's first inspection is due after 5 years).

q.en: During bad weather, the two-second rule should be increased to:
q.zh: 在天气恶劣的情况下，车距保持两秒钟的规定应增加到
q.why: 两秒规则 (two-second rule) 适用于良好路况；天气恶劣时应把跟车距离增加到三到四秒。
q.why_en: The two-second rule applies in good conditions; in bad weather, increase your following distance to three to four seconds.

q.en: What three items must you have with you when driving?
q.zh: 在驾车时必须携带哪三种东西？
q.why: 开车时必须随身携带驾照 (driver license)、车辆注册卡 (registration) 和保险卡 (insurance ID card)，故选“以上皆是”。
q.why_en: When driving, you must carry your driver license, vehicle registration card and insurance identification card, so the answer is "all of the above."

q.en: You may not park within how many feet of a fire hydrant?
q.zh: 你不在消防龙头多远范围内停车
q.why: 新泽西规定不得在消防栓 (fire hydrant) 10 英尺范围内停车。
q.why_en: New Jersey prohibits parking within 10 feet of a fire hydrant.

q.en: The best way to “talk” to other drivers is to:
q.zh: 与其他驾车者交流的最佳方法是
oe: roll down the window and yell
oz: 使用喇叭或者信号灯光
q.why: 与其他驾驶员“沟通”的最好方式是使用喇叭和车灯（包括转向灯、刹车灯），让对方清楚你的意图。
q.why_en: The best way to "talk" to other drivers is to use your horn and lights (including turn signals and brake lights) so they clearly know your intentions.

q.en: When using the brakes, a common mistake a new driver makes is:
q.zh: 使用刹车时新司机常犯的通病是
oe: not pushing the brake pedal hard enough
pushing the brake pedal down too hard
q.why: 新手常见错误是刹车踩得太猛 (too hard)，容易造成车轮抱死和失控；应平稳、逐渐地施加压力。
q.why_en: A common new-driver mistake is pushing the brake pedal down too hard, which can lock the wheels and cause loss of control; apply pressure smoothly and gradually.

q.en: A green arrow means:
q.zh: 绿色箭头表示
oe: proceed as shown by the arrow
q.why: 绿色箭头 (green arrow) 表示可以按箭头方向前进（受保护的转弯），但仍要注意路口内的行人和车辆。
q.why_en: A green arrow means you may proceed in the direction of the arrow (a protected turn), but still watch for pedestrians and vehicles in the intersection.

q.en: The two-second rule refers to:
q.zh: 两秒钟的规则是
oe: the distance ahead of you that should be looking
q.why: 两秒规则是用来保持安全跟车距离 (following distance) 的方法：前车经过某参照物后，你至少数两秒才经过同一点。
q.why_en: The two-second rule is a way to keep a safe following distance: after the vehicle ahead passes a fixed point, count at least two seconds before you pass the same point.

q.en: The best way to handle a curve is to:
q.zh: 最佳的转弯方法是
oe: Slow down before entering the curve
lean in the direction of the curve
q.why: 应在进入弯道之前就减速，在弯道中保持速度平稳；进入弯道后再急刹容易打滑。
q.why_en: Slow down before entering the curve and keep a steady speed through it; braking hard once you are in the curve can cause a skid.
q.tip_en: Slow before the curve, steady through it

q.en: The law allows you to turn right after stopping and yielding to all traffic and pedestrians at a red light unless:
q.zh: 在交通路口，何种情形下红灯不能依法右转
oe: there is a flashing red light
there is a sign “no turn on red”
there is a red arrow pointing right
oz: 有红灯不能转向的标志
q.why: 在停车并让行所有车辆和行人后可红灯右转，除非有“No Turn on Red”（红灯禁止右转）标志。
q.why_en: You may turn right on red after stopping and yielding to all traffic and pedestrians, unless there is a "No Turn on Red" sign.

q.en: If your car breaks down on an expressway, the first thing you should do is:
q.zh: 如果在高速公路上抛锚，要做的第一件事是
oe: try to pull off the road
q.why: 在高速公路上抛锚时，首先应尽量把车驶离行车道 (pull off the road)，开双闪警示，再考虑求助。
q.why_en: If your car breaks down on an expressway, first try to pull off the road, turn on your hazard lights, and then look for help.
q.tip_en: Get out of the travel lane first, then get help

q.en: After you drive through a deep puddle of water:
q.zh: 车辆经过深坑水潭之后
oe: pump your brakes to test them
roll your engine to dry it out
apply your brakes hard to test them
speed up to dry your tires
q.why: 驶过深水后刹车可能变湿失灵，应轻踩几次刹车 (pump the brakes) 测试并把刹车片弄干。
q.why_en: After driving through deep water, your brakes may be wet and weak; pump your brakes gently a few times to test and dry them.
q.tip_en: After water, pump the brakes to dry them

q.en: If a collision is impossible to avoid, you can lessen the impact by:
q.zh: 在无法避免相撞时，你应选择
oe: steering away from objects that do not “give”
q.why: 无法避免碰撞时，应把车转离不会“缓冲”的坚硬物体 (objects that do not give)，尽量撞向能缓冲的物体以减轻冲击。注意 A 选项的中文翻译有误。
q.flag: 中文翻译有误：A 原意为“转向会缓冲/可变形的物体”，C 原意为“伏倒在车内地板上”；答案 D 无误。
q.why_en: When a collision cannot be avoided, steer away from objects that do not "give" and toward objects that do, to lessen the impact. Note that the Chinese translation of option A is wrong.
q.tip_en: Avoid hard objects, hit soft ones
q.flag_en: Chinese translation error: A actually means "steer toward objects that give (are yielding/deformable)", and C means "drop to the car floor"; the answer D is correct.

q.en: A triangular sign with an orange center and red border means:
q.zh: 黄底有红边的三角形表示
oe: slow moving vehicle (The vehicle cannot travel faster than 25 mph)
q.why: 红边橙色三角形是慢速车辆标志 (slow moving vehicle emblem)，表示该车时速不能超过 25 英里，如农用车、马车。
q.why_en: A triangle with an orange center and red border is the slow moving vehicle emblem, meaning the vehicle cannot travel faster than 25 mph, such as farm equipment or horse-drawn vehicles.
q.tip_en: Orange triangle with red border = slow vehicle

q.en: If a collision is impossible to avoid, you should:
q.zh: 当碰撞不可避免时，你的选择是
oe: choose to hit something that will give away rather than something that’s rigid
choose to hit something that’s standing still rather than something moving toward you
if you have to hit anything, try to make it glancing blow or a sidewipe
oz: 选择柔软物体好过刚硬物体
选择固定物体好过移动物体
选择侧面碰擦，避免正面碰撞
q.why: 无法避免碰撞时：宁撞软物不撞硬物、宁撞静止物不撞迎面来车、尽量侧面擦撞 (glancing blow) 而非正面相撞，故选“以上皆是”。
q.why_en: When a collision cannot be avoided: hit something that gives rather than something rigid, something standing still rather than something moving toward you, and try for a glancing blow rather than a head-on hit. So the answer is "all of the above."
q.tip_en: Soft > hard, still > moving, glancing > head-on

q.en: After restoration of your driver license (or upon Completing an MVS Driver Improvement Program), you will be on probation for:
q.zh: 驾照被暂停（或完成驾驶提高班后）你取回驾照，但仍将被察看
q.why: 驾照恢复（或完成 MVC 驾驶改进课程）后，你将被察看 (probation) 一年。
q.why_en: After your driver license is restored (or you complete an MVC Driver Improvement Program), you will be on probation for one year.

q.en: The meaning of a hand signal when a driver’s hand and arm is downward is:
q.zh: 当司机将手和手臂均向下垂，这个手势意为
q.why: 手臂向下伸出表示减速或停车 (slow or stop)；手臂向上弯曲是右转，手臂水平伸出是左转。
q.why_en: Hand and arm extended downward means slow or stop; arm bent upward means right turn; arm extended straight out means left turn.
q.tip_en: Down = stop, up = right, straight out = left

q.en: Hydroplaning means:
q.zh: 汽车在湿路打滑的含义是
oe: road surfaces become slippery during the first minutes of rainfall
a car will skid when water is deeper than the tire tread
brakes fail to hold when cars are driven through deep water
tire treads lose contact with a wet road
oz: 在下雨最初几分钟路面最滑
路面水深超过轮胎汽车将打滑
汽车通过深水时刹车失灵
轮胎飞离受雨淋的地面
q.why: 湿路打滑 (hydroplaning) 指轮胎在积水上“滑行”，胎面与路面失去接触，导致无法转向和刹车。
q.why_en: Hydroplaning means the tires ride up on a layer of water and the tread loses contact with the road, so you cannot steer or brake.

q.en: You can practice drive with a valid special learner’s permit:
q.zh: 如有学习驾驶的特别许可证，其学习时间是
q.why: 持特别学习许可证 (special learner permit) 的驾驶员只能在早 5 点到晚 11 点之间练车，晚 11:01 至早 5 点禁止驾驶。
q.why_en: A driver with a special learner permit may practice only between 5 a.m. and 11 p.m.; driving from 11:01 p.m. to 5 a.m. is prohibited.

q.en: If your windshield wipers stop suddenly during rain or snow you should:
q.zh: 当你的雨刷在雨中或风雪中不能工作，你应该
oe: roll down the driver’s window and put your head out so can see ahead
brake and pull off the road
oz: 打开车窗，伸出头朝前看
使用刹车及时离开道路
q.why: 雨刷突然失灵时应减速、必要时摇下车窗查看前方，并刹车驶离道路，故选“以上皆是”。
q.why_en: If your wipers suddenly stop working, slow down, roll down the window to see ahead if needed, and brake and pull off the road, so the answer is "all of the above."

q.en: To obtain a New Jersey driver license or nondriver ID card, you must present these identifiers:
q.zh: 为获得新泽西州驾照或非驾车身份证，你必须出示什么证件
oe: proof of age, identity and that your presence in the country is authorized under federal law
oz: 年龄证件、身份证件以及联邦法所获准的居住证明
q.why: 申请新泽西驾照或非驾驶身份证，需证明年龄、身份，以及你在美国的居留是联邦法律授权的 (6 Points of ID)。
q.why_en: To get a New Jersey driver license or non-driver ID, you must prove your age, your identity, and that your presence in the U.S. is authorized under federal law (6 Points of ID).

q.en: As you drive, you must turn your headlights on:
q.zh: 驾车时你何时应打开车灯？
oe: when you turn your wipers on
q.why: 新泽西规定从日落后半小时至日出前半小时，以及使用雨刷时，都必须开车灯，故选“以上皆是”。
q.flag: 中文翻译有误：B/C 应为“日落后半小时/日出前半小时”，不是“一个半小时”；答案 D 无误。
q.why_en: New Jersey requires headlights from one-half hour after sunset to one-half hour before sunrise, and whenever your wipers are on, so the answer is "all of the above."
q.flag_en: Chinese translation error: B/C should read "one-half hour after sunset / one-half hour before sunrise", not "one and a half hours"; the answer D is correct.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志什么意思？
q.why: 图为黄色菱形“STOP AHEAD”警告标志，表示前方有停车标志，需准备停车。
q.why_en: The image is a yellow diamond "STOP AHEAD" warning sign: there is a stop sign ahead, so be ready to stop.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志什么意思？
oe: A four-way intersection ahead/There is a crossroad ahead
oz: 前方有四通路口/前方有十字路口
q.why: 黄色菱形上画黑色十字，表示前方有十字路口 (crossroad)。
q.why_en: A black cross on a yellow diamond means there is a crossroad ahead.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志什么意思？
q.why: 红底白字“DO NOT ENTER”是禁止驶入标志，通常设在单行道或匝道的逆行入口。
q.why_en: The red sign with white "DO NOT ENTER" lettering means no entry; it is usually posted at the wrong-way entrance to a one-way street or ramp.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志什么意思？
oe: You may pass if there are no cars coming.
You may not pass at this part of the road.
q.why: “DO NOT PASS”是管制标志，表示这段路禁止超车。
q.why_en: "DO NOT PASS" is a regulatory sign meaning passing is prohibited on this stretch of road.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志什么意思？
oe: Keep right if you are driving slow
Keep right if you are going to turn left.
Keep right if you are driving at the posted speed limit.
q.why: “SLOW TRAFFIC KEEP RIGHT”表示开得较慢的车辆应靠右行驶，把左侧车道留给较快的车辆。
q.why_en: "SLOW TRAFFIC KEEP RIGHT" means slower vehicles should keep right, leaving the left lane for faster traffic.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志什么意思？
oe: Keep to the right to turn left.
You must turn left if in left lane
q.why: “LEFT LANE MUST TURN LEFT”表示在左车道的车辆必须左转。
q.why_en: "LEFT LANE MUST TURN LEFT" means vehicles in the left lane must turn left.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志什么意思？
q.why: “SPEED ZONE AHEAD”表示前方限速将改变，需注意新的限速标志。
q.why_en: "SPEED ZONE AHEAD" means the speed limit is changing ahead; watch for the new speed limit sign.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志什么意思？
oe: You must stop at all times.
Allow other cars, if near, to pass before driving ahead.
You are not allowed to make right turns.
q.why: 让行标志 (YIELD) 表示要减速，必要时停车，让附近车辆和行人先行后再前进。
q.why_en: A YIELD sign means slow down, stop if necessary, and let nearby vehicles and pedestrians go first before proceeding.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志什么意思？
oe: Caution other traffic entering road ahead.
oz: 小心前方有其他车辆进入
q.why: “MERGING TRAFFIC”警告前方会有其他车辆从侧面并入你的道路，要注意调整车速和位置。
q.why_en: "MERGING TRAFFIC" warns that other vehicles will be entering your road from the side ahead; be ready to adjust your speed and position.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志什么意思？
q.why: “DIVIDED HIGHWAY ENDS”表示前方中间隔离带结束，道路变为双向无隔离，需靠右行驶并注意对向来车。
q.why_en: "DIVIDED HIGHWAY ENDS" means the median ends ahead and the road becomes undivided two-way traffic; keep right and watch for oncoming vehicles.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志什么意思？
oe: You may expect cars coming toward you
You may expect no traffic ahead.
q.why: “TWO WAY TRAFFIC AHEAD”表示前方变为双向通行，要预期有迎面来车。
q.why_en: "TWO WAY TRAFFIC AHEAD" means the road becomes two-way ahead; expect oncoming vehicles.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志什么意思？
q.why: 按题库答案为“小心前方减速”，但图片实际上是一条实黄线加一条虚黄线的路面标线，与选项不符。
q.flag: 图片与选项不匹配：图片是路面黄色实线+虚线标线，而选项是警告标志含义；题目疑似配错图，按原意答案保留 A。
q.why_en: The keyed answer is "Caution slow down ahead," but the image actually shows pavement markings (one solid and one broken yellow line), which don't match the options.
q.flag_en: Image doesn't match the options: the image shows solid + broken yellow pavement markings, while the options describe warning-sign meanings; the question appears to have the wrong image, so answer A is kept as originally intended.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志什么意思？
oe: You may not make left turns.
You may not make right turns.
You may not pass other traffic.
q.why: “NO LEFT TURN”是管制标志，表示此处禁止左转。
q.why_en: "NO LEFT TURN" is a regulatory sign meaning left turns are prohibited here.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志什么意思？
q.why: 黄色菱形“NARROW BRIDGE”警告前方桥梁变窄，需减速并注意对向车辆。
q.why_en: The yellow diamond "NARROW BRIDGE" sign warns that the bridge ahead is narrower; slow down and watch for oncoming vehicles.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志什么意思？
oz: 除非超车，否则必须靠右行驶
q.why: “KEEP RIGHT EXCEPT TO PASS”表示除超车外都应在右侧车道行驶。
q.why_en: "KEEP RIGHT EXCEPT TO PASS" means you should drive in the right lane except when passing.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志什么意思？
q.why: 黄色菱形“SCHOOL AHEAD”表示前方有学校，注意儿童并减速。
q.why_en: The yellow diamond "SCHOOL AHEAD" sign means there is a school ahead; watch for children and slow down.

q.en: If you are on a single or two-lane road and come to an intersection with a divided highway or a roadway with three or more lanes, you must:
q.zh: 如果你在单车道或者双车道的路上行至与双向车道的高速公路或有三条及以上车道的公路交叉的路口，你必须
oe: Take a left turn to merge into the traffic
Stop and take a right turn to merge into the traffic
Yield the right-of-way to other traffic
q.why: 从单车道或双车道道路驶入与分隔式公路或三车道以上道路的路口时，必须让行 (yield) 该道路上的车辆。
q.why_en: When you come from a single or two-lane road to an intersection with a divided highway or a roadway with three or more lanes, you must yield the right-of-way to traffic on that road.
q.tip_en: Smaller road yields to bigger road

q.en: The broken yellow lines on the pavement mean:
q.zh: 路面上黄色虚线的含义是
oe: The left lane is used for bicycles and motorcyclists
Passing is allowed if done safely
Traffic moves only in one direction
oz: 左侧车道是自行车和摩托车专用车道
q.why: 黄色虚线 (broken yellow lines) 表示在安全的情况下允许超车（越线）；实黄线才表示禁止超车。
q.why_en: Broken yellow lines mean passing (crossing the line) is allowed if done safely; solid yellow lines mean no passing.
q.tip_en: Broken: may cross; solid: may not

q.en: The vertical rectangular traffic sign generally gives:
q.zh: 垂直长方形的交通标志一遍给出
oe: Directions to the driver to stop
A warning about the condition of the road
q.why: 垂直长方形 (vertical rectangle) 白底标志一般是管制标志 (regulatory sign)，向驾驶员发出指令，如限速、禁止超车等。
q.why_en: A white vertical rectangular sign is generally a regulatory sign that gives instructions to the driver, such as speed limits or no passing.

q.en: These pavement markings mean:
q.zh: 这些路面标记意味着
oe: vehicles traveling in both directions can take left turns
vehicles traveling in both directions can take right turns
oz: 双向行驶的车辆可以左转
在两个方向行驶的车辆可以右转
q.why: 图为中间双向左转车道 (two-way left turn lane)：外侧实黄线、内侧虚黄线，两个方向的车辆都可从此车道左转。
q.why_en: The image shows a center two-way left turn lane: solid yellow lines on the outside, broken yellow lines on the inside. Vehicles traveling in both directions can turn left from this lane.

q.en: What does this sign indicate?
q.zh: 这个标志表示什么？
oe: The maximum allowable speed when children are present near a school zone
The maximum allowable speed at any time near a school zone
The minimum allowable speed at any time near a school zone
The minimum allowable speed at any time near a school zone
oz: 儿童在学区附近时的最大允许速度
学区附近任何时间的最大允许速度
在学校区域附近任何时候的最低允许速度
当儿童出现在学校区域附近时的最低允许速度
q.why: 学区限速标志“15 WHEN CHILDREN ARE PRESENT”表示有儿童在场时的最高限速。
q.why_en: The school zone sign "15 WHEN CHILDREN ARE PRESENT" gives the maximum speed when children are present.

q.en: This sign with two arrows allows:
q.zh: 这个带有两个箭头的标志允许
oe: Vehicles in both directions to pass
Vehicles from either direction to make a right turn
Vehicles from either direction to make a left turn
oz: 两个方向的车辆都可以超车
来自任何一个方向的车辆要进行右转弯
来自任一方向的车辆进行左转
q.why: 双箭头“ONLY”标志表示中间车道是双向左转专用车道，两个方向的车辆都可从此车道左转。
q.why_en: The two-arrow "ONLY" sign marks the center lane as a two-way left turn lane; vehicles from either direction can turn left from it.

q.en: What does this sign indicate?
q.zh: 这个标志表示什么？
oe: Passing on the left is permitted when the way ahead is clear
Passing is not allowed in either direction
Passing on the left is prohibited
Passing is allowed only during the daytime
oz: 在前方道路畅通的情况下，允许左侧超车
任何方向的超车都是不允许的
q.why: 中间是黄色虚线，两侧车流方向相反，在前方畅通、安全时可从左侧越线超车。
q.why_en: A broken yellow center line separates opposite directions of traffic; passing on the left is permitted when the way ahead is clear and safe.

q.en: What does this warning sign mean?
q.zh: 这个警告标志是什么意思？
oe: The indicated lane is permitted for high occupancy vehicles during specified timings
High occupancy vehicles are not allowed during specified times
The indicated lane is permitted for heavy trucks
No cars or buses are allowed during specified times
oz: 在指定时间允许高承载车辆使用指示的车道
在指定时间不允许高承载车辆
指示的车道允许重型卡车通行
D.在规定的时间内不允许汽车或公共汽车进入
q.why: 菱形标志加公交车/小汽车图案表示高承载车辆车道 (HOV lane)：在标明时段内只供高承载车辆使用。
q.why_en: A diamond with a bus/car symbol marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane: during the specified times, only high occupancy vehicles may use it.

q.en: What does this sign indicate?
q.zh: 这个标志表示什么？
oe: Keep to the right of the traffic island
oz: 右转进入低净度的地下通道
前方有分叉的高速公路
q.why: “Keep Right”标志：表示要从前方交通岛或隔离带的右侧通过。
q.why_en: The "Keep Right" sign means pass to the right of the traffic island or median ahead.

q.en: This black arrow-marked sign indicates that:
q.zh: 这个标志表示什么？
oe: Vehicles on the left must turn left and vehicles on the right may go straight or turn right
B.Vehicles on the left must turn left and vehicles on the right must go straight
Vehicles on the left must turn left and vehicles on the right must merge with the right lane
D.Vehicles on the left must turn left and vehicles on the right must turn right
oz: 左边的车辆必须左转，右边的车辆可以直行或右转
左边的车辆必须左转，右边的车辆必须直行
左边的车辆必须左转，右边的车辆必须与右边的车道合并
左边的车辆必须左转，右边的车辆必须右转
q.why: 车道使用标志：左车道“ONLY”必须左转，右车道箭头表示可直行或右转。
q.why_en: Lane-use sign: the left lane "ONLY" must turn left; the arrows for the right lane mean you may go straight or turn right.

q.en: This traffic sign means:
q.zh: 这个交通标志意味着
oe: Passing is allowed in these directions
Do not pass a vehicle on the left
Move only in the directions indicated
q.why: 车道使用控制标志 (lane-use control sign) 表示只能按箭头所示方向行驶。
q.why_en: A lane-use control sign means you may move only in the directions indicated by the arrows.

q.en: If you see this sign and you are driving in the left lane, you:
q.zh: 如果你看到这个标志，并且你在左边的车道上行驶，你
q.why: 在左车道看到左转专用标志时必须左转。注意图片显示的是双向左转车道标志，与题干略不一致。
q.flag: 图片疑似配错：图为“双向左转车道”标志，题干描述的是“左车道必须左转”标志；答案 D 按题意无误。
q.why_en: If you see a left-turn-only sign while in the left lane, you must turn left. Note that the image shows a two-way left turn lane sign, which doesn't quite match the question.
q.flag_en: Image appears wrong: it shows a two-way left turn lane sign, while the question describes a "left lane must turn left" sign; answer D is correct as intended.

q.en: This sign means:
q.zh: 这个标志意味着
oe: The lane is reserved for high-speed vehicles
The lane is shared for left turns in both directions of travel
The lane is reserved for certain purposes or certain vehicles
The lane is reserved for right turns
oz: 该车道是为高速车辆保留的
该车道为双向行驶的左转车道，可共享
该车道是为某些目的或某些车辆保留的
该车道是为右转保留的
q.why: “RESTRICTED LANE AHEAD”加菱形表示前方车道是限用车道，只供特定车辆（如 HOV、公交）或特定用途使用。
q.why_en: "RESTRICTED LANE AHEAD" with a diamond means the lane ahead is reserved for certain vehicles (such as HOVs or buses) or certain purposes.

q.en: 176.You arrive at a railroad crossing. The crossing has lights and a bell that are not activated at the moment. You cannot see a train approaching. Which of the following is true?
q.zh: 你来到了一个铁道口。该路口有灯光和铃声，但目前没有启动。你无法看到一辆火车正在接近。以下哪项是真的？
oe: You can proceed even if the flashing lights are on but you do not see a train approaching
School buses and certain trucks must stop at railroad crossings even when the tracks are clear
You can proceed while the flashing lights are on if there is only one set of tracks and you are certain no trains are coming
oz: 即使闪烁的灯亮着，但你没有看到有火车驶来，你也可以继续前进
校车和某些卡车必须在铁路交叉口停车，即使是在铁轨畅通的情况下
如果只有一组轨道，并且你确定没有火车来，你可以在闪光灯亮起时继续前进
q.why: 校车和运输某些危险品的卡车必须在所有铁路道口停车，即使铁轨畅通。A、C 都错：闪灯亮起时必须停车等待，绝不可通过。
q.why_en: School buses and certain trucks carrying hazardous materials must stop at all railroad crossings, even when the tracks are clear. A and C are both wrong: when the flashing lights are on, you must stop and wait, never proceed.

q.en: This sign indicates that:
q.zh: 这个标志表明
oe: Vehicles are allowed to make left turns from this lane
Vehicles must take a U-turn from this lane
Vehicles can make a U-turn from this lane
Drivers must go straight and should take a detour at the intersection
oz: 允许车辆从该车道左转
车辆必须从该车道调头
车辆可以从该车道调头
驾驶员必须直行，应在路口绕行
q.why: “U-turn ONLY”标志表示这条车道的车辆必须调头 (U-turn)。
q.why_en: The "U-turn ONLY" sign means vehicles in this lane must make a U-turn.

q.en: This sign means that:
q.zh: 这个标志意味着。
oe: you may either proceed straight ahead or turn to the left
you may either proceed straight ahead or turn to the right
You must make a left turn if you are on the left
there is a sharp turn ahead
oz: 你可以直接前进或向右转弯
如果你是在左边，你必须左转。
q.why: 箭头同时指向左方和前方，表示此车道可直行或左转。
q.why_en: The arrow points both left and straight ahead, meaning from this lane you may either proceed straight ahead or turn left.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志是什么意思？
oe: You are not allowed to enter
You are going in the wrong direction
oz: 前面是一条废弃的道路
q.why: 红色圆圈中间一道白横杠，是“禁止驶入” (Do Not Enter) 的标志。
q.why_en: A red circle with a white horizontal bar is the "Do Not Enter" sign.

q.en: This red and white triangle indicates:
q.zh: 这个红白相间的三角形表示
q.why: 红边白底倒三角形是让行标志 (YIELD)。
q.why_en: A downward-pointing red and white triangle is a YIELD sign.

q.en: If you see this sign, it means you are:
q.zh: 如果你看到这个标志，这意味着你是
q.why: “WRONG WAY”表示你正在逆向行驶，应立即安全地掉头或驶离。
q.why_en: "WRONG WAY" means you are driving against traffic; turn around or get off the road immediately and safely.

q.en: This octagonal sign indicates:
q.zh: 这个八角形的标志表示。
oz: 前方有一个交通信号灯
q.why: 八角形红底白字是停车标志 (STOP)。
q.why_en: A red octagon with white lettering is a STOP sign.

q.en: You drive up to an intersection and you see this sign. What should you do?
q.zh: 你开车到一个十字路口，看到这个标志。你应该怎么做？
oe: Slow down and only proceed if the intersection is clear
Find another route, you cannot proceed through here
oz: 你开车到一个十字路口，看到这个标志。你应该怎么做？
放慢速度，只有在十字路口畅通的情况下才能继续前进
寻找其他路线，你不能通过这里继续前进 Come to a complete stop and yield to any traffic before proceeding 完全停止，并在继续前行前让开任何车辆 Come to a complete stop and then go  完全停止后再走
q.why: 看到停车标志 (STOP) 必须完全停车，让行路口内的车辆和行人后再继续前进。
q.flag: 题目选项排版错乱：英文/中文选项错位。正确内容应为“Come to a complete stop and yield to any traffic before proceeding（完全停止并让行其他车辆后再前进）”，但该句被并入 D 栏，而 C 栏显示的是“放慢速度…”。
q.why_en: At a STOP sign you must come to a complete stop and yield to vehicles and pedestrians in the intersection before proceeding.
q.flag_en: Option layout is garbled: the English/Chinese options are misaligned. The correct option should read "Come to a complete stop and yield to any traffic before proceeding," but that sentence was merged into column D, while column C shows "Slow down...".

q.en: The octagonal shape in the figure is:
q.zh: 图中的八角形是
q.why: 八角形 (octagon) 是停车标志 (STOP) 专用的形状。
q.why_en: The octagon is the shape used only for STOP signs.

q.en: What does this sign indicate?
q.zh: 这个标志表示什么？
oz: 前方有缓慢行驶的车辆
q.why: 橙色中心红边三角形是慢速车辆标志 (slow moving vehicle)，前方车辆时速不超过 25 英里。
q.why_en: A triangle with an orange center and red border is the slow moving vehicle emblem; the vehicle ahead travels no faster than 25 mph.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志是什么意思？
oe: No trucks are allowed on the road where this sign is posted
Drivers can park their trucks on the road where this sign is posted
Only heavy goods vehicles are allowed
Vehicle parking is not allowed ahead
oz: 在贴有此标志的道路上不允许卡车通行
司机可以将卡车停在贴有此标志的道路上
q.why: 红圈斜杠加卡车图案表示禁止卡车通行 (No Trucks)。
q.why_en: A red circle and slash over a truck symbol means no trucks allowed (No Trucks).

q.en: This sign indicates:
q.zh: 这个标志表明。
oe: No parking is allowed at the sign
The road ahead is closed permanently
Parking is allowed for disabled persons only
oz: 前面的路是永久关闭的
q.why: 红圈斜杠加“P”表示禁止停车 (No Parking)。
q.why_en: A red circle and slash over a "P" means No Parking.

q.en: At 9:30am, beside this sign you are:
q.zh: 上午9:30，在这个标志旁，你是
oe: Allowed to park for less than 5 minutes
Allowed to park with a special permit only
oz: 允许停放时间不超过5分钟
只允许在有特别许可的情况下停车
q.why: 标志写明 8:30 AM 至 5:30 PM 禁止停车，上午 9:30 在此时段内，所以不允许停车。
q.why_en: The sign prohibits parking from 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM; 9:30 AM falls within that period, so you are not permitted to park.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志是什么意思？
oe: Motorists must use extreme caution and slow down
Pedestrians ahead; no entry for vehicles
oz: 驾车者必须极为谨慎，并减速行驶
前方有行人；车辆不能进入
驾驶员必须为行人停车
q.why: 红圈斜杠加行人图案表示禁止行人通行/横穿 (No Pedestrian Crossing)。
q.why_en: A red circle and slash over a pedestrian symbol means pedestrians may not cross here (No Pedestrian Crossing).

q.en: This sign with a red circle means:
q.zh: 这个带红圈的标志意味着
oe: The right lane is closed ahead
The left lane is closed ahead
The left turn is not permitted
The right turn is not permitted
oz: 前面的左边车道已经关闭
q.why: 红圈斜杠加左转箭头表示禁止左转 (No Left Turn)。
q.why_en: A red circle and slash over a left-turn arrow means No Left Turn.

q.en: When you see this sign, you should:
q.zh: 当你看到这个标志时，你应该。
oe: Not make a U-turn/vehicles must not turn around at an intersection or in the middle of a street
oz: 不调头/车辆不得在十字路口或街道中间调头
q.why: 红圈斜杠加调头箭头表示禁止调头 (No U-Turn)。
q.why_en: A red circle and slash over a U-turn arrow means No U-Turn.

q.en: If you see this sign, you:
q.zh: 如果你看到这个标志，你应该
oe: should not park on the left of the sign
can only stop to take a break
must park on the left of the sign
oz: 不应在标志的左边停车
q.why: “NO PARKING ANY TIME”加左箭头表示箭头所指（标志左侧）区域任何时候都不能停车。
q.why_en: "NO PARKING ANY TIME" with a left arrow means no parking at any time in the area the arrow points to (left of the sign).

q.en: What does this sign indicate?
q.zh: 这个标志表明了什么？
oe: Left turn is allowed, provided the circular green signal is lit and there is no approaching traffic
B.Left turn is allowed only when the circular green signal is not lit
Left turn is not allowed when green arrow goes out
Left turn is allowed when green arrow is on
oz: 允许左转，条件是圆形绿色信号灯亮起，并且没有接近的车辆
只有在圆形绿灯未亮时才允许左转
绿色箭头熄灭时不允许左转
当绿色箭头亮起时，允许左转
q.why: “LEFT TURN YIELD ON GREEN”表示绿色圆灯时可以左转，但必须让行对向来车和行人。
q.why_en: "LEFT TURN YIELD ON GREEN" means you may turn left on a circular green light, but must yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.

q.en: What does this sign indicate?
q.zh: 这个标志表示什么？
oe: A driver is required to stop
A driver must watch for oncoming vehicles
A driver is required to slow down
A driver may proceed, if the intersection is clear
oz: 司机必须注意迎面而来的车辆
如果十字路口畅通无阻，司机可以继续前进
q.why: 绿灯 (green light) 表示路口畅通时可以前进，但仍需让行路口内的车辆和行人。
q.why_en: A green light means you may proceed if the intersection is clear, but you must still yield to vehicles and pedestrians in the intersection.

q.en: This route marker sign indicates:
q.zh: 这个路线标志牌表明。
oe: The right turn to enter route 47north
q.why: 路线标志下方的箭头指向右，表示右转进入 47 号公路北向 (Route 47 North)。
q.why_en: The arrow below the route marker points right, meaning turn right to enter Route 47 North.

q.en: If you see this sign at an intersection above your lane, it means you
q.zh: 如果你在十字路口你的车道上方看到这个标志，这意味着你
oe: must drive straight through the intersection
come to a complete stop when you reach the intersection
oz: 必须直行通过十字路口
到了十字路口要完全停下来
过了十字路口再换车道
q.why: 白底黑色直箭头加“ONLY”是车道用途管制标志 (lane-use control)：该车道只能直行，不能转弯。
q.why_en: A black straight-ahead arrow with "ONLY" on a white sign is a lane-use control sign: this lane must go straight through and cannot turn.
q.tip_en: ONLY = go only where the arrow points

q.en: This posted sign is a/an:
q.zh: 这个张贴的标志是一个/一个
oz: 高速公路上的速度指示
q.why: 白底黑字的“SPEED LIMIT”是限速标志 (regulatory speed limit sign)，图中 75 mph / 120 km/h 用于高速公路。注意新泽西州高速公路最高限速一般为 65 mph。
q.tip: 白色长方形 = 法规/限速
q.why_en: A white "SPEED LIMIT" sign with black lettering is a regulatory speed limit sign; the 75 mph / 120 km/h shown here applies on highways. Note that the maximum speed limit on New Jersey highways is generally 65 mph.

q.en: What does this arrow-marked sign mean?
q.zh: 这个箭头标记的标志是什么意思？
oe: You are approaching a right turn
You are approaching a left turn
oz: 前方有一个急速的左转弯
你正在接近一个右转弯
q.why: 按题库答案，带箭头的弯道/转弯警告标志表示前方要右转 (right turn)。
q.flag: 图片与题目不符：图中是“RESTRICTED LANE AHEAD”（前方专用车道/HOV 菱形标志），并非箭头标志；按题干“箭头标志”理解，答案 C 才成立。
q.why_en: Per the answer key, the arrow-marked turn warning sign means "You are approaching a right turn".
q.flag_en: Image doesn't match the question: it shows a "RESTRICTED LANE AHEAD" (HOV diamond) sign, not an arrow sign. Answer C only holds if you go by the stem's "arrow-marked sign".

q.en: Which of the following is NOT true about freeway minimum speed limits?
q.zh: 关于高速公路的最低速度限制，以下哪项是不正确的？
oe: You can get a ticket for driving too slowly
If mechanical problems prohibit you from keeping with traffic, you should pull over where it is safe and turn on your hazard lights
You should try to match the speed of other traffic up to the safe and legal speed limit
Posted minimum speed limits are optional
oz: 你可以因驾驶速度过慢而收到罚单
如果机械问题使你无法与交通保持一致，你应该把车停在安全的地方，并打开你的危险灯
你应该尽量保持和其他车辆的速度匹配，达到安全和合法的速度限制
公布的最低速度限制是可选的
q.why: 最低限速 (minimum speed) 是强制性的，开得太慢同样会被开罚单，所以“最低限速可选”是错误说法。车辆故障跟不上车流时，应安全靠边并打开双闪 (hazard lights)。
q.why_en: Minimum speed limits are mandatory - "You can get a ticket for driving too slowly" - so "Posted minimum speed limits are optional" is the false statement. If mechanical problems keep you from keeping up with traffic, pull over where it is safe and turn on your hazard lights.
q.tip_en: Minimum speed limits are law too

q.en: What does this sign indicate?
q.zh: 这个标志表示什么？
oe: An interstate traffic merging area ahead
oz: 前方有一条弯曲的道路
前方有一个州际交通合并区
前方有一个环形交叉路口
q.why: 白色方形牌上三个箭头首尾相接成圆形，表示前方是环岛 (roundabout)，按逆时针方向行驶并让行环内车辆。
q.why_en: Three arrows chasing each other in a circle on a white square sign mean a roundabout is ahead: travel counterclockwise and yield to vehicles already in the circle.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志是什么意思
oe: Traffic must come to a complete stop
oz: 交通必须不停歇地前进
交通工具必须小心翼翼地行驶
q.why: 闪烁黄灯 (flashing yellow) 表示减速并小心通过 (proceed with caution)，不需要停车。闪烁红灯才要像 STOP 一样完全停下。
q.why_en: A flashing yellow light means slow down and proceed with caution; you don't need to stop. Only a flashing red light requires a complete stop, like a STOP sign.
q.tip_en: Flashing yellow = slow; flashing red = stop

q.en: This black and yellow marked sign is:
q.zh: 这个黑色和黄色标记的标志是。
oe: A guide sign at interstate highways
A warning sign at work zones
An object marker in the roadway
oz: 路面上的一个物体标记
q.why: 黑黄斜条纹竖牌是障碍物标记 (object marker)，用来标出路中或路边的桥墩、护栏端等障碍物。
q.why_en: A vertical sign with black and yellow diagonal stripes is an object marker, used to mark obstructions in or next to the roadway such as bridge piers or guardrail ends.

q.en: Which of the following signs represents two-way traffic?
q.zh: 以下哪个标志代表双向交通？
q.why: 图中四个警告标志：左上环岛、右上铁路道口 (RR)、左下上下相反的两个箭头 = 双向交通 (two-way traffic)、右下为车道并入/增加。双向交通标志位于第三个位置，即 C。
q.tip: 一上一下箭头 = 双向
q.flag: 题目原无选项文字，只能按图中位置（左上A、右上B、左下C、右下D）理解，C 为双向交通标志。
