q.why_en: The image shows four warning signs: top left is a roundabout, top right is a railroad crossing (RR), bottom left has two opposing up/down arrows = two-way traffic, and bottom right is a merge/added lane. The two-way traffic sign is in the third position, i.e. C.
q.tip_en: One arrow up, one down = two-way
q.flag_en: The question has no option text, so options can only be read by position in the image (top left A, top right B, bottom left C, bottom right D); C is the two-way traffic sign.

q.en: What does this sign indicate?
q.zh: 这个标志表示什么？
q.why: 图中中心有圆岛、四个方向的车都绕它单向行驶，是环形交叉口 (circular intersection / roundabout)。
q.why_en: The image shows a central island with traffic from all four directions circulating one way around it: a circular intersection (roundabout).

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志是什么意思？
oe: 45 mph is the minimum speed limit
The maximum speed limit is 45 mph
You can drive up to 45 mph when driving at night
oz: 夜间驾驶时速最高可达 45 英里/小时
q.why: 黑底白字“NIGHT 45”是夜间限速 (night speed limit)：夜间最高只能开 45 mph。
q.why_en: "NIGHT 45" in white on black is a night speed limit: at night you may drive no faster than 45 mph.

q.en: This flag person’s sign indicates that:
q.zh: 这个旗人的标志表明。
oe: Drivers must go at a posted speed
oz: 司机必须按规定的速度行驶
q.why: 图中旗手 (flagger) 把旗子从水平位置慢慢向下挥动，表示车辆应减速 (slow down) 慢行。旗子水平伸出不动才表示停车。
q.tip: 旗平举 = 停；旗慢挥 = 慢
q.why_en: The flagger is slowly waving the flag down from the horizontal position, meaning drivers must slow down. Holding the flag straight out and still means stop.
q.tip_en: Flag held level = stop; flag waved slowly = slow

q.en: What does this figure indicate?
q.zh: 这个图形说明了什么？
oe: A broken white line that prohibits passing
A broken white line that allows passing
An accident situation due to a less following distance
oz: 由于跟车距离较短，出现事故情况
q.why: 白色虚线 (broken white line) 分隔同向车道，在安全时允许越线变道或超车 (passing)。
q.why_en: A broken white line separates lanes of traffic moving in the same direction; you may cross it to change lanes or pass when it is safe.
q.tip_en: Broken lines may be crossed; solid lines may not

q.en: The single white dashed line in this figure indicates:
q.zh: 该图中的单一白色虚线表示
oe: Traffic moving in the same direction
The center of a roadway where passing is prohibited
Traffic moving in the opposite direction
oz: 禁止通行的道路的中心点
q.why: 白色线分隔的是同方向 (same direction) 行驶的车道；黄色线才分隔对向车流。
q.why_en: White lines separate lanes of traffic moving in the same direction; yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions.

q.en: What does this sign indicate?
q.zh: 这个标志表示什么？
oe: Vehicles may cross the broken yellow line to pass or turn, if it is safe to do so
Vehicles are allowed to cross the broken yellow line only to turn, if it is safe to do so
Vehicles are not allowed to cross the broken yellow line to pass or turn
Vehicles are allowed to cross the broken yellow line only to pass, if it is safe to do so
oz: 在安全的情况下，车辆可以越过虚黄线超车或转弯
车辆只允许越过虚黄线转弯，如果这样做是安全的
车辆不允许越过虚线黄线超车或转向
在安全的情况下，车辆只允许越过虚线黄线超车
q.why: 黄色中心虚线 (broken yellow line) 分隔对向车流，在安全时可越线超车或左转。
q.tip: 黄虚线：安全时可越线超车
q.why_en: A broken yellow center line separates opposing traffic; you may cross it to pass or turn when it is safe.
q.tip_en: Broken yellow: cross to pass when safe

q.en: This sign is a/an:
q.zh: 这是什么标志？
q.why: 黄色菱形牌上的折角箭头配 25 MPH 建议速度，提示前方是急弯 (sharp curve/turn)，须减速到约 25 mph。严格按标准说，90° 折角箭头叫“转弯标志 (turn sign)”，题库把它算作急弯标志。
q.why_en: A bent arrow on a yellow diamond with a 25 MPH advisory speed warns of a sharp curve/turn ahead; slow to about 25 mph. Strictly speaking, a 90-degree bent arrow is a "turn sign", but the question bank counts it as a sharp curve sign.
q.tip_en: The sharper the arrow bends, the sharper the curve

q.en: This sign represents:
q.zh: 这个标志代表。
oe: the number of vehicles allowed to park
the maximum speed limit on a road
q.why: 白色盾形加数字是美国国道路线标志 (US route marker)。
q.why_en: A white shield with a number is a US route marker.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志是什么意思？
oe: Country road ahead; vehicles must slow down
Farm machinery is crossing the road
A slippery road ahead; use special tires
Farm equipment is not allowed beyond this sign
oz: 前方是乡村道路；车辆必须减速
农业机械正在穿越道路
前方道路湿滑；使用特殊轮胎
农场设备不允许超过此标志
q.why: 黄色菱形上画着拖拉机，提醒前方可能有农用机械 (farm machinery) 穿过或在路上低速行驶。
q.why_en: A tractor on a yellow diamond warns that farm machinery may be crossing or moving slowly on the road ahead.

q.en: What does this diamond-shaped sign mean?
q.zh: 这个菱形标志是什么意思？
q.why: 橙色菱形牌是施工区 (work zone) 警告，上面是持旗人图案，表示前方有旗手 (flagger)，要按其指挥行驶。
q.why_en: An orange diamond sign is a work zone warning; the flagger symbol means a flagger is ahead and you must follow their directions.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志是什么意思？
oe: A minimum suggested speed on a highway
The posted speed limit for a sharp right turn
A safe speed indication for a curve ahead to the right
The posted speed limit for a reversing curve
oz: 高速公路上的最低建议速度
右急转弯时的规定速度限制
右转弯道安全速度指示
倒车弯道的张贴速度限制
q.why: 右弯箭头警告牌配 35 MPH 小牌，是前方右弯的建议安全速度 (advisory speed)，不是法定限速。
q.tip: 黄色小牌数字 = 建议速度
q.why_en: A right-curve arrow warning sign with a 35 MPH plaque gives the advisory speed for the curve ahead to the right; it is not a legal speed limit.
q.tip_en: Number on a small yellow plaque = advisory speed

q.en: When you see this road sign, you should:
q.zh: 当你看到这个路牌时，你应该。
oe: Exit the highway with a speed less than 30 mph
Increase your speed to 30 mph and pass the vehicle in front of you
Exit the highway with a speed greater than 30 mph
Exit the highway with the posted speed
oz: 以低于30英里/小时的速度离开高速路
将你的速度提高到30英里/小时，并超过你前面的车辆
离开高速公路时，速度超过30英里/小时
以规定的速度离开高速公路
q.why: 黄色“EXIT 30 MPH”是出口匝道建议速度 (exit advisory speed)，离开高速时应按标示速度行驶。
q.why_en: A yellow "EXIT 30 MPH" sign is the exit ramp advisory speed; leave the highway at the posted speed.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志是什么意思？
oe: There is a school crossing ahead; prepare to stop
There is a shared section of road ahead; slow down and watch out for pedestrians
There is a park or playground ahead; slow down and watch for pedestrians
oz: 前方有一个学校路口，准备停车
前方有一段共用道路，请减速并注意行人
前方有公园或操场；放慢速度，注意行人 There is a pedestrian crossing or crosswalk ahead; prepare to stop 前方有一个行人穿越或人行横道，准备停车
q.why: 黄绿色五边形 (pentagon) 加两个行人是学校区/学校人行横道 (school crossing) 标志，应减速并准备停车让学生通过。
q.flag: 选项文字错乱（B/C/D 的中英文错位、合并），但答案 A（学校路口，准备停车）正确。
q.why_en: A yellow-green pentagon with two pedestrians is a school crossing sign; slow down and prepare to stop for students crossing.
q.flag_en: Options are garbled (B/C/D Chinese and English text misaligned and merged), but answer A ("There is a school crossing ahead; prepare to stop") is correct.

q.en: What does this sign indicate?
q.zh: 这个标志表示什么？
q.why: 环岛警告标志下方的 15 是进入环岛的建议速度 (advisory speed in roundabout)。
q.why_en: The 15 below the roundabout warning sign is the advisory speed for entering the roundabout.

q.en: This steady red cross mark sign over a lane in a highway indicates that ____.
q.zh: 在高速公路的一条车道上，这个稳定的红色十字标记牌表示。
oe: you must not drive in this lane
you must drive only in this lane
you must stop in this lane
oz: 你必须只在这条车道上行驶
你必须在这条车道上停车
q.why: 车道上方持续亮的红色 X (steady red X) 表示该车道禁止行驶，必须换到其他车道。
q.tip: 红X不能走，绿箭头可以走
q.why_en: A steady red X over a lane means you must not drive in that lane; move to another lane.
q.tip_en: Red X = don't use; green arrow = OK to use

q.en: This diamond-shaped sign indicates:
q.zh: 这个菱形标志表示。
oe: a side road near a railroad crossing
q.why: 菱形牌上画着车辆在铁轨上被卡住，警告前方是低底盘/路面隆起的铁路道口 (low ground clearance railroad crossing)，低底盘车辆可能刮底被卡。
q.why_en: A diamond sign showing a vehicle stuck on the tracks warns of a low ground clearance railroad crossing ahead, where low vehicles may scrape and get stuck.

q.en: What does this image mean?
q.zh: 这个图像是什么意思？
oe: Driving is prohibited through this lane
You are permitted to go through the lane
You are required to stop your vehicle
q.why: 旗手把旗子放低、用另一只手示意前进，表示车辆可以通过 (proceed)。
q.tip: 旗放低 + 招手 = 走
q.why_en: The flagger is lowering the flag and waving traffic on with the other hand, meaning you may proceed.

q.en: What does this sign indicate?
q.zh: 这个标志表示什么？
q.why: 上下箭头加 12'-6" 表示前方限高 (low clearance)，路面到上方结构只有 12 英尺 6 英寸。
q.why_en: Up/down arrows with 12'-6" mean low clearance ahead: only 12 feet 6 inches between the road and the structure above.

q.en: This diamond-shaped sign indicates:
q.zh: 这个菱形标志表示。
oe: A parking area ahead; the width of the road is 13 feet and 6 inches
A median ahead; the width of the road is 13 feet and 6 inches
oz: 前方有一个停车区；道路宽度为13英尺6英寸

前方有一个中间地带；道路的宽度为13英尺6英寸 An overpass ahead; clearance from the roadway surface to the overpass is 13 feet and 6 inches 前方有立交桥；从路面到立交桥的间隙为13英尺6英寸 A bridge ahead; the width of the road is 13 feet and 6 inches 前方有一座桥；道路的宽度为13英尺6英寸
q.why: 上下箭头加 13'-6" 表示前方立交桥/天桥净空 (overpass clearance) 为 13 英尺 6 英寸，高车要注意。
q.tip: 上下箭头 = 高度，不是宽度
q.flag: 选项文字错乱（中英文错位、多个选项挤在 D 中）；还原后 C 应为“前方立交桥，净高 13 英尺 6 英寸”，答案 C 正确。
q.why_en: Up/down arrows with 13'-6" mean an overpass ahead with 13 feet 6 inches of clearance; tall vehicles should take care.
q.flag_en: Option text is garbled (Chinese/English misaligned, several options crammed into D); restored, C should read "Overpass ahead, clearance 13 feet 6 inches". Answer C is correct.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志是什么意思？
q.why: 菱形牌上道路两侧向内收窄，表示前方是窄桥 (narrow bridge)。
q.why_en: A diamond sign with the road edges narrowing inward means a narrow bridge is ahead.

q.en: This curved arrow indicates that:
q.zh: 这个弯曲的箭头表示。
oe: The right lane is closed ahead
oz: 一条分车道公路在前方结束
一条分车道公路开始在前面
前面的右车道已经关闭
q.why: 箭头从同一道路分开、中间出现中央分隔带，表示前方开始变成分隔公路 (divided highway begins)，靠右行驶。
q.tip: 分隔带在前方 = 开始
q.why_en: Arrows splitting apart from one road with a median appearing between them mean a divided highway begins ahead; keep right.

q.en: If you are driving 65 mph, and you approach this sign, it means ____.
q.zh: 如果你以每小时65英里的速度行驶，而你接近这个标志，这意味着。
oe: You will have to slow down up ahead
You are approaching a school zone
You will need to speed up ahead
oz: 你将不得不在前面放慢速度
你正在接近一个学校区域
q.why: “SPEED LIMIT 55” 加向前箭头是前方降速 (reduced speed ahead) 标志；你以 65 mph 行驶时必须准备减速到 55。
q.why_en: "SPEED LIMIT 55" with an ahead arrow is a reduced speed ahead sign; driving at 65 mph, you must prepare to slow down to 55.

q.en: This sign on a highway shows:
q.zh: 高速公路上的这个标志表示。
oz: 一个即将到来的三叉路口
q.why: 主路旁伸出一条短横线，表示前方有支路 (side road) 汇入，注意有车进出。
q.why_en: A short line branching off the main road means a side road joins ahead; watch for vehicles entering and leaving.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志是什么意思？
oe: A dangerous goods truck is moving
A high occupancy farm vehicle is moving
oz: 一辆危险品卡车正在行驶
一辆超载农用车正在行驶
一辆重型卡车正在行驶
q.why: 黄色菱形牌上的消防车表示前方有消防站 (fire station)，消防车可能突然驶出。
q.why_en: A fire truck on a yellow diamond means a fire station is ahead and fire trucks may pull out suddenly.

q.en: This diamond-shaped orange sign is placed in:
q.zh: 这个菱形的橙色标志被放置在。
q.why: 橙色菱形牌用于施工区 (work zones)；“BE PREPARED TO STOP”提醒前方可能需要停车。
q.why_en: Orange diamond signs are used in work zones; "BE PREPARED TO STOP" warns you may need to stop ahead.

q.en: This figure indicates that:
q.zh: 这个图形表明。
oe: A public utility crew is ahead
oz: 一个公共事业的工作人员在前面
q.why: 橙色菱形牌上是拿铲子的工人，表示前方有道路/公共事业工作人员 (road/utility crew) 施工，应减速注意。
q.why_en: An orange diamond showing a worker with a shovel means a road/public utility crew is working ahead; slow down and be alert.

q.en: This sign is used for:
q.zh: 这个标志用于。
oe: Showing alternate routes during road closures and construction
Making the route to a hospital
oz: 显示道路封闭和施工期间的备用路线
q.why: 橙色“DETOUR”箭头牌指示道路封闭或施工时的绕行路线 (detour)。
q.why_en: An orange "DETOUR" arrow sign shows the alternate route during road closures and construction.

q.en: What does this traffic sign mean?
q.zh: 这个交通标志是什么意思？
oe: Right turn is prohibited after 1000 ft
oz: 另一条替换道路的开始
q.why: “DETOUR 1000 FT” 表示 1000 英尺后开始绕行路线 (detour / alternate route)。
q.why_en: "DETOUR 1000 FT" means the detour (alternate route) begins in 1000 feet.

q.en: This black cross mark sign is
q.zh: 这个黑色的十字标记标志是
oe: a road repair sign near a work zone
an advance warning sign for tracks/There is a railroad crossing ahead
a pavement marking sign near rotaries
a right turn sign at a four-way intersection
oz: 工作区附近的道路维修标志
轨道的预先警告信号 /前面有一个铁道口
转盘附近的人行道标识牌
在一个十字路口右转标志
q.why: 黄色圆牌上 X 和两个 R 是铁路道口预告标志 (railroad advance warning)，前方有铁路道口，应减速、看听、准备停车。
q.why_en: A round yellow sign with an X and two Rs is a railroad advance warning sign: a railroad crossing is ahead, so slow down, look and listen, and be prepared to stop.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志是什么意思？
oe: A new railroad is under construction
The roadway ahead is closed for repairs
The railroad is closed for repairs
oz: 一条新的铁路正在建设中
前面的道路被关闭进行维修
q.why: 菱形牌上道路与铁轨斜交，表示前方有铁路道口 (railroad crossing)。
q.why_en: A diamond sign with the road crossing the tracks at an angle means a railroad crossing is ahead.

q.en: This warning sign alerts a driver that:
q.zh: 这个警告牌提醒司机
oe: A multi-use path crossing is ahead
The lane must be shared with bicyclists
A single use path crossing is ahead
oz: 前方有一个多功能道路交叉口
该车道必须与骑自行车的人共享
前方有一个单一用途的道路交叉口
q.why: 自行车加行人图案配斜向下箭头，表示前方有多用途小径 (multi-use path / trail) 穿越道路。
q.why_en: A bicycle and pedestrian symbol with a downward diagonal arrow means a multi-use path (trail) crosses the road ahead.

q.en: This sign cautions that:
q.zh: 这个标志提醒注意。
oz: 前面是一条曲折的道路
q.why: 车后面拖着弯曲的车轮印，表示路面湿滑 (slippery when wet)，应减速、避免急刹急转。
q.why_en: A car trailing wavy tire tracks means slippery when wet; slow down and avoid hard braking and sharp turns.

q.en: This pennant sign warns of:
q.zh: 这个旗帜性标志警告说。
oe: the ending of a no-passing zone
the beginning of a no-passing zone/No-passing zone for all vehicles
oz: 禁止超车区的开始/ 所有车辆禁止超车的区域
q.why: 三角旗形 (pennant) 黄牌放在道路左侧，表示禁止超车区 (no-passing zone) 开始。
q.why_en: A yellow pennant-shaped sign on the left side of the road marks the beginning of a no-passing zone.

q.en: What is the meaning of this sign?
q.zh: 这个标志的含义是什么？
oe: Road shoulder is much lower than the road surface
q.why: 车轮掉下路肩的图案表示低路肩 (low shoulder)，路肩比路面低很多。
q.why_en: A wheel dropping off the shoulder means low shoulder: the road shoulder is much lower than the road surface.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志是什么意思？
oe: The maximum speed for this corner is 35 mph
The minimum speed for this corner is 35 mph
There is a 35 degree corner ahead
The recommended speed for this corner is 35 mph
oz: 这个角落的最高速度是35英里/小时
这个角落的最低速度是35英里/小时
这个角落的建议速度是35英里/小时
q.why: 弯道警告配 35 是建议速度 (advisory speed)，不是法定最高或最低限速。
q.why_en: A curve warning with 35 is an advisory speed, not a legal maximum or minimum speed limit.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志是什么意思？
oe: The speed limit at night is 35 mph
The speed limit during the day is 35 mph
The recommended speed limit is 35 mph
oz: 晚上的限速是35英里/小时
速度限制为每小时35英里
白天的限速是35英里/小时
建议速度限制为每小时35英里
q.why: 黄色牌上的速度是建议速度 (advisory speed)，通常挂在警告牌下方；白色牌才是法定限速。
q.why_en: Speeds on yellow signs are advisory speeds, usually posted below a warning sign; only white signs show legal speed limits.

q.en: This sign warns the drivers that they:
q.zh: 这个标志警告司机，他们
oe: Should move on to a shoulder of the road at a high speed
Should move onto a shoulder with a reduced speed
Should increase the following distance to 6 seconds
oz: 应以高速移动到路肩上
应该以较低的速度移到路肩上
q.why: “SOFT SHOULDER” 表示路肩松软 (soft shoulder)，除非紧急情况不要驶离铺装路面。
q.why_en: "SOFT SHOULDER" means the shoulder is soft; do not leave the pavement except in an emergency.

q.en: This black-lettered sign indicates:
q.zh: 这个黑字的标志表明。
oe: Vehicles must maintain a speed of less than 40 mph
Slow-moving vehicles must not exceed a speed of 40 mph
Vehicles must not exceed the posted speed limit of 40 mph
Vehicles must maintain a speed greater than 40 mph
oz: 车辆必须保持低于40英里/小时的速度
慢速行驶的车辆不得超过每小时40英里的速度
车辆不得超过规定的40英里/小时的速度限制
车辆必须保持高于40英里/小时的速度
q.why: 白底黑字“SPEED LIMIT 40”是法定限速，车辆不得超过 40 mph。
q.why_en: A black-on-white "SPEED LIMIT 40" sign is a legal speed limit; vehicles must not exceed 40 mph.

q.en: This sign warns the driver that it is a:
q.zh: 这个标志警告司机，这是一个。
q.why: 多次左右弯曲的箭头表示前方是连续弯道/蜿蜒道路 (winding road)。
q.why_en: An arrow with several back-and-forth bends means a winding road is ahead.

q.en: This sign marks a reserved parking space for
q.zh: 这个标志标志着一个保留的停车位，用于。
q.why: “RESERVED PARKING” 配轮椅标志是残疾人专用停车位 (handicapped parking)。
q.why_en: "RESERVED PARKING" with the wheelchair symbol marks a handicapped parking space.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志是什么意思？
oe: A side road ahead; watch for vehicles entering the roadway
A T-intersection ahead; yield to cross-traffic
A tourist information center ahead; stop if needed
A four-way intersection ahead; prepare to yield
oz: 前方支路，注意进入车辆
前方是T型交叉口，请让行
前方有一个旅游咨询中心；如有需要请停车
前方有一个十字路口，准备让路
q.why: T 字形图案表示前方是 T 型路口 (T-intersection)，道路到头，须让行横向车流后左转或右转。
q.why_en: A T-shaped symbol means a T-intersection is ahead: the road ends, and you must yield to cross-traffic before turning left or right.

q.en: This symbol warns of:
q.zh: 这个符号警告说。
oe: a side marker of rails of a narrow bridge
q.why: 黑黄条纹配双向箭头的标志放在 T 型路口 (T-intersection) 尽头，提示道路终止，只能左转或右转。
q.why_en: A black and yellow striped sign with a two-way arrow is placed at the end of a T-intersection, showing the road ends and you can only turn left or right.

q.en: This posted sign is:
q.zh: 这个张贴的标志是
q.why: 竖在路边的白色/反光小柱是夜间反光标 (reflector / delineator)，夜间帮助看清道路边缘。
q.why_en: A small white/reflective post beside the road is a reflector (delineator) that helps you see the road edge at night.

q.en: What does this hand sign represent?
q.zh: 这个手势代表什么？
oe: Do not take a right turn
q.why: 行人信号灯里的红色手掌表示“不要走 (Don't Walk)”，行人不得开始过马路。
q.why_en: A red raised hand on a pedestrian signal means "Don't Walk": pedestrians must not start crossing.

q.en: This sign indicates:
q.zh: 这个标志表明。
oe: The end of a divided high way
q.why: 主路旁一条线并入，表示前方有车流汇入 (merging traffic)，注意让行或调整车速。
q.why_en: A line joining the main road from the side means merging traffic ahead; be ready to yield or adjust your speed.

q.en: If you are approaching a stop sign accompanied by this sign, it means ____.
q.zh: 如果你正在接近一个伴有这个标志的停车标志，这意味着。
oe: There are four lanes of traffic
you must stop for four seconds
all four directions approaching the intersection must stop
oz: 所有接近十字路口的四个方向必须停车
q.why: STOP 牌下加“4-WAY”表示四向停车 (all-way stop)：四个方向的车都必须停车，先到先走。
q.why_en: A "4-WAY" plaque under a STOP sign means an all-way stop: traffic from all four directions must stop, and the first to arrive goes first.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志是什么意思？
q.why: 让行三角配向前箭头表示前方有让行标志 (yield ahead)，准备减速让行。
q.why_en: A yield triangle with an ahead arrow means a yield sign is ahead; prepare to slow down and yield.

q.en: What does this figure mean?
q.zh: 这个图形是什么意思？
oz: 前面有一个儿童看护中心
q.why: 按题库答案，此题考的是游乐场 (playground) 标志，提醒附近有儿童，应减速。
q.flag: 图片与选项不符：图中是行人过街 (pedestrian crossing) 标志，四个选项都不对；题库答案 A（游乐场）应对应另一张儿童玩球的图。
q.why_en: Per the answer key, this question is about the playground sign, warning that children are nearby; slow down.
q.flag_en: Image doesn't match the options: it shows a pedestrian crossing sign, so none of the four options fits. The key's answer A ("A playground ahead") belongs with a different image of a child playing with a ball.

q.en: This diamond-shaped sign means that:
q.zh: 这个菱形标志意味着。
oe: the road ahead has a dip
the road ahead has a bump
q.why: “BUMP” 表示前方路面有凸起 (bump)，应减速通过。
q.why_en: "BUMP" means the road ahead has a bump; slow down to cross it.

q.en: The arrow in this sign indicates that there is:
q.zh: 这个标志中的箭头表示有。
oe: A double curve ahead/the road ahead curves to the right and left/curves on the road
oz: 前方有S弯/前方道路向右和向左弯曲/道路上有弯路
q.why: 箭头先向一侧弯再向另一侧弯，表示前方有反向弯/S 弯 (reverse curve)。
q.why_en: An arrow that bends one way then the other means a reverse (double) curve is ahead.

q.en: The arrow-marked sign means:
q.zh: 箭头标记的标志意味着
oe: the main road curves to the left
q.why: 按题库答案为“主路向左弯”。
q.flag: 答案疑似有误：图中箭头一上一下、中央分隔带在下方，这是“分隔公路结束 (divided highway ends)”，前方变成双向车道。四个选项都不准确，A 不成立。
q.why_en: Per the answer key: "the main road curves to the left".
q.flag_en: Answer looks wrong: the arrows point one up and one down with the median at the bottom, which is "divided highway ends" (the road becomes two-way). None of the four options is accurate, and A doesn't hold.

q.en: What does this sign indicate?
q.zh: 这个标志表示什么？
oe: A steep hill/steep descent, drive with care
oz: 陡峭的山坡/陡峭的下坡，小心驾驶
q.why: 卡车在斜坡上的图案表示前方陡坡 (steep hill / downgrade)，下坡要低速档并控制车速。
q.why_en: A truck on a slope means a steep hill/downgrade ahead; use a lower gear and control your speed going down.

q.en: This sign means:
q.zh: 这个标志的意思
oe: Bicyclists should not use this lane
Bicyclists should move only in the lane where the sign is posted
oz: 骑自行车的人不应该使用这条车道
骑自行车的人应该只在贴有标志的车道上移动
自行车道与前方道路相交
q.why: 黄色菱形上的自行车表示前方有自行车道穿越道路 (bikeway crossing)，注意骑车人。
q.why_en: A bicycle on a yellow diamond means a bikeway crosses the roadway ahead; watch for cyclists.

q.en: What does the arrow mark sign mean?
q.zh: 箭头标记标志是什么意思
oe: Rest area open to the right
q.why: 按题库答案为急右转。
q.flag: 图片与答案不符：图中是双向大箭头 (two-direction large arrow)，表示道路到头须左转或右转（T 型路口），不是只向右急转；题库答案 B 应对应单向右大箭头图。
q.why_en: Per the answer key: make a sharp right turn.
q.flag_en: Image doesn't match the answer: it shows a two-direction large arrow, meaning the road ends and you must turn left or right (T-intersection), not a sharp right turn only. Key answer B belongs with the one-direction large right arrow image.

q.en: This sign indicates:
q.zh: 这个标志表明。
q.why: 直角折向右的箭头表示前方右急转弯 (sharp right turn)，须大幅减速。
q.tip: 直角 = 急转，圆弧 = 弯道
q.flag: 中文选项 D 缺失（英文为“a winding road”，蜿蜒道路）；答案 B 正确。
q.why_en: An arrow bent at a right angle to the right means a sharp right turn ahead; slow down considerably.
q.tip_en: Right angle = turn; smooth arc = curve
q.flag_en: Chinese option D is missing (English: "a winding road"); answer B is correct.

q.en: This sign warns motorists:
q.zh: 这个标志警告驾驶者
q.why: 牛的图案表示前方有牲畜穿越 (cattle crossing)。
q.why_en: A cow symbol means a cattle crossing is ahead.

q.en: What does this flashing arrow panel mean?
q.zh: 这个闪烁的箭头面板是什么意思
oe: The lane ahead is open to traffic
The left lane is winding ahead
oz: 前面的车道是可以通行的
q.why: 施工区闪烁箭头板 (flashing arrow panel) 指示前方车道封闭 (lane closed)，应及早并入箭头所指车道。
q.why_en: A flashing arrow panel in a work zone means the lane ahead is closed; merge early into the lane the arrow points to.

q.en: This sign may be used to:
q.zh: 这个标志可用于
oe: Warn drivers of a one-way ahead
Inform drivers to make a U-turn
Guide drivers into certain traffic lanes
Inform drivers of a school zone
oz: 警告司机前方有单行线
引导司机进入某些交通车道
告知司机学校区域的情况
q.why: 箭头板 (arrow panel) 用来引导司机并入/进入指定车道 (guide into lanes)。
q.why_en: Arrow panels are used to guide drivers into certain traffic lanes.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志是什么意思
oe: The driver is going to make a left turn
The driver is going to make a U-turn
The driver is going to slow down or stop
The driver is going to make a right turn
q.why: 手臂向下伸出是手势信号“减速或停车 (slow down/stop)”。左转是手臂平伸，右转是手臂向上弯。
q.why_en: An arm extended downward is the hand signal for slow down or stop. Left turn is the arm straight out; right turn is the arm bent upward.
q.tip_en: Out = left, up = right, down = stop

q.en: This sign indicates a:
q.zh: 这个标志表示一个
q.why: 蓝底白色轮椅图案是残疾人停车区/设施标志 (handicap parking)。
q.why_en: A white wheelchair symbol on blue marks a handicap parking zone/facility.

q.en: The service sign shows the location of:
q.zh: 这个服务标志表示
q.why: 蓝色服务标志 (service sign) 上的油泵表示附近有加油站 (gas station)。
q.why_en: A gas pump on a blue service sign means a gas station is nearby.

q.en: This guide sign indicates:
q.zh: 该服务标志显示的位置是
q.why: 蓝底白色“H”表示医院 (hospital)。
q.why_en: A white "H" on blue means hospital.

q.en: This blue sign represents the availability of:
q.zh: 这个蓝色的标志代表着可以使用。
q.why: 刀叉图案表示前方有餐饮 (food)。
q.why_en: A knife and fork symbol means food is available ahead.

q.en: This service sign indicates:
q.zh: 这个服务标志表明
q.why: 床的图案表示前方有住宿 (lodging)。
q.why_en: A bed symbol means lodging (accommodation) is available ahead.

q.en: The shield shape is a/an:
q.zh: 盾牌的形状是
oe: speed limit sign on an interstate highway
oz: 州际公路上的限速标志
q.why: 盾形 (shield) 标志是路线号标志 (route marker)，例如州际公路和美国国道都用盾形。
q.flag: 图片与题目不符：图中是蓝色休息区/野餐区服务标志，并非盾形；按题干，答案 B 仍正确。
q.why_en: The shield shape is a route marker sign; Interstate and US routes both use shields.
q.flag_en: Image doesn't match the question: it shows a blue rest area/picnic area service sign, not a shield. Going by the stem, answer B is still correct.

q.en: This white lettered sign is:
q.zh: 这个白色字体的标志是。
q.why: 蓝底白字是服务标志 (service sign)，如“REST AREA 1 MILE”表示 1 英里外有休息区。
q.why_en: White lettering on blue is a service sign; e.g. "REST AREA 1 MILE" means a rest area is 1 mile ahead.

q.en: This sign is a
oz: 高速公路交汇处的标志
q.why: 绿色引导牌显示高速公路分岔/交汇处各方向的路线和目的地，属于高速公路交汇处标志 (freeway interchange sign)。
q.flag: 中文题干缺失（英文为“This sign is a”）；图中为绿色高速公路交汇处指路牌，答案 D 正确。
q.why_en: A green guide sign showing routes and destinations for each direction where freeways split or join is a freeway interchange sign.
q.flag_en: The Chinese stem is missing (English: "This sign is a"); the image is a green freeway interchange guide sign, and answer D is correct.

q.en: The number seen in this sign represents:
q.zh: 在这个标志中看到的数字代表。
oe: number of miles to the exit
the speed limit in the exit
q.why: 绿色出口牌上的数字是出口编号 (exit number)，不是里程或限速。
q.why_en: The number on a green exit sign is the exit number, not a distance or speed limit.

q.en: This guide sign indicates to the driver that:
q.zh: 这个引导标志向司机表明
oe: He/she must take this exit to enter highway 117
The next exit is 117 miles away
oz: 他/她必须从这个出口进入117号公路
q.why: 牌上“117 EXIT”表示前方是 117 号出口 (exit 117)。
q.why_en: "117 EXIT" on the sign means exit number 117 is ahead.

q.en: What does this green arrow sign indicate to a driver?
q.zh: 这个绿色箭头标志对司机来说表示什么？
oe: Turn in the direction of the arrow
Do not make a left turn
q.why: 绿色箭头信号表示可以按箭头方向转弯 (protected turn)，对向车辆此时是停的。
q.why_en: A green arrow signal means you may turn in the direction of the arrow (protected turn); oncoming traffic is stopped.

q.en: These signs located on freeways are called ____.
q.zh: 这些位于高速公路上的标志被称为。
q.why: 高速公路上可以显示实时文字的电子牌叫动态信息标志 (dynamic message signs)，用于发布事故、施工、天气等信息。
q.flag: 图片与题目不符：图中是铁路道口交叉牌和信号灯；按题干，答案 B 仍正确。
q.why_en: Electronic signs on freeways that display real-time text are called dynamic message signs, used for crash, construction and weather information.
q.flag_en: Image doesn't match the question: it shows a railroad crossbuck and signal lights. Going by the stem, answer B is still correct.

q.en: You are travelling along the right lane of a four lane highway. You see an emergency vehicle pulled over with its lights flashing ahead. Which of the following are true?
q.zh: 你正沿着一条四车道高速公路的右车道行驶。你看到一辆紧急车辆停在路边，其灯光在前方闪烁。以下哪项是真的？
oe: You should leave an empty lane between your car and the emergency vehicle but you don’t have to slow down
You can proceed as normal, but drive with care
You are required to leave an empty lane between yourself and the emergency vehicle only when the speed limit exceeds 40 mph
You are required to slow down and leave an empty lane between your car and the emergency vehicle if it is safe
oz: 你应该在你的车和紧急车辆之间留出一条空车道，但你不必减慢速度
你可以照常行驶，但要小心驾驶
只有当速度限制超过40英里/小时时，你才需要在自己和紧急车辆之间留下一条空车道
在安全的情况下，你需要减速并在你的车和紧急车辆之间留出一条空车道
q.why: 新泽西州让道法 (Move Over law)：经过闪灯停在路边的紧急车辆、拖车等时，若安全应换到不相邻车道；无法换道时必须减速到低于限速并准备停车。
q.tip: Move Over：能让道就让，不能就减速
q.why_en: New Jersey's Move Over law: when passing a stopped emergency vehicle, tow truck, etc. with flashing lights, move to a non-adjacent lane if safe; if you can't change lanes, you must slow down below the speed limit and be prepared to stop.
q.tip_en: Move Over: change lanes if you can; otherwise slow down

q.en: Is this car legally parked?
q.zh: 这辆车是合法停放的吗？
oe: Yes, so long as it is moved within 10 minutes
No, you cannot park within 30ft of a fire hydrant
No, you cannot park within 10ft of a fire hydrant
oz: 是的，只要它在10分钟内被移走
不，你不能在消火栓的30英尺范围内停车
不，你不能在消防栓的10英尺内停车
q.why: 新泽西州规定不得在消防栓 (fire hydrant) 10 英尺范围内停车，图中车辆停得太近，属违法停车。
q.why_en: New Jersey prohibits parking within 10 feet of a fire hydrant; the car shown is too close, so it is illegally parked.

q.en: Two cars are turning onto a divided highway. Which car is turning correctly?
q.zh: 两辆汽车正在转入一条分车道公路。哪辆车的转向是正确的？
q.why: 转入分隔公路时，应先越过第一条车道，进入中央分隔带缺口，再转入远侧道路的最近车道。图中 A 车的路线正确。
q.flag: 选项文字错位：车辆字母被挤到英文末尾，中文 B、C 只剩“车”。B = B 车，C = A 车；答案 C（A 车）正确。
q.why_en: When turning onto a divided highway, cross the first roadway, enter the median opening, then turn into the nearest lane of the far roadway. Car A's path is correct.
q.flag_en: Option text is misaligned: the car letters were pushed to the end of the English text, and Chinese B and C read only "车". B = Car B, C = Car A; answer C (Car A) is correct.

q.en: You spot an emergency vehicle approach with its flashing lights switched on. What should you do?
q.zh: 你发现一辆紧急车辆驶来，并打开了闪光灯。你应该怎么做？
oe: Pull over and stop; it doesn’t matter which direction the emergency vehicle is travelling
Maintain speed and direction; changing lanes or stopping is unpredictable and could be dangerous
Pull over and stop, but only if the emergency vehicle is coming from the opposite direction
Pull over and stop, but only if the emergency vehicle is travelling in the same direction as you
oz: 靠边停车；不管紧急车辆在哪个方向行驶，都要靠边停车
保持速度和方向；改变车道或停止是不可预知的，可能会有危险
靠边停车，但只有在紧急车辆从相反方向驶来时才可停车
靠边停车，但只有在紧急车辆与你同向行驶的情况下才可以。
q.why: 听到警笛或看到闪灯的紧急车辆驶来，应靠右边停车让行 (pull over and stop)，直到其通过，不管它从哪个方向来；但不要停在路口内。
q.why_en: When an emergency vehicle approaches with a siren or flashing lights, pull over to the right and stop until it passes, regardless of which direction it is coming from - but don't stop in an intersection.

q.en: Two cars have parked outside of a fire station. Which of the following is most true?
q.zh: 有两辆汽车停在了一个消防站的外面。以下哪项是最正确的？
oe: Car A cannot park across the driveway  A
Car A must remain at least 20ft from the driveway
Car A must remain at least 75ft from the driveway, and Car B must remain at least 20ft from the driveway
Car A must remain at least 20ft from the driveway, and Car B must remain at least 75ft from the driveway
oz: 轿车A必须与车道保持至少20英尺的距离
轿车A必须离车道至少75英尺，而轿车B必须离车道至少20英尺
A车必须保持离车道至少20英尺，B车必须保持离车道至少75英尺
q.why: 新泽西州规定：同侧不得在消防站车道 (fire station driveway) 20 英尺内停车，对面一侧不得在 75 英尺内停车。A 车在同侧，B 车在对面。
q.flag: 选项 A 文字错位：字母“A”被挤到英文末尾，中文只剩“车不能停在车道对面”，应为“A 车不能横停在车道口”。答案 D 不受影响。
q.why_en: New Jersey rules: do not park within 20 feet of a fire station driveway on the same side of the street, or within 75 feet on the opposite side. Car A is on the same side; Car B is across the street.
q.flag_en: Option A is misaligned: the letter "A" was pushed to the end of the English text, and the Chinese reads only "车不能停在车道对面"; it should be "Car A cannot park across the driveway". Answer D is unaffected.

q.en: You are driving along a four lane highway and you see a school bus parked with its red signals flashing on the other side of the highway. Are you required to stop?
q.zh: 你在一条四车道的公路上行驶，你看到一辆校车停在公路的另一侧，红色信号灯闪烁着。你是否需要停车？
oe: Yes you must stop, but you can then proceed when you deem it to be safe
No, but you are required to slow down to 10 mph as you pass
Yes, you must stop until the bus has started moving again
No, you can proceed as normal on this road
oz: 是的，你必须停下来，但你可以在你认为安全的时候继续前进
没有，但你在通过时需要减慢到10英里/小时
是的，你必须停下来，直到公交车重新开始行驶
不，你可以在这条路上正常行驶
q.why: 在有中央分隔带/安全岛的分隔公路上，对向停靠闪红灯的校车，你不用停车，但须减速到 10 mph 以下通过。同侧或无分隔的道路则必须在 25 英尺外停车。
q.why_en: On a divided highway with a median/safety island, you don't have to stop for a school bus with flashing red lights on the opposite side, but you must slow to 10 mph as you pass. On the same side, or on a road without a divider, you must stop at least 25 feet away.

q.en: 296.Which vehicle is least likely to be visible to the truck driver?
q.zh: 哪辆车最不可能被卡车司机看到？
oe: None of the cars would be visible to the truck driver
q.why: 大货车侧面，尤其是右侧，有很大盲区 (No Zone)。图中 B 车紧贴挂车侧面，最难被卡车司机看到。
q.tip: No Zone：看不到司机的镜子，司机就看不到你
q.flag: 选项文字错乱：英文 A 合并了“Car A / Car C”，B 为空；中文 A、B、D 均缺失。答案 D（B 车）本身合理。
q.why_en: Large trucks have big blind spots (No Zones) along their sides, especially the right side. Car B, right alongside the trailer, is least likely to be seen by the truck driver.
q.tip_en: No Zone: if you can't see the driver in the mirror, the driver can't see you
q.flag_en: Option text is garbled: English A merges "Car A / Car C" and B is blank; Chinese A, B and D are all missing. Answer D ("Car B") itself is reasonable.

q.en: You are turning left into a driveway. What must you do before you proceed?
q.zh: 你要左转进入一条车道。在你前进之前，你必须做什么？
oe: You have right of way; proceed with caution
q.why: 左转进入车道 (driveway) 时，必须让行对向直行车辆，以及在人行道上通过的行人 (yield to pedestrians and traffic)。
q.why_en: When turning left into a driveway, you must yield to oncoming traffic and to pedestrians on the sidewalk ("Yield to pedestrians and traffic").
q.tip_en: Left turn: yield to both cars and people

q.en: Three cars arrive at a four-way STOP, one car after the next. Which car can go first?
q.zh: 三辆车到达一个十字路口的STOP，一辆接一辆。哪辆车可以先走？
oe: Car B, as it was first to arrive at the intersection  B
Car C, as it is to the right of Car A and Car B  C
Car A, as it is to the left of Car B
Car B, as it is to the right of Car A
oz: 车，因为它是第一个到达十字路口的人
车，因为它在A车和B车的右边
q.why: 四向停车路口 (4-way stop) 先到先走；B 车最先到达，所以先走。只有同时到达时才让右侧车先走。
q.flag: 选项 A、B 文字错位：车号字母被挤到英文末尾，中文缺少车号。A = B 车（最先到达），B = C 车；答案 A 正确。
q.why_en: At a 4-way stop, first to arrive goes first; Car B arrived first, so it goes first. Yield to the car on the right only when vehicles arrive at the same time.
q.tip_en: First come, first go; tie goes to the right
q.flag_en: Options A and B are misaligned: the car letters were pushed to the end of the English text, and the Chinese lacks the car letters. A = Car B (first to arrive), B = Car C; answer A is correct.

q.en: You are following another vehicle, but you might be a little too close. Which of the following is true about tailgating?
q.zh: 你在跟随另一辆车，但你可能有点太近了。关于尾随者，以下哪项是真的？
oe: A good rule of thumb is to stay two seconds behind under 30 mph and three seconds behind over 30 mph
You should follow close enough to make eye contact through the rear vision mirror
A good rule of thumb is to stay at least three seconds behind when conditions are good
You should remain at least 30ft behind any other vehicle when conditions are good
oz: 一个好的经验法则是在低于30英里/小时的情况下落后两秒，超过30英里/小时的情况下落后三秒。
你应该跟得足够近，以便通过后视镜进行眼神交流
一个好的经验法则是在条件好的时候，至少要保持三秒钟的落后。
在条件好的情况下，你应该保持在任何其他车辆后面至少30英尺处
q.why: 新泽西州驾驶手册建议，条件良好时至少保持 3 秒跟车距离 (3-second rule)；天气差、车速高时要更长。
q.why_en: The NJ Driver Manual recommends following at least 3 seconds behind in good conditions (3-second rule); allow more in bad weather or at higher speeds.

q.en: You are turning at an intersection on a red light. At the same time, a pedestrian is entering the road to cross. What should you do?
q.zh: 你在红灯时在一个十字路口转弯。与此同时，一个行人正在进入马路准备过马路。你应该怎么做？
oe: Speed up and pass the pedestrian
Turn into the far lane to avoid the pedestrian
Stop and let the pedestrian cross
Use your horn to alert the pedestrian to your presence
oz: 转入远处的车道以避开行人
用你的喇叭提醒行人注意你的存在
q.why: 红灯时转弯 (turn on red) 要先完全停车，并让行正在过马路的行人。不能按喇叭催或绕开行人。
q.why_en: When turning on red, first come to a complete stop and yield to pedestrians crossing. Don't honk to hurry them or swerve around them.
q.tip_en: Turn on red: stop first, then yield to pedestrians

q.en: Three cars arrive at an intersection at the same time. Who here has the right of way?
q.zh: 三辆车同时到达一个十字路口。这里谁有路权？
oe: Car BB. Car CC. The pedestrian
q.why: 按题库答案，图中 A 车有路权 (right of way)，其他车按图中路线须让行。
q.flag: 选项文字错乱（A 合并了“Car B / Car C / 行人”，B、C 为空）；图片太小，难以核实。
q.why_en: Per the answer key, Car A has the right of way; the other vehicles must yield based on their paths in the image.
q.flag_en: Option text is garbled (A merges "Car B / Car C / The pedestrian"; B and C are blank); the image is too small to verify.

q.en: What does this traffic sign mean?
q.zh: 这个交通标志是什么意思？
oe: You must stop before going straight
Only passenger vehicles are allowed to go straight
You are not allowed to go straight
oz: 你必须在直行前停下来
q.why: 绿色直行箭头信号表示可以直行 (go straight)，同时须让行仍在路口内的车辆和行人。
q.why_en: A green straight-ahead arrow signal means you may go straight, while still yielding to vehicles and pedestrians already in the intersection.

q.en: You arrive at a crossroad with a green traffic signal. You wish to drive straight through the intersection. Which of the following is true?
q.zh: 你来到一个十字路口，有一个绿色的交通信号。你希望直接驶过该交叉路口。以下哪项是真的？
oe: You are free to proceed, so long as you yield to any traffic already in the intersection
You must briefly come to a stop, yield, and then you can proceed
oz: 你可以自由地前进，只要你让开已经在十字路口的任何车辆。
你必须短暂地停下来，让步，然后你可以继续前进
q.why: 绿灯可以通行，但仍须让行已经在路口内的车辆和行人 (yield to traffic already in the intersection)，不需要先停。
q.why_en: A green light means you may proceed, but you must still yield to traffic already in the intersection; you don't need to stop first.
q.tip_en: Green light ≠ absolute right of way

q.en: If a NJ driver is convicted of a DUI charge, his or her license may be lost for up to
q.zh: 如果新泽西州的司机被判定犯有酒后驾车罪，他或她的驾照可能会被吊销，最高可达。
q.why: 题库按新泽西州较早的酒驾 (DUI/DWI) 处罚：初犯最高可吊销驾照 1 年（再犯 2 年，三犯 10 年）。2019 年后的新法改以安装点火联锁装置 (ignition interlock) 为主，但考试题库仍按 1 年。
q.tip: 初犯 1 年，再犯 2 年，三犯 10 年
q.why_en: The question bank uses New Jersey's older DUI/DWI penalties: a first offense can mean license loss for up to 1 year (2 years for a second, 10 years for a third). Since the 2019 law change, penalties center on an ignition interlock device, but the test bank still uses 1 year.

q.en: If you are one of the first persons to come upon the scene of a collision, the first thing you should do is
q.zh: 如果你是第一个到达碰撞现场的人之一，你应该做的第一件事就是。
oe: Turn off the ignition of vehicles involved in the crash
Ask others who have stopped to warn the approaching traffic
oz: 关闭肇事车辆的点火装置
请其他已经停下来的人警告即将到来的车辆
q.why: 先到碰撞现场时，应先关闭事故车辆的点火开关 (turn off ignition) 以降低起火风险；除非有起火等危险，不要随意移动伤者 (move injured persons)。
q.why_en: If you are first on the scene of a crash, first turn off the ignition of the vehicles involved to reduce fire risk; don't move injured persons unless there is a danger such as fire.
q.tip_en: Ignition off first; don't move the injured

q.en: When turning a vehicle around, a motorist should start from the right edge of road and follow to make a turn during MVC’s road test.
q.zh: 在MVC的道路测试中，当车辆掉头时，驾驶者应从道路的右侧边缘开始，并按照进行转向。
oz: 型转弯法 The T-turn method  T型转弯法
q.why: NJ 路考要求用 K 型转弯 (K-turn，即三点掉头)：从道路右侧边缘开始，左转到对面路边、倒车、再前进完成掉头。
q.tip: K 字三笔 = 前-倒-前三步
q.flag: 选项文字错位：C 混入了 “T-turn method”，D 为空；正确答案应为 K-turn（C）。
q.why_en: The NJ road test requires a K-turn (three-point turn): start from the right edge of the road, turn left across to the opposite curb, back up, then pull forward to complete the turnaround.
q.tip_en: K has three strokes = forward, back, forward
q.flag_en: Option text misaligned: "The T-turn method" is merged into C and D is empty; the correct answer is "The K-turn method" (C).

q.en: When changing lanes, look over your shoulder in the direction you plan to move to make sure there are no other vehicles in
q.zh: 当改变车道时，在你计划移动的方向上看你的肩膀，以确保没有其他车辆在。
q.why: 变道前要回头看你要并入方向的盲点 (blind spots)，后视镜照不到那里。
q.tip: 镜子看不到 → 回头看
q.why_en: Before changing lanes, look over your shoulder toward the lane you're moving into to check your blind spots, which your mirrors can't see.
q.tip_en: Mirror can't see it → turn your head

q.en: When is it legal to pass another vehicle, using the shoulder of a road?
q.zh: 在什么情况下，利用路肩超过另一辆车是合法的？
oe: When the vehicle in front of you is making a left turn
When the vehicle in front of you is stopped for an emergency
You are not legally allowed to pass using the shoulder of a road
When the vehicle in front of you is making a right turn
oz: 当你前面的车辆正在进行左转时
当你前面的车辆因紧急情况而停车时
法律上不允许你使用路肩通过
当你前面的车辆正在进行右转时
q.why: NJ 法律不允许利用路肩 (shoulder) 超车，路肩只供紧急停车用；即使前车左转，也只能在路面内从右侧超车。
q.why_en: NJ law does not allow passing on the shoulder; it is for emergency stops only. Even when the vehicle ahead is turning left, you may pass on the right only while staying on the pavement.

q.en: Passing is not allowed on either side of a highway when ____.
q.zh: 在下列情况下，不允许在公路的任何一侧通行 ____。
oe: both sides have broken yellow line markings
both sides have solid yellow line markings
one side has a broken yellow line marking
oz: 两侧都有实心黄线标记
q.why: 两侧都是黄色实线 (double solid yellow) 时，双向都禁止越线超车。虚线一侧才允许超车。
q.why_en: When both sides have solid yellow lines (double solid yellow), passing is prohibited in both directions. Passing is allowed only from the side with a broken line.

q.en: Which of the following statements is NOT true regarding the use of headlights?
q.zh: 关于大灯的使用，以下哪项说法不正确？
oe: Low-beams are used in city driving and driving in traffic on roadways
High-beams are used for open country driving when there is no traffic in sight
High-beams are used when traveling behind other vehicles
Low-beams are used when traveling in fog, rain or snow
oz: 近光灯用于城市驾驶和道路交通驾驶
远光灯用于在没有车辆的情况下，在开阔的乡村驾驶。
在其他车辆后面行驶时，要使用远光灯
在雾、雨或雪中行驶时使用近光灯
q.why: 跟在其他车后面时必须用近光灯，远光会晃到前车司机。NJ 规定跟车 200 英尺内、对向来车 500 英尺内都要切换近光。
q.why_en: You must use low beams when following another vehicle; high beams will dazzle the driver ahead. NJ requires dimming to low beams within 200 feet of a vehicle you're following and within 500 feet of an oncoming vehicle.

q.en: Motorists should never turn the vehicle ignition to the lock position while the vehicle is in motion, because the action ____.
q.zh: 在车辆行驶过程中，驾驶者千万不要将车辆点火装置转到锁止位置，因为这个动作。
q.why: 行驶中把点火开关转到锁止 (lock) 位置会锁住方向盘，导致无法转向。
q.why_en: Turning the ignition to the lock position while moving locks the steering wheel, so you can't steer.

q.en: When driving at night in a heavy fog, you must use:
q.zh: 晚上在大雾中驾驶时，必须使用。
q.why: 雾天夜间要用近光灯 (low beams)；远光会被雾反射，反而看不清。
q.why_en: Use low-beam headlights at night in fog; high beams reflect off the fog and make it harder to see.

q.en: Motorists entering a highway from the entrance ramp must yield the right-of-way to
q.zh: 从入口匝道进入高速公路的驾驶者必须将路权让给
oe: Other motorists on the entrance ramp
No need to yield the right-of-way
oz: 入口匝道上的其他驾驶者
高速公路上迎面而来的车辆
q.why: 从入口匝道并入高速时，必须让行高速公路上已在行驶的车流（主路车辆有路权）。
q.why_en: When merging onto a highway from an entrance ramp, you must yield to traffic already on the highway (mainline traffic has the right-of-way).

q.en: While operating a motor vehicle on a public road or highway, state law prohibits the use of hand-held cell phones for:
q.zh: 在公共道路或公路上驾驶机动车时，州法律禁止在以下情况下使用手持手机：
q.why: NJ 法律禁止驾驶时使用手持手机，打电话、发短信、读短信都不行；只能用免提 (hands-free)。
q.flag: 中文选项缺失（仅英文有内容）。
q.why_en: NJ law prohibits using a hand-held cell phone while driving: no calling, sending texts or reading texts. Only hands-free use is allowed.
q.flag_en: Chinese options are missing (only the English has content).

q.en: In normal driving, a driver should place his/her hands on the steering wheel at the
q.zh: 在正常驾驶中，驾驶员应将双手放在方向盘上，在
oz: 点钟和2点钟位置 9 and 3 o’clock positions  9点钟和3点钟位置
q.why: NJ 手册建议正常驾驶时双手放在方向盘 9 点和 3 点位置（也可 8 点和 4 点）。
q.flag: 选项文字错位：“9 and 3 o’clock” 被并入 C，D 为空；正确答案为 9 点和 3 点（键入的 D 对应此项）。
q.why_en: The NJ manual recommends placing your hands at the 9 and 3 o'clock positions for normal driving (8 and 4 o'clock is also acceptable).
q.flag_en: Option text misaligned: "9 and 3 o'clock" is merged into C and D is empty; the correct answer is 9 and 3 o'clock (the keyed D corresponds to it).

q.en: “No-Zone” refers to:  "
q.zh: 盲区 "指的是
q.why: “No-Zone” 指卡车、公交车等大型车辆周围的盲区，小车在里面司机看不到你。
q.why_en: The "No-Zone" is the blind-spot area around large vehicles such as trucks and buses, where the driver can't see you.

q.en: The stopping distance for a moving vehicle is calculated by adding ____.
q.zh: 移动中的车辆的停车距离应该考虑什么来计算。
oe: The perception distance and braking distance
The braking distance and reaction distance
The braking distance, perception distance and reaction distance
The reaction distance and perception distance
oz: 刹车距离、感知距离和反应距离
q.why: 总停车距离 = 感知距离 (perception) + 反应距离 (reaction) + 制动距离 (braking)，三者相加。
q.why_en: Total stopping distance = perception distance + reaction distance + braking distance, all three added together.

q.en: The danger areas around trucks and buses where crashes are more likely to occur are called ____.
q.zh: 卡车和公共汽车周围比较容易发生车祸的危险区域被称为。
q.why: 卡车和巴士周围容易出事的危险区域是盲点 (blind spots)，也叫 No-Zone。
q.why_en: The danger areas around trucks and buses where crashes are likely are their blind spots, also called the No-Zone.

q.en: To avoid a collision, a driver must maintain at least following distance for each 10 mph of speed.
q.zh: 为了避免碰撞，司机必须在每10英里/小时的速度下保持至少的跟随距离。
q.why: NJ 手册：每 10 mph 车速至少保持一个车身长度的跟车距离（另可用 3 秒法则）。
q.why_en: NJ manual: keep at least one car length of following distance for each 10 mph of speed (or use the three-second rule).

q.en: If your vehicle’s wheels drift onto the shoulder of the road, you must ____.
q.zh: 如果你的车辆的车轮漂移到路肩上，你必须。
oe: Not try to turn back onto the pavement right away
Try to turn back onto the pavement right away
Push hard on the gas pedal
oz: 不试图马上转回硬路面上
试着马上转回人行道上
q.why: 车轮偏到路肩时不要急打方向盘回路面，应松油门减速、握稳方向盘，确认安全后再平稳驶回，否则易失控或翻车。
q.why_en: If your wheels drift onto the shoulder, don't jerk the wheel back onto the pavement. Ease off the gas, hold the steering wheel firmly, and steer back smoothly once it's safe; otherwise you may lose control or roll over.
q.tip_en: Slow down first, then steer back

q.en: If you wish to exit a freeway or expressway, you must use to reduce your speed.
q.zh: 如果你想离开高速公路或快速路，你必须使用什么以降低你的速度。
q.why: 离开高速时应进入减速车道 (deceleration lane) 后再减速，不要在主车道上减速。加速车道是入口用的。
q.tip: 出口减速道，入口加速道
q.why_en: To exit a freeway, move into the deceleration lane before slowing down; don't slow down in the main travel lanes. The acceleration lane is for entering.
q.tip_en: Exit = deceleration lane, entry = acceleration lane

q.en: If a vehicle is approaching with high-beams, a motorist should look until the vehicle passes.
q.zh: 如果有车辆开着远光灯驶来，驾驶人应该看一看什么，直到车辆通过。
oe: To the right of the road
To the left of the road
At the headlights of the oncoming vehicle
oz: 在迎面而来的车辆的大灯下
q.why: 对向车开远光时，眼睛看向道路右侧边缘 (right edge) 直到它通过，避免被晃眼。
q.why_en: When an oncoming vehicle has its high beams on, look toward the right edge of the road until it passes to avoid being blinded.
q.tip_en: Look at the right edge line

q.en: Which of the following is not legally allowed when using turnpikes?
q.zh: 在使用收费高速时，以下哪项是法律上不允许的？
oe: Speed up to the flow of traffic when leaving the acceleration lane
Yield right-of-way to an emergency vehicle when driving on the left lane
Come to a complete stop on the acceleration lane when your tire blows out
Yield to traffic and enter the right-hand lane when safe
oz: 在离开加速车道时，要加快跟上车流的步伐
在左侧车道上行驶时，应向紧急车辆让出路权
当你的轮胎爆裂时，要在加速车道上完全停下来
礼让车辆，安全时进入右侧车道
q.why: 加速车道是用来提速并入的，不能在上面完全停车；爆胎应尽量驶到路肩或安全区域再停。
q.why_en: The acceleration lane is for building speed to merge; you must not come to a complete stop there. If a tire blows out, get to the shoulder or another safe area before stopping.

q.en: When a school bus stops on a two-lane road with its red lights flashing, all motorists traveling behind or approaching it must ____.
q.zh: 当一辆校车停在双车道的道路上并闪烁着红灯时，所有在其后面行驶或接近的驾驶者都必须。
oe: Stop their vehicles at least 15 feet away
Slow down and proceed with caution
Stop their vehicles at least 25 feet away
Change lanes and proceed with caution
oz: 将其车辆停在至少15英尺以外
将其车辆停在至少25英尺以外
q.why: NJ 法律：校车停下闪红灯时，后方和接近的车辆必须在至少 25 英尺外停车。
q.why_en: NJ law: when a school bus is stopped with red lights flashing, vehicles behind or approaching it must stop at least 25 feet away.

q.en: Which of the following are three types of intersections on the road?
q.zh: 以下哪种是道路上的三种类型的交叉口？
oz: 受控的、非受控的和不易看清的道路交叉口
受控的、非受控的和立交
不易看清的道路交叉口、受控和菱形
q.why: NJ 手册把路口分为三类：受控 (controlled)、非受控 (uncontrolled) 和视线受阻 (blind) 路口。菱形、苜蓿叶是立交类型，不是这里的分类。
q.why_en: The NJ manual divides intersections into three types: controlled, uncontrolled and blind. Diamond and cloverleaf are interchange types, not this classification.

q.en: When driving through curves, motorists must use the technique to retain grip on the steering wheel.
q.zh: 当开车通过弯道时，驾驶者必须使用该技术来保持对方向盘的抓握。
q.why: 转弯时应使用交叉手 (hand-over-hand) 转向，可保持对方向盘的控制。
q.why_en: Use hand-over-hand steering through curves to keep control of the steering wheel.

q.en: When making a left turn at a controlled intersection, a motorist must yield to
q.zh: 在受控制的十字路口左转时，驾驶人必须让位于
q.why: 左转时必须让行对向直行来车 (oncoming traffic) 和行人。
q.why_en: When turning left, you must yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.
q.tip_en: Left turn yields to through traffic

q.en: Motorists must avoid highway hypnosis by:
q.zh: 驾车者必须通过以下方式避免高速公路犯困
oe: Not looking at anyone or anything for more than a few seconds
Talking on the cell phone frequently
oz: 不看任何人或事物超过几秒钟的时间
q.why: 避免高速催眠 (highway hypnosis) 的方法是保持眼睛移动扫视，不要长时间盯着一处；也要适时休息。服用兴奋剂、频繁变道都不对。
q.why_en: To avoid highway hypnosis, keep your eyes moving and don't stare at any one thing for long; also take breaks as needed. Taking stimulants or changing lanes frequently is wrong.

q.en: The ‘do-not-enter’ sign is indicated by:
q.zh: 勿入标志的表示方法是：。
q.why: 禁止驶入 (Do Not Enter) 标志是红色圆形图案（白色方牌上红圈加白横杠）。
q.why_en: The Do Not Enter sign is a red round shape (a red circle with a white horizontal bar on a white square sign).

q.en: If you cannot drive your vehicle due to excessive alcohol, you must ____.
q.zh: 如果你因酒精过量而不能驾驶你的车辆，你必须 ____。
oe: Use drugs to reduce the effect of alcohol before driving
Use coffee to keep you awake while driving
Have a designated driver drive your vehicle
Call 911 to help you to drive
oz: 驾驶前使用药物来减少酒精的影响
开车时用咖啡来保持清醒
让指定的司机驾驶你的车辆
q.why: 喝多了就不能开车，应让指定司机 (designated driver) 开；咖啡、药物都不能让你醒酒，只有时间可以。
q.why_en: If you've had too much to drink, don't drive; have a designated driver drive. Coffee or drugs won't sober you up; only time will.

q.en: If your rear wheels start to skid, you must:
q.zh: 如果你的后轮开始打滑，你必须
oe: Turn the steering wheel in the direction of the skid
Turn the steering wheel toward the right
Turn the steering wheel toward the left
Turn the steering wheel in the opposite direction of the skid
oz: 将方向盘转向打滑方向
将方向盘转到打滑的相反方向
q.why: 后轮打滑时，方向盘朝打滑方向（车尾滑向的方向）转，以把车摆正。
q.why_en: If your rear wheels skid, turn the steering wheel in the direction of the skid (the direction the rear is sliding) to straighten the car.

q.en: At an intersection where there is no stop sign or traffic signal, drivers should yield to
q.zh: 在没有停车标志或交通信号的十字路口，司机应该让行。
q.why: 无标志、无信号灯的路口，同时到达时要让行右侧来车。
q.why_en: At an intersection with no signs or signals, when vehicles arrive at the same time, yield to vehicles coming from the right.

q.en: Because of their size trucks/buses often need to move to make right turns.
q.zh: 由于其尺寸，卡车/公共汽车经常需要移动以进行右转。
q.why: 大卡车/巴士因车身长，右转时常需先向左侧车道摆出，所以不要从它右侧插入。
q.why_en: Because they are long, trucks and buses often swing into the left lane before making a right turn, so don't squeeze in on their right.
q.tip_en: Big vehicles swing left to turn right

q.en: The most important vehicle control device to use during a skid is
q.zh: 在打滑过程中，最重要的车辆控制装置是。
q.why: 打滑时最重要的是方向盘：朝打滑方向修正。急踩刹车或油门会加重打滑。
q.why_en: During a skid, the steering wheel matters most: steer in the direction of the skid to correct it. Slamming the brakes or gas makes the skid worse.

q.en: When a traffic signal turns green at an intersection and you are going straight through, you must ____.
q.zh: 当十字路口的交通信号灯变成绿色，而你要直行通过时，你必须。
oe: Drive your vehicle as quickly as possible through the intersection
Stop and wait for the next signal
Make sure there are no more vehicles coming through or still in the intersection
oz: 尽可能快地驾驶你的车辆通过十字路口
停止并等待下一个信号
确保没有更多的车辆通过或仍在十字路口内
q.why: 绿灯亮了也要先确认路口内没有仍在通过或闯红灯的车辆，再直行。
q.why_en: Even on a green light, first make sure no vehicles are still in or running through the intersection before going straight.

q.en: If there are three or more lanes going in one direction, the left lane is used by drivers who want to
q.zh: 如果有三条或更多的车道向一个方向行驶，左边的车道就会被想要干什么的司机使用。
oe: Go slower or enter the road
q.why: 三条及以上同向车道时，左侧车道给车速较快或准备左转的车用。
q.why_en: With three or more lanes in one direction, the left lane is for faster drivers or those turning left.

q.en: When you’re driving through a roundabout, which of the following statements is false?
q.zh: 当你开车通过一个环形路口时，以下哪种说法是错误的？
oe: Don’t try to pass bicyclists within the roundabout
Yield to vehicles and bicyclists within the circulating roadway
Always enter the roundabout to the left and proceed on the left side of the central island
Put on your right turn signal to tell drivers that you intend to exit
oz: 不要试图在环岛内超过骑自行车的人
在循环道路内向车辆和骑自行车的人让行
始终向左进入环岛，并在中央岛的左侧前进
打开你的右转向灯，告诉司机你打算退出。
q.why: 错误说法是 C：美国环岛是逆时针行驶，应向右进入、在中央岛右侧行驶，不能往左。
q.why_en: The false statement is C: U.S. roundabouts run counterclockwise, so you enter to the right and travel on the right side of the central island, never to the left.

q.en: The distance a vehicle travels between the time the driver recognizes a problem and the time he/she applies the brakes is known as
q.zh: 从司机认识到问题到他/她踩下刹车之间的车辆行驶距离被称为。
q.why: 从发现问题到踩下刹车期间车行驶的距离叫反应距离 (reaction distance)。
q.why_en: The distance traveled between recognizing a problem and applying the brakes is the reaction distance.

q.en: Flag persons are often located in highways and work zones ____.
q.zh: 旗手通常位于高速公路和工作区。
oe: To slow vehicles to a lower speed limit posted ahead
To determine the amount of alcohol in a driver’s blood
To stop, slow or guide traffic safely through construction areas
To report accidents to the police department and insurance company
oz: 将车辆减速至前方公布的较低的速度限制
为了确定司机血液中的酒精含量
阻止、减缓或引导交通安全通过施工区域
向警察部门和保险公司报告事故
q.why: 旗手 (flag persons) 在施工区负责让车辆停下、减速或引导安全通过，必须服从其指挥。
q.why_en: Flag persons in work zones stop, slow or guide traffic safely through; you must follow their directions.

q.en: Lanes of traffic going in opposite directions are divided by:
q.zh: 相向行驶的车道被什么划分
q.why: 黄色线分隔相反方向的车道；白色线分隔同方向的车道。
q.why_en: Yellow lines separate lanes going in opposite directions; white lines separate lanes going in the same direction.

q.en: If your vehicle’s directional signals fail, use until you can have them repaired.
q.zh: 如果你的车辆的方向灯出现故障，请使用什么，直到你能将其修复。
q.why: 转向灯坏了，在修好前要使用手势信号 (hand signals)。
q.why_en: If your directional signals fail, use hand signals until they are repaired.

q.en: If a driver behind you repeatedly flashes his/her headlights, you should ____.
q.zh: 如果你后面的司机反复闪烁他/她的大灯，你应该。
oe: Increase your vehicle speed and move ahead
oz: 提高你的车速并向前行驶
q.why: 后车反复闪大灯通常表示想超车，应安全让路（靠右让其通过），不要加速或回闪远光。
q.why_en: A driver behind you who repeatedly flashes headlights usually wants to pass; safely get out of the way (move right and let them by). Don't speed up or flash your high beams back.

q.en: you must:
q.zh: 当你来到一辆停在任何道路上的学校或教会巴士前上下乘客时。你必须
oe: Slow down and proceed with caution
Increase your speed and pass the bus quickly
Stop and remain stopped until all people have cleared the roadway
oz: 提高你的速度，快速通过巴士
继续以同样的速度前进
停止并保持停止，直到所有的人都离开道路。 344. If your vehicle is hit from the side, your body will be thrown:
q.why: 按题库答案：遇到停靠上下客的校车/教会巴士 (school or church bus)，要减速谨慎通过。NJ 规定若巴士未亮闪烁红灯，经过时车速不得超过 10 mph。
q.tip: 未闪红灯：≤10 mph 慢过；闪红灯：25 英尺外停
q.flag: 英文题干残缺（只剩“you must:”），D 选项混入了下一题文字。若巴士亮着闪烁红灯，NJ 法律要求在 25 英尺外停车，此时 D 才对；题库答案 A 只适用于未闪红灯的情况。
q.why_en: Per the answer key: when you come to a school or church bus stopped to load or unload passengers, slow down and proceed with caution. NJ rules say that if the bus is not flashing red lights, you may pass at no more than 10 mph.
q.tip_en: No red lights: pass at ≤10 mph; red lights flashing: stop 25 feet away
q.flag_en: The English stem is truncated (only "you must:" remains) and option D includes text from the next question. If the bus has red lights flashing, NJ law requires you to stop 25 feet away, and D would be correct; the keyed answer A only fits a bus without flashing red lights.

q.en: If your vehicle is hit from the side, your body will be thrown:
q.zh: 如果你的车辆从侧面被撞，你的身体就会被抛出。
oe: Toward the side that is hit
To the opposite the side that is hit
q.why: 侧面被撞时，车被推开而身体因惯性留在原处，相对会被甩向被撞的那一侧，所以系安全带很重要。
q.why_en: When hit from the side, the car is pushed away while your body stays in place by inertia, so you are thrown toward the side that is hit. That's why seat belts matter.

q.en: Talking on a cell phone while driving increases your chances of being in a crash by
q.zh: 开车时用手机通话会使你发生车祸的几率增加。
q.why: NJ 手册：开车打手机使发生车祸的几率增加高达四倍。
q.why_en: NJ manual: talking on a cell phone while driving increases your crash risk by as much as four times.

q.en: Car drivers should never move into the same lane with a motorcycle side by side, even if the lane is wide and the cyclist is riding to one side, because ____.
q.zh: 汽车司机决不能与摩托车并排进入同一车道，即使车道很宽，骑车人骑在一边，因为。
oe: Motorcycles do not have signal lights
Motorcyclists do not need to follow traffic rules
Motorcyclists may misguide the car driver
Motorcycles need a full lane width
oz: 摩托车手不需要遵守交通规则
摩托车手可能会误导汽车司机
摩托车需要一个完整的车道宽度
q.why: 摩托车需要整条车道宽度来安全行驶和避让，汽车不能与其并排共用一条车道。
q.why_en: Motorcycles need a full lane width to ride and maneuver safely; a car must never share a lane side by side with one.

q.en: When you are moving through an intersection with a green signal and a pedestrian starts to cross in your path against the red signal, the first thing to do is
q.zh: 当你在一个有绿色信号的十字路口行驶时，一个行人开始逆着红色信号在你的道路上穿过，首先要做的是。
oe: Stop your vehicle and allow the pedestrian to cross
Give a warning with your horn
oz: 停下你的车，让行人过马路
q.why: 按题库答案，先鸣笛警告行人。
q.flag: 行人违规闯红灯也应让行；首要动作应是减速/停车避免撞人。答案疑似应为 B：停车让行人通过。
q.why_en: Per the answer key: first give a warning with your horn.
q.flag_en: You must yield even to a pedestrian crossing against the red; the first action should be to slow down/stop to avoid hitting them. The answer should likely be B: "Stop your vehicle and allow the pedestrian to cross".

q.en: If you are driving on a road with three or more lanes, you should stay , except when passing another vehicle.
q.zh: 如果你在有三条或更多车道的道路上行驶，你应该保持在哪儿，除非在超过另一辆车时。
oe: On the shoulder of the road
q.why: 在三条及以上车道的道路上，除超车外应靠右行驶 (keep right)，留出左侧给超车车辆。
q.why_en: On roads with three or more lanes, keep right except when passing, leaving the left lanes for passing vehicles.

q.en: Before backing up your vehicle, you should look to the front, sides and rear, and continue to look         while backing.
q.zh: 在倒车之前，你应该看一下前面、侧面和后面，并在倒车时继续看
q.why: 倒车时要持续回头看后方 (to the rear)，不能只依赖后视镜。
q.why_en: While backing, keep turning to look to the rear; don't rely only on the mirrors.

q.en: All work zone symbols or signs have:
q.zh: 所有工作区的符号或标志都有
oe: an orange background and black letters
a red background and white letters
a blue background and white letters
a yellow background and black letters
q.why: 施工区标志是橙色底黑字 (orange background, black letters)。
q.why_en: Work zone signs have an orange background and black letters.

q.en: Being constantly aware of the driving conditions, planning ahead, anticipating dangers, and taking the right actions so as to avoid obstacles or other vehicles is known as
q.zh: 不断了解驾驶条件，提前计划，预测危险，并采取正确的行动，以避开障碍物或其他车辆，这就是所谓的。
q.why: 不断观察路况、提前计划、预判危险并采取正确行动，就是防御性驾驶 (defensive driving)。
q.why_en: Constantly watching conditions, planning ahead, anticipating dangers and taking the right action is defensive driving.

q.en: Drivers operating vehicles on a divided highway must , unless directed to do otherwise by a sign, traffic control device, or police officer.
q.zh: 在分车道的公路上驾驶车辆的驾驶人必须，除非有标志、交通控制装置或警察的指示。
oe: Drive to the right of the median
Drive to the center of the median
Drive to the left of the median
Not drive to the right of the median
oz: 驶向中间隔离带的右侧
驶向中间隔离带的中心
驶向中间隔离带的左边
不靠中间隔离带的右侧行驶
q.why: 在有中央隔离带的公路上，必须在隔离带右侧行驶，除非标志或警察另有指示。
q.why_en: On a divided highway, you must drive to the right of the median unless a sign or police officer directs otherwise.

q.en: Vehicles approaching a roundabout must:
q.zh: 接近环岛的车辆必须
oe: Enter the roundabout with a speed of 35mph
Yield to the traffic in the circle
Come to a complete stop and wait until the traffic in the circle is clear
Enter the roundabout to the left of the central island
oz: 以每小时35英里的速度进入环形交叉路口
完全停止并等待，直到圈内的交通畅通为止
在中央岛的左边进入环岛
q.why: 进入环岛前要让行环岛内的车辆，有空隙再进入；不需要一律完全停车。
q.why_en: Before entering a roundabout, yield to traffic in the circle and enter when there's a gap; you don't always need to come to a complete stop.
q.tip_en: Traffic in the circle goes first

q.en: Which of the following statements is NOT true about blind spots?
q.zh: 关于盲点，以下哪种说法不正确？
oe: Don’t ride in another driver’s blind spot
The best way to compensate for blind spots is to turn and glance over either shoulder
You have two blind spot areas to the left and right back sides of your car while driving
The larger the vehicle, the smaller the blind spots
oz: 不要在其他司机的盲点上骑车
弥补盲点的最好方法是转身，并从任何一个肩膀上看一眼
你在开车时有两个盲点区域，分别在你的车的左后侧和右后侧
q.why: 错误说法是 D：车越大，盲点越大，不是越小。
q.why_en: The false statement is D: the larger the vehicle, the larger the blind spots, not smaller.

q.en: A curb painted with yellow lines indicate that the driver:
q.zh: 绘有黄线的路边表明，司机。
oe: May stop only long enough to load or unload
May stop only long enough to make a quick turn
May not stop, stand or park
May stop until the road is clear to pass
oz: 可能只停止足够长的时间来装载或卸载
可能只停留足够长的时间来做一个快速转弯
可以停下来，直到道路畅通时再通过
q.why: 按题库答案，黄色路缘表示只可短暂停车装卸货。
q.flag: 不确定：NJ 黄色路缘多由地方规定，通常表示禁止停车 (no stopping/parking)；“只限装卸”是加州规则。答案可能应为 C，需按当地标志为准。
q.why_en: Per the answer key: a yellow curb means you may stop only long enough to load or unload.
q.flag_en: Uncertain: in NJ, yellow curbs are mostly set by local rules and usually mean no stopping/parking; "load or unload only" is a California rule. The answer may be C; follow local signs.

q.en: Drivers entering a main road from a driveway, alley or roadside should ____.
q.zh: 从车道、小巷或路边进入主干道的司机应：
oe: Reduce the speed and enter the main road
Enter the main road with an increased speed
Yield to vehicles already on the main road
oz: 以更高的速度进入主路
向已经在主路上的车辆让行
q.why: 从车道、小巷或路边驶入主路时，要让行主路上已有的车辆和行人。
q.why_en: When entering a main road from a driveway, alley or roadside, yield to vehicles and pedestrians already on the main road.

q.en: If there are three or more lanes going in the same direction on a highway, the    are usually the smoothest, in terms of the flow of traffic.
q.zh: 如果高速公路上有三条或更多的车道朝同一方向行驶，就交通流量而言，通常是最顺畅的是。
q.why: 三条及以上同向车道时，中间车道通常车流最顺畅：左道有超车、右道有进出车辆。
q.why_en: With three or more lanes in the same direction, the middle lanes usually flow most smoothly: the left lane has passing traffic and the right lane has vehicles entering and exiting.

q.en: If you see a vehicle coming toward you in the lane from the opposite direction, what should you do?
q.zh: 如果你看到一辆车从相反方向的车道上向你驶来，你应该怎么做？
oe: You must pull as far to the right as you safely can
You must slow down and sound your horn
oz: 你必须在你安全的范围内尽量向右拉动
你必须放慢速度并鸣笛
q.why: 对向车开进你的车道时：尽量靠右、减速并鸣笛、闪大灯提醒对方——以上都要做。
q.why_en: If a vehicle comes toward you in your lane: pull as far right as you safely can, slow down and sound your horn, and flash your headlights to alert the driver. Do all of the above.

q.en: To control speed on steep downgrades, drivers should:
q.zh: 为了在陡峭的下坡路上控制车速，司机应该。
q.why: 陡下坡用低挡 (lower gear) 让发动机制动控制车速，持续踩刹车会使刹车过热失效。
q.why_en: On steep downgrades, use a lower gear so engine braking controls your speed; braking continuously can overheat the brakes and make them fail.

q.en: The correct hand signal to indicate a left turn is:
q.zh: 表示左转的正确手势是。
q.why: 左转手势：左手臂水平向外伸直。右转是手臂向上弯，减速/停车是手臂向下。
q.why_en: Left-turn hand signal: left arm extended straight out. Right turn is arm bent upward; slow/stop is arm downward.
q.tip_en: Out = left, up = right, down = stop

q.en: Before reaching the crest of a hill or entering a curve, you must and watch for oncoming vehicles.
q.zh: 在到达山顶或进入弯道之前，你必须并注意来往车辆的情况
oe: Slow down, move to the right side of the road
Speed up, turn on the headlights
Slow down, move to the left side of the road
oz: 慢下来，移到道路的右边
慢下来，移到道路的左侧
q.why: 接近坡顶或弯道视线受阻，应减速并靠右行驶，留意对向来车。
q.why_en: Near a hill crest or curve where your view is blocked, slow down, keep to the right, and watch for oncoming vehicles.

q.en: This flashing red signal is treated as
q.zh: 这种闪烁的红色信号被视为。
q.why: 闪烁红灯等同于停车标志 (stop sign)：完全停车，确认安全后再走。
q.why_en: A flashing red signal is treated as a stop sign: come to a complete stop, then go when safe.

q.en: A red light with a green arrow means:
q.zh: 带绿色箭头的红灯意味着。
oe: You may go cautiously in the direction of the arrow, yielding to pedestrians
You must stop and proceed slowly, yielding to pedestrians
You must stop at the signal, yielding to pedestrians
You must stop and wait until it turns yellow
oz: 你可以小心翼翼地沿着箭头的方向前进，让着行人
你必须停止并缓慢前进，让位于行人
你必须在信号灯前停车，让位于行人
你必须停车并等待，直到它变成黄色
q.why: 红灯加绿色箭头：可按箭头方向谨慎通行，但要让行行人和路口内车辆。
q.why_en: Red light with a green arrow: you may go cautiously in the direction of the arrow, yielding to pedestrians and vehicles in the intersection.

q.en: Passing on the right is permitted in all of the following situations, EXCEPT ____.
q.zh: 在下列所有情况下都允许右侧超车，但以下情况除外。
oe: On highways that have at least two lanes traveling in each direction
When driving in a lane set aside for left-turns
When passing a vehicle that is in the left-turn lane
On one-way streets where all lanes of traffic move in the same direction
oz: 在每个方向至少有两条车道行驶的高速公路上
在留出的左转车道上行驶时
在超过处于左转弯车道的车辆时
在单行道上，所有的车道都在同一方向行驶
q.why: 按题库答案为 D。
q.flag: NJ 手册允许在单行道、每方向至少两条车道的公路、以及前车左转时从右侧超车，所以 D 也是允许的；“例外”应为 B（在左转专用道里行驶时不能用于右侧超车/直行超车）。答案疑似应为 B。
q.why_en: Per the answer key: D.
q.flag_en: The NJ manual allows passing on the right on one-way streets, on highways with at least two lanes in each direction, and when the vehicle ahead is turning left, so D is also permitted. The exception should be B (a lane set aside for left turns can't be used to pass on the right/go straight). The answer should likely be B.

q.en: The area of the freeway on the outside of the solid white line is meant for
q.zh: 白实线外侧的高速公路区域是指。
q.why: 高速公路白色实线外侧是路肩，仅供紧急情况使用，不能停车、调头或行驶超车。
q.why_en: Outside the solid white line on a freeway is the shoulder, for emergency use only; don't park, make U-turns or drive on it to pass.

q.en: If you find a “speed zone ahead” sign, you are approaching ____.
q.zh: 如果你发现一个 "前方限速路段 "的标志，你就接近了。
oe: An area where a reduced speed has been established
An area where the speed limit must not exceed 75 mph
An area where minimum speed limit is 70 mph
oz: 已确定减低速度的区域
速度限制不得超过75英里/小时的地区
一条快速路或高速公路
最低时速限制为70英里的地区
q.why: “Speed Zone Ahead” 表示前方已设定较低限速的区域，需准备减速。
q.why_en: "Speed Zone Ahead" means you are approaching an area where a reduced speed has been established; prepare to slow down.

q.en: If you see a pedestrian using a guide dog or other service animal and/or carrying a white cane at an intersection, you must ____.
q.zh: 如果你在十字路口看到一个使用导盲犬或其他服务动物和/或携带白手杖的行人，你必须。
oe: Use your horn to alert the pedestrian
Reduce your speed and pass slowly
Switch on your headlights to alert the pedestrian
oz: 用你的喇叭来提醒行人
降低你的速度并慢慢通过
打开你的大灯以提醒行人
q.why: 看到使用导盲犬或白手杖的行人，必须停车让其通过；鸣笛会惊吓他们。
q.why_en: When you see a pedestrian with a guide dog or white cane, you must stop and let them cross; honking may startle them.

q.en: When you drive in city traffic, you should try to look at least ____.
q.zh: 当你在城市交通中开车时，你应该尽量至少看看。
q.why: NJ 手册：城市驾驶至少要往前看一个街区 (one block)。
q.why_en: NJ manual: in city driving, look at least one block ahead.

q.en: If the traffic signals at an intersection are not operating, treat the intersection as a(n)
q.zh: 如果一个十字路口的交通信号灯不工作，将该十字路口视为
oz: 不易看清的道路交叉口
q.why: 路口信号灯失灵时，按全向停车 (all-way stop) 处理：每辆车先停，再依次通过。
q.why_en: If the traffic signals are not working, treat the intersection as an all-way stop: each vehicle stops, then proceeds in turn.

q.en: Locked wheel skids are usually caused by:
q.zh: 锁定的车轮打滑通常是由以下原因造成的
oe: Braking too hard at a high speed
Pressing the gas and brake pedal at the same time
Ignition turned to the lock position while the vehicle is still in motion
Drive wheels losing traction with the road surface
oz: 在高速状态下刹车过猛
同时踩下油门和刹车踏板
车辆仍在行驶中，点火器转到锁定位置
驱动轮失去与路面的牵引力
q.why: 高速时刹车太猛会使车轮抱死 (locked wheels) 而打滑。
q.why_en: Braking too hard at high speed locks the wheels and causes a skid.

q.en: A single solid white line across a road at an intersection means that a motorist must for a traffic signal or sign.
q.zh: 在十字路口的道路上有一条白色实线，意味着驾车者必须等待交通信号或标志
oe: Slow down after crossing the line
q.why: 路口横跨车道的单条白色实线是停止线，等信号或标志时要停在线前（线后方）。
q.why_en: A single solid white line across the lanes at an intersection is a stop line; when waiting for a signal or sign, stop behind the line.

q.en: If you are parked parallel on the right-hand side of the street, you should before pulling out into traffic.
q.zh: 如果你是在街道的右侧平行停车，你应该在开车之前。
oe: Give a left turn signal and look over your right shoulder
Give a right turn signal and look over your left shoulder
Give a left turn signal and look over your left shoulder
Give a right turn signal and look over your right shoulder
oz: 打左转向灯并看向你的右肩
打右转向灯并看向你的左肩
打左转向灯并看向你的左肩
打右转向灯并看向你的右肩
q.why: 从右侧路边驶出要打左转向灯，并回头看左肩方向的来车。
q.why_en: When pulling out from the right-hand curb, give a left turn signal and look over your left shoulder for oncoming traffic.

q.en: Which of the following statements about right-of-way is incorrect?
q.zh: 以下关于路权的说法哪个是不正确的？
oe: Vehicles entering or crossing a roadway from a private drive must yield to all oncoming vehicles
Drivers must yield to pedestrians at unmarked intersections
Vehicles turning left must yield to oncoming traffic
At an uncontrolled T-intersection, the vehicle on the continuing street must yield to the vehicle on the terminating street.
oz: 从私人车道进入或穿过道路的车辆必须让位于所有迎面而来的车辆
在没有标志的十字路口，司机必须让路给行人
左转的车辆必须让位于迎面而来的车辆
在不受控制的 T 形交叉路口，继续在街道上直行的车辆必须让行到支线街道上的车辆
q.why: 错误的是 D：在无控制 T 字路口，尽头路（支路）上的车应让行直通街道上的车，而不是反过来。
q.tip: T 字路口支路让主路
q.why_en: The incorrect statement is D: at an uncontrolled T-intersection, the vehicle on the terminating street must yield to the vehicle on the continuing street, not the other way around.
q.tip_en: At a T, the side road yields to the through road

q.en: All regulatory devices on the road instruct you:
q.zh: 道路上的所有监管设备都会指导您
oe: In finding your way safely or provide information to make your trip more comfortable
To stop, proceed in a certain direction, or limit your speed
Of hazardous conditions or the possibility of hazardous conditions
oz: 在安全地找到你的路或提供信息，使你的旅行更舒适
停下来，向某一方向前进，或限制你的速度
危险条件或危险条件的可能性
q.why: 规制类 (regulatory) 标志告诉你停车、朝某方向行驶或限速；A 是指示类，C 是警告类。
q.why_en: Regulatory signs tell you to stop, proceed in a certain direction, or limit your speed; A describes guide signs and C describes warning signs.

q.en: On a multiple-lane roadway with several lanes in one direction, you must use for passing.
q.zh: 在一个方向有几条车道的多车道道路上，你必须用那条车道超车
q.why: 同向多车道道路上，超车应使用中间和左侧车道，不应从最右侧超车。
q.why_en: On a multiple-lane road in one direction, pass using the middle and left lanes, not the far right lane.

q.en: Which of the following situations is ideal for overtaking and passing another vehicle on the right?
q.zh: 以下哪种情况适合于在右侧超车和超越另一车辆？
oe: When the vehicle you are passing is making or about to make a right turn
When the vehicle you are passing is making or about to make a left turn
When the vehicle you are passing is trying to change lanes
oz: 当你所经过的车辆正在或即将进行右转时
当你所通过的车辆正在或即将进行左转时
当你通过的车辆正试图改变车道时
q.why: 前车正在或准备左转时，可以从其右侧安全超车（不得驶出路面）。
q.why_en: When the vehicle ahead is making or about to make a left turn, you may safely pass it on the right (without leaving the pavement).

q.en: When there are two or more lanes for traffic moving in the same direction, slower vehicles should use
q.zh: 当有两条或更多的车道供同一方向的车辆行驶时，速度较慢的车辆应使用。
oe: The left lane, except when passing or making a left turn
The right lane, except when passing or making a left turn
oz: 左侧车道，但在超车或进行左转时除外
右侧车道，但在超车或进行左转弯时除外
q.why: 慢车应走右侧车道，超车或左转时除外。
q.why_en: Slower vehicles should use the right lane, except when passing or making a left turn.

q.en: An ____ is the connection of a freeway to a road or another freeway by a series of ramps.
q.zh: ____ 是指通过一系列坡道将高速公路与公路或另一条高速公路连接起来。
q.why: 互通式立交 (interchange) 是用一系列匝道把高速公路与其他道路连接起来的结构。
q.why_en: An interchange connects a freeway to a road or another freeway by a series of ramps.

q.en: are the mobile devices that are often used on some roads to give drivers an advance warning of construction zones.
q.zh: 什么是一些道路上经常使用的移动设备，为司机提供施工区的预先警告。
q.why: 闪烁箭头标志 (flashing arrow panels) 是可移动设备，用于提前提醒施工区并引导变道。
q.why_en: Flashing arrow signs are mobile devices that give advance warning of construction zones and direct lane changes.

q.en: When you see a solid center line on your side of the road, you must ____.
q.zh: 当你看到道路一侧有一条实的中心线时，你必须。
q.why: 你这侧是实线中心线时，不得越线超车/变道。
q.why_en: When the solid center line is on your side, you must not cross it to pass or change lanes.

q.en: A two-headed arrow with one head pointing straight ahead and the other pointing to the left means ____.
q.zh: 一个双头的箭头，一个头指向正前方，另一个头指向左边，意味着。
oe: You may either proceed straight ahead or turn to the left
You may only turn to the left
You may only turn to the right
You may either proceed straight or merge left
oz: 你可以直接前进或向左转弯
你可以直行或向左并线
q.why: 双头箭头（一个直行、一个左转）表示该车道可直行或左转。
q.why_en: A two-headed arrow (one straight, one left) means you may either proceed straight ahead or turn left from that lane.

q.en: While getting onto an expressway, you reach the end of a freeway on-ramp. At this point, you should be traveling:
q.zh: 在进入高速公路时，你会到达一个高速公路匝道的终点。这时，你应该是在行驶。
oe: At a speed under the speed of traffic
As close as possible to the speed of traffic
oz: 以低于交通速度的速度行驶
尽可能地接近交通的速度
q.why: 到达入口匝道尽头时，应尽量接近主路车流速度，以便安全并入。
q.why_en: At the end of the on-ramp, be traveling as close as possible to the speed of traffic so you can merge safely.

q.en: If an emergency vehicle approaches while you are driving in a roundabout, you must ____.
q.zh: 如果你在环岛内行驶时有紧急车辆驶来，你必须:
oe: Move over to the center of the roundabout and allow the emergency vehicle to pass
Stop in the middle of the roundabout
Slow down, move over to the right, and let the emergency vehicle pass first
Continue to your exit, pull over, and let the emergency vehicle pass
oz: 移到环岛的中心，让紧急车辆通过
放慢速度，移到右边，让紧急车辆先通过
继续往你的出口走，靠边停车，让紧急车辆通过
q.why: 环岛内遇到紧急车辆，不要在环岛内停车，应继续驶到出口离开，再靠边停车让其通过。
q.why_en: If an emergency vehicle approaches in a roundabout, don't stop inside it; continue to your exit, pull over, and let the emergency vehicle pass.

q.en: If a broken yellow line is on your side of the center dash stripe, then ____.
q.zh: 如果虚黄线在你这一侧的中央，那么。
oe: You may not cross the line
You may cross the line only if the other side has a broken line
You may cross the line to pass other vehicles
oz: 只有当对方有虚线时，您才可以越线
您可以越线超越其他车辆
q.why: 你这一侧是黄色虚线时，在安全情况下可越线超车。
q.why_en: When the broken yellow line is on your side, you may cross it to pass when safe.

q.en: The driver of the car being passed must until the pass is complete.
q.zh: 被超车的司机必须在超车完成之前
q.why: 被超车的司机在超车完成前不得加速，必要时应减速配合。
q.why_en: The driver being passed must not increase speed until the pass is complete, and should slow down if needed.

q.en: If a vehicle stalls on the tracks and the motorist sees a train coming, the motorist must ____.
q.zh: 如果车辆停在铁轨上，而驾车者看到有火车驶来，驾车者必须 ____。
oe: Give a signal to the oncoming train
Open all doors and wait for the help
Get out and walk clear of tracks
oz: 向迎面而来的列车发出信号
打开所有的门，等待救援
q.why: 车辆在铁轨上熄火且火车驶来，必须立即下车并远离铁轨（往火车来的方向斜着跑开以避碎片）。
q.why_en: If your vehicle stalls on the tracks with a train coming, get out immediately and walk clear of the tracks (move away at an angle toward the train to avoid debris).

q.en: If traffic from another roadway is merging into the roadway you are traveling on, you must ____.
q.zh: 如果来自另一条道路的车辆正在并入你所行驶的道路，你必须：
oe: Sound horn to let the merging traffic know you are there
Ignore the merging traffic since you have the right-of-way
Adjust your speed and vehicle position to allow the traffic to merge
oz: 发出喇叭声，让并线的车辆知道你在那里
忽略并线的车辆，因为你有路权
调整你的速度和车辆位置，让交通并入
q.why: 有车从其他道路并入时，应调整车速和位置让其安全并入。
q.why_en: When traffic merges in from another roadway, adjust your speed and position to let it merge safely.

q.en: A yield sign indicates that a driver must slow down when approaching an intersection and if a vehicle or pedestrian with the right-of-way is approaching from another direction.
q.zh: 避让标志表明，在接近十字路口时，如果有拥有路权的车辆或行人从另一方向驶来，司机必须减速并
oe: Be prepared to increase the speed
Be prepared to make a turn
Be prepared to make a U-turn
Be prepared to come to a complete stop
q.why: 让行 (yield) 标志：减速，并准备在有路权车辆或行人时完全停车。
q.why_en: Yield sign: slow down and be prepared to come to a complete stop if a vehicle or pedestrian with the right-of-way is approaching.

q.en: The wide white lines painted across a traffic lane before you enter the intersection are known as
q.zh: 在你进入十字路口之前，横跨交通车道的宽白线被称为。
q.why: 进入路口前横跨车道的宽白线叫停止线 (stop line)。
q.why_en: The wide white lines across a lane before an intersection are stop lines.

q.en: Before pulling out from a right-side parallel parking space, you must ____.
q.zh: 在从右侧平行停车位驶出之前，你必须。
oe: Check for approaching traffic and give a right-turn signal
Check for approaching traffic, but not give any turn signal
Check for approaching traffic and give a left-turn signal
oz: 检查驶来的车辆并发出右转信号
检查驶来的车辆，但不打任何转向灯
检查驶来的车辆并发出左转信号
q.why: 从右侧平行车位驶出前，要检查来车并打左转向灯。
q.why_en: Before pulling out of a right-side parallel parking space, check for approaching traffic and give a left-turn signal.

q.en: You must use high-beam lighting at night in all of the following situations, except ____.
q.zh: 在以下所有情况下，你必须在夜间使用远光灯照明，但以下情况除外。
oe: In fog, snow, or heavy rain
When there may be people along the side of the road
q.why: 雾、雪或大雨中不能用远光，会反光刺眼；其他情况（陌生道路、施工区、路边有人）可在无来车时用远光。
q.why_en: Don't use high beams in fog, snow or heavy rain; the glare reflects back. In the other cases (unfamiliar roads, construction areas, people along the road) use high beams when no vehicles are approaching.

q.en: A broken white line on the road represents:
q.zh: 道路上的一条白色虚线代表
oe: Lanes of traffic moving in the same direction
Lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions
oz: 方向相反的车道上行驶的车辆
在十字路口设置停车线
q.why: 白色虚线分隔同向行驶的车道，可在安全时变道。
q.why_en: A broken white line separates lanes moving in the same direction; you may change lanes when safe.

q.en: A double solid white line marks the edge of a traffic lane where ____.
q.zh: 双实白线标志着交通车道的边缘：
oe: Travel in the same direction is permitted on both sides of the line and crossing the line is also permitted
Travel in the opposite direction is permitted on both sides of the line and crossing the line is also permitted
Travel in the same direction is permitted on both sides of the line, but crossing the line is prohibited
Travel in the opposite directions is permitted on both sides of the line, but crossing the line is prohibited.
oz: 在线的两侧允许沿同一方向行进，并允许过线路
在线的两边允许反方向行驶，也允许越过线
在线的两边允许各自沿同一方向行驶，但禁止越线
允许在线的两边以相反的方向行驶，但禁止越线
q.why: 双白实线：两侧都是同方向行驶，但禁止越线。
q.why_en: Double solid white line: traffic on both sides moves in the same direction, but crossing the line is prohibited.

q.en: Which of the following statements is true when driving on highways?
q.zh: 在高速公路上行驶时，以下哪种说法是正确的？
oe: Slow-moving vehicles should use the left lane and fast-moving vehicles should use right lane
Fast-moving vehicles should overtake slower vehicles from right side
Slow-moving vehicles should use the right lane and fast-moving vehicles should use left lane
Fast-moving vehicles must enter the highway through the deceleration lane
oz: 慢速行驶的车辆应使用左侧车道，快速行驶的车辆应使用右侧车道
快速行驶的车辆应从右侧超越较慢的车辆
慢速行驶的车辆应使用右侧车道，快速行驶的车辆应使用左侧车道
快速行驶的车辆必须通过减速车道进入高速公路
q.why: 慢车走右道，快车走左道；超车从左侧进行。
q.why_en: Slow vehicles use the right lane and fast vehicles the left lane; pass on the left.

q.en: When you come to an intersection and try to make a move, you must follow the before you pull out.
q.zh: 当你来到一个十字路口并试图做出行动时，你必须在行驶之前遵循。
q.why: 出路口前按“左-右-左”顺序观察：先看左（最近车流），再看右，再看一次左。
q.why_en: Before pulling out at an intersection, look left-right-left: left first (nearest traffic), then right, then left again.

q.en: You must use when the sun is shining brightly or when a line of cars following you could obscure your turn signal light.
q.zh: 当太阳很亮的时候，或者当后面有一排汽车可能会遮住你的转向灯的时候，你必须用。
q.why: 阳光强烈或后方车队可能挡住你的转向灯时，要用手势信号。
