q.why_en: Use hand signals when bright sunlight or a line of cars behind you could obscure your turn signal light.

q.en: You have parked next to the curb facing downhill. Which way should you point your front wheels to stop your car from rolling if your brakes should fail?
q.zh: 你把车停在路边，面向下坡。如果你的刹车失灵，你应该将前轮指向哪个方向以阻止你的车滚动？
q.why: 朝下坡靠路缘停车，前轮转向路缘 (toward the curb)，刹车失灵时车会顶住路缘。
q.why_en: When parked facing downhill next to a curb, turn your front wheels toward the curb so the car rests against it if the brakes fail.

q.en: 399.A motorist must stop        from railroad crossings when there are flashing lights, ringing bells or flag signals.
q.zh: 当有闪灯、铃声或旗帜信号时，驾车者必须在铁路交叉口停车。
q.why: 铁路道口有闪灯、铃声或旗手信号时，NJ 规定须在距铁轨不少于 15 英尺（不超过 50 英尺）处停车。
q.flag: 题干开头有多余编号“399.”，不影响答案。
q.why_en: When a railroad crossing has flashing lights, ringing bells or flag signals, NJ requires you to stop at least 15 feet (and no more than 50 feet) from the tracks.
q.flag_en: Stem starts with a stray number "399."; it doesn't affect the answer.

q.en: You approach a school bus which has pulled over for passengers. Its red lights are flashing. What must you do?
q.zh: 你接近一辆停在路边等候乘客的校车。它的红灯在闪烁。你必须做什么？
oe: You must come to a complete stop at least 25ft from the bus, regardless of which direction you are travelling
If you are travelling in the same direction as the bus, you must come to a complete stop at least 25ft away
You must slow down to 10 mph and pass with caution
You must come to a complete stop at least 25ft away, check the road is clear of children, and pass at 20 mph or less
oz: 必须在距离公交车至少25英尺处完全停下，无论你在哪个方向行驶。
如果你与公交车同向行驶，你必须在至少25英尺外完全停下来
你必须放慢到10英里/小时，并谨慎地通过
你必须在至少25英尺外完全停止，检查路上是否有儿童，并以20英里/小时或更低的速度通过。
q.why: NJ 法律：校车闪红灯时，无论同向还是对向都须在至少 25 英尺外停车。唯一例外：中间有隔离带的分隔公路对向车道，可减速至 10 mph 谨慎通过。
q.why_en: NJ law: when a school bus has red lights flashing, traffic in both directions must stop at least 25 feet away. The only exception: on a divided highway with a median, opposite-direction traffic may slow to 10 mph and pass with caution.

q.en: You arrive at a crossroads. You want to turn left and you have a green light. Can you proceed?
q.zh: 你到了一个十字路口。你想左转，而你有一个绿灯。你能继续吗？
oe: Yes, you can turn left, however you may still need to yield to pedestrians and oncoming traffic
Yes, but only if there is a LEFT TURN PERMITTED sign present
Yes you can turn left, as this is a ‘protected’ turn where no other cars are allowed to enter the intersection
oz: 是的，你可以左转，但你可能仍然需要让行人和来往车辆。
是的，但只有当有一个允许左转的标志存在时才可以。
是的，你可以左转，因为这是一个 "受保护 "的转弯，其他车辆不允许进入十字路口
q.why: 普通绿灯（无绿箭头）可以左转，但属于非保护转弯，仍须让行行人和对向来车。
q.flag: 选项 D 为空。
q.why_en: On a plain green light (no green arrow) you may turn left, but it's an unprotected turn: you must still yield to pedestrians and oncoming traffic.
q.flag_en: Option D is empty.

q.en: Are you allowed to turn right at a red signal?
q.zh: 你可以在红灯时右转吗？
oe: Yes, this is s a ‘protected’ turn so you will have right of way
Yes, but only after coming to a stop and yielding to traffic
Yes, but only if a sign permits you to do so
No, you can never turn right at a red light
oz: 是的，这是一个 "受保护 "的转弯，所以你将有路权。
是的，但只有在停车和让行后才可以。
是的，但只有在标志允许你这样做的情况下。
不，你永远不能在红灯前右转
q.why: 新泽西允许红灯右转 (right on red)，但必须先完全停车，并让行行人和横向来车，除非有“No Turn on Red”标志。红灯右转不是“受保护转弯”，你没有路权。
q.tip: 红灯右转：先停、再让、后转
q.why_en: New Jersey allows right on red, but you must first come to a complete stop and yield to pedestrians and cross traffic, unless a "No Turn on Red" sign is posted. A right on red is not a "protected" turn; you do not have the right-of-way.
q.tip_en: Right on red: stop, yield, then turn

q.en: What must you do at a flashing yellow traffic signal?
q.zh: 在闪烁的黄色交通信号灯下，你必须做什么？
oe: This signal tells you that you cannot turn at this intersection, so continue on straight
Slow down and drive with caution
Stop, yield and proceed when safe
oz: 这个信号灯告诉你，你不能在这个路口转弯，所以继续直走。
放慢速度，谨慎驾驶 Prepare to stop; the light will soon turn red  准备停车；信号灯很快就会变红
停车，让路，安全时继续前进
q.why: 闪烁黄灯 (flashing yellow) 表示警告：减速并谨慎通过，不需要停车。闪烁红灯才等同于停车标志（停车、让行、再走）。
q.flag: 选项 B 文本混入了另一个选项"Prepare to stop; the light will soon turn red"（应为空着的 D），不影响答案 B"减速，谨慎驾驶"。
q.why_en: A flashing yellow signal is a warning: slow down and proceed with caution; you do not have to stop. A flashing red signal is the one treated like a stop sign (stop, yield, then go).
q.tip_en: Flashing yellow = slow; flashing red = stop
q.flag_en: Option B's text has another option merged into it ("Prepare to stop; the light will soon turn red," which belongs in the blank option D); this does not affect answer B, "Slow down and drive with caution."

q.en: Which of the following is NOT true about using headlights?
q.zh: 关于使用大灯，以下哪项是不正确的？
oe: You should use your headlights whenever there is less than 500ft visibility, even during the day
If you need to use your windscreen wipers, then you need to use your headlights
You are required to switch your headlights on from half an hour after sunset to half an hour before sunrise
Your parking lights are sufficient when there is poor visibility during the day
oz: 只要能见度低于500英尺，你就应该使用你的头灯，即使在白天也是如此。
如果你需要使用你的挡风玻璃雨刷，那么你就需要使用你的大灯
你必须在日落后半小时至日出前半小时内打开你的大灯
在白天能见度低的情况下，你的停车灯是足够的
q.why: 白天能见度差时只开示宽灯/停车灯 (parking lights) 是不够的，必须开大灯，因此 D 是错误说法。新泽西规定：日落后半小时到日出前半小时、能见度低于 500 英尺、以及使用雨刷时都必须开大灯。
q.why_en: Parking lights alone are not enough when visibility is poor during the day; you must use headlights, so D is the false statement. NJ requires headlights from half an hour after sunset to half an hour before sunrise, when visibility is less than 500 feet, and whenever your windshield wipers are on.

q.en: If you approach a vehicle displaying a triangular sign that is orange with a red, reflective border on the back side, you must ____.
q.zh: 如果你接近一辆显示三角形标志的车辆，该标志为橙色，背面有红色的反光边框，你必须。
oe: Share the same lane with the vehicle
q.why: 橙色三角形、红色反光边框是慢速车辆标志 (slow-moving vehicle emblem)，常见于农用车、马车等，车速一般不超过 25 mph，接近时应减速并谨慎。
q.why_en: An orange triangle with a red reflective border is the slow-moving vehicle emblem, used on farm equipment, horse-drawn vehicles and the like, which usually travel no faster than 25 mph. Slow down and use caution when approaching.

q.en: When should you yield on a green light?
q.zh: 什么时候应该在绿灯时让行？
oe: When the green light is an arrow
When going straight through the intersection
q.why: 绿灯（圆形）左转时，必须让行对向直行车辆和行人。绿色箭头 (green arrow) 是受保护转弯，所以 A 不对。
q.why_en: When turning left on a circular green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians. A green arrow is a protected turn, so A is wrong.
q.tip_en: Left on green: yield to oncoming traffic

q.en: Always decrease your driving speed when driving:
q.zh: 驾驶时一定要降低你的驾驶速度
q.why: 盲弯、坡道、铁路道口等视线受限或路况特殊的地方都应降速，所以选“以上全部”。
q.why_en: Slow down wherever your view is limited or conditions are special, such as blind curves, hills and railroad crossings, so the answer is "All of the above."

q.en: While turning left on a green light, you see that a pedestrian is in the crosswalk walking with the green light. Who has the right of way?
q.zh: 在绿灯左转时，你看到一个行人在人行横道上行走，绿灯亮起。谁有路权？
oe: Whoever comes to the intersection first
Your vehicle because the light is green
Your vehicle because you are turning left
The pedestrian, because the light is green for them
oz: 您的车辆，因为绿灯亮了
你的车辆，因为你正在左转
q.why: 即使你也是绿灯，转弯车辆必须让行正在人行横道 (crosswalk) 内合法通行的行人。
q.why_en: Even if your light is also green, a turning vehicle must yield to a pedestrian lawfully crossing in the crosswalk.

q.en: Is talking on your cell phone while driving permitted?
q.zh: 开车时用手机是否允许
oe: Yes, as long as you are careful
Only if a hands-free device is used
Only if you are driving on a rural road
Talking on a cell phone while driving is never permitted
oz: 只有在使用免提设备的情况下
只有当你在农村道路上行驶时
q.why: 新泽西禁止开车时手持使用手机，只允许使用免提设备 (hands-free)。注意：持学习驾照/试用驾照 (GDL) 的新手连免提也不允许。
q.why_en: New Jersey bans using a hand-held cell phone while driving; only hands-free devices are allowed. Note: GDL holders (permit and probationary license) may not use even a hands-free device.
q.tip_en: Hand-held is illegal; hands-free is OK

q.en: Construction zones usually have:
q.zh: 施工区通常有
oe: A standard speed limit of 15 mph
oz: 标准速度限制为15英里/小时
q.why: 施工区 (construction/work zone) 通常会降低限速，而且在新泽西施工区超速等违规罚款加倍。
q.why_en: Construction (work) zones usually have reduced speed limits, and in New Jersey fines for speeding and other violations are doubled in work zones.
q.tip_en: Work zone: slow down, fines doubled

q.en: What is a “no zone”?
q.zh: 什么是 "盲区"
oe: An area where you are not permitted to park
The blind spots that a truck driver has
oz: 一个不允许停车的区域
q.why: “No Zone”指大卡车、巴士周围司机看不到的盲区（车前、车后、两侧）。避免在其中停留。
q.tip: 看不到卡车司机后视镜里的你=你在 No Zone
q.why_en: The "No Zone" is the blind-spot area around a large truck or bus (front, rear and sides) where the driver cannot see you. Avoid lingering in it.
q.tip_en: If you can't see the truck driver in their mirror, you're in the No Zone

q.en: After you stop at a solid red light and yield to pedestrians, you may turn while the light is still red.
q.zh: 在实心红灯前停车并让行人后，你可以在红灯时转弯。
oe: You are never permitted to turn on a red light
oz: 绝不允许你在红灯时转弯
q.why: 新泽西红灯时，完全停车并让行行人和来车后可以右转（除非有禁止标志）。红灯左转只有从单行道转入单行道才允许，题中一般情况答右转。
q.why_en: In New Jersey, after a complete stop and yielding to pedestrians and traffic, you may turn right on red (unless a sign prohibits it). Left on red is allowed only from a one-way street onto another one-way street, so the general answer is right.

q.en: Freeway traffic traveling at less than the normal speed should use which lane?
q.zh: 高速公路上以低于正常速度行驶的车辆应使用哪条车道？
oe: Whichever lane has the least traffic
oz: 哪条车道的车流量最少，就走哪条
q.why: 在高速/快速路上比正常车速慢的车辆应走最右侧车道 (right lane)，左侧车道留给超车和快车。
q.why_en: On a freeway, vehicles moving slower than normal traffic should use the right lane; the left lanes are for passing and faster traffic.

q.en: When a stopped school bus has red lights flashing on a divided highway, you must ____.
q.zh: 当一辆停在路边的校车在分车道公路上闪烁着红灯时，你必须。
oe: Stop only if you are traveling the opposite direction of the bus.
Stop if you are driving either direction.
Slow down if you are traveling the same direction as the bus.
Slow down to 10 mph if on the other side of a safety island or raised median.
oz: 只有在与校车相反的方向行驶时才可以停车。
如果在驾驶任何一个方向，请停下来。
如果你与公交车同向行驶，请放慢速度。
如果在安全岛或凸起的隔离带的另一侧，请将速度降至10英里/小时。
q.why: 新泽西：在有安全岛或隆起中央隔离带 (safety island / raised median) 的分隔公路上，对向车辆可以不停但须减速到 10 mph 以下；同向车辆必须在 25 英尺外停车。
q.tip: 同向必停，有隔离带的对向减到 10 mph
q.why_en: New Jersey: on a divided highway with a safety island or raised median, traffic on the opposite side does not have to stop but must slow to 10 mph or less; traffic in the same direction must stop at least 25 feet away.
q.tip_en: Same direction always stops; opposite side across a median slows to 10 mph

q.en: At a four-way stop, which driver gets to proceed first?
q.zh: 在一个四个方向停车标志的路口，哪个司机可以先走？
oe: The driver going straight through the intersection
oz: 直接通过十字路口的司机
q.why: 四向停车 (four-way stop) 路口，先到先走；同时到达时让右侧车辆先行。
q.why_en: At a four-way stop, the first driver to arrive goes first; if drivers arrive at the same time, yield to the driver on the right.
q.tip_en: First come, first go; tie goes to the right

q.en: What is the maximum speed limit on rural roadways?
q.zh: 农村公路的最高限速是多少？
q.why: 新泽西未另标示时，乡村道路 (rural roads) 法定限速为 50 mph。参考：学校区/商业住宅区 25 mph，郊区商业住宅区 35 mph，部分州际公路 55/65 mph。
q.why_en: Unless otherwise posted, the New Jersey speed limit on rural roads is 50 mph. For reference: school zones and business/residential districts 25 mph, suburban business/residential districts 35 mph, certain interstates 55/65 mph.

q.en: When are you permitted to pass a school bus with red flashing lights?
q.zh: 什么时候允许你超过有红灯闪烁的校车？
oe: If there is more than one lane in your direction
When you feel it is safe to do so
Only if there is a physical barrier divider between you and the bus
When you see that children have crossed the road
oz: 如果在你的方向有超过一条车道
当你觉得这样做是安全的
只有在你和公交车之间有物理屏障隔断的情况下
当你看到孩子们横穿马路时
q.why: 只有在你与校车之间有安全岛或隆起中央隔离带等物理隔离时，对向车辆才可通过（且须减速到 10 mph）。多车道本身不能免除停车义务。
q.why_en: Only when a safety island or raised median physically separates you from the bus may opposite-direction traffic pass (and it must slow to 10 mph). Multiple lanes alone do not excuse you from stopping.

q.en: Turning right on a red light in New Jersey is:
q.zh: 在新泽西州红灯时右转是。
oe: Permitted unless a sign is posted
oz: 允许的，除非有标志贴出
只允许在多车道的道路上使用
q.why: 新泽西允许红灯时停车让行后右转，除非有“No Turn on Red”标志禁止。
q.why_en: New Jersey allows a right turn on red after stopping and yielding, unless a "No Turn on Red" sign is posted.

q.en: When being approached from the rear by an ambulance with a siren, you should ____.
q.zh: 当有救护车鸣笛从后方接近时，你应该。
oe: Pull over to the side of the road and proceed to drive slowly on the shoulder
Pull over only if it looks like the ambulance will need room
Stop in your lane to let the vehicle pass
Pull over to the side of the road and stop
oz: 把车停在路边，继续在路肩上缓慢行驶
只有在救护车看起来需要空间时才靠边停车
在你的车道上停车，让车辆通过
把车停在路边并停下来
q.why: 听到救护车等紧急车辆鸣笛从后方接近，应靠右边路边并停车，直到其通过。不要在本车道停下，也不要在路肩继续行驶。
q.why_en: When an ambulance or other emergency vehicle with a siren approaches from behind, pull over to the right side of the road and stop until it passes. Don't stop in your lane, and don't keep driving on the shoulder.
q.tip_en: Pull right, stop, let it pass

q.en: When you are traveling on a two-lane road and a vehicle ahead of you stops for a pedestrian, you must ____.
q.zh: 当你在一条双车道的道路上行驶时，你前面的车辆为行人停车，你必须 ____。
oe: Change lanes and pass the vehicle quickly
Alert the stopped vehicle to take a detour
Reduce your speed and pass the vehicle slowly
oz: 改变车道并快速超越车辆
警告停止的车辆绕道而行
降低你的速度，慢慢地超过车辆
q.why: 前车为行人停车时，不得超越该停着的车辆，因为可能有你看不见的行人正在过马路。
q.why_en: When a vehicle ahead stops for a pedestrian, you must not pass it, because a pedestrian you can't see may be crossing.

q.en: Stopping on an expressway entrance ramp is permitted:
q.zh: 允许在高速公路入口匝道上停车
oe: Only when there is no opening in the flow of traffic
Stopping on a freeway entrance ramp is never permitted
oz: 只有在车流中没有进入开口的时候
绝不允许在高速公路入口匝道上停车
q.why: 入口匝道一般不应停车，只有当主路车流中完全没有空隙可以汇入时才可停下等待。
q.why_en: You generally should not stop on an entrance ramp; you may stop and wait only when there is no gap in the main traffic flow to merge into.

q.en: When driving, you should always slow down on:
q.zh: 开车时，你应该始终在什么地方放慢速度。
q.why: 急弯、坡道、湿滑路面都会降低视线或抓地力，都应减速，选“以上全部”。
q.why_en: Sharp corners, hills and wet roads all reduce visibility or traction, so slow down on all of them: "All of the above."

q.en: In an uncontrolled intersection, when multiple vehicles arrive at the same time, you must yield to
q.zh: 在一个不受控制的交叉路口，当多辆车同时到达时，你必须让行。
oe: Any vehicle turning across the intersection
oz: 任何转过十字路口的车辆
q.why: 无信号控制路口多车同时到达时，让行右侧车辆 (vehicle on your right)。
q.why_en: At an uncontrolled intersection, when several vehicles arrive at the same time, yield to the vehicle on your right.
q.tip_en: Arrive together, yield to the right

q.en: You see that a bus in the lane to your right is about to make a right turn. What should you be aware of?
q.zh: 你看到你右边车道上的一辆公共汽车即将右转。你应该注意什么？
oe: The bus will be turning slower than other vehicles
The bus may need to move into the left lane to make the turn
Buses are not allowed to make right turns
Buses are only permitted to make turns from the right lane
oz: 巴士的转弯速度会比其他车辆慢
公交车可能需要移动到左边的车道来进行转弯
公共汽车只允许从右侧车道转弯
q.why: 大巴/卡车右转时需要大转弯半径，常会先向左摆或占用左侧车道再右转，不要从其右侧挤过去。
q.why_en: Buses and trucks need a wide turning radius when turning right, often swinging left or using the left lane first. Don't squeeze past on their right.
q.tip_en: Big vehicles swing left to turn right

q.en: When you are in the middle lane of a road, you want to turn left. You may turn left from the middle lane only if:
q.zh: 当你在一条道路的中间车道上时，你想左转。只有在以下情况下，你才能从中间车道左转：
oe: You are turn onto a one-way road
You are unable to merge to the left-most lane due to traffic
q.why: 一般左转应从最左侧车道进行；只有当路面标线或标志允许从中间车道左转时才可以（例如双左转车道）。
q.flag: 选项不完整：C、D 为空，无法核对键答 C。按 NJ 手册，应为“标志/标线允许时”才可从中间车道左转。
q.why_en: Left turns are normally made from the left-most lane; you may turn left from the middle lane only when signs or pavement markings allow it (e.g., dual left-turn lanes).
q.flag_en: Options incomplete: C and D are blank, so keyed answer C can't be verified. Per the NJ manual, a left turn from the middle lane is allowed only when signs/markings permit it.

q.en: Before every lane change, you should:
q.zh: 在每次改变车道之前，你应该
q.why: 变道前应查看后视镜、打转向灯、回头检查盲区 (blind spot)，三者都要做。
q.why_en: Before changing lanes, check your mirrors, signal, and look over your shoulder to check your blind spot; do all three.

q.en: When entering a freeway from an acceleration lane, it is important to
q.zh: 当从加速车道进入高速公路时，一定要。
oe: Increase speed beyond speed limit make sure you enter
Increase your speed to match that of the freeway
Come to a full stop and wait for an opening in traffic.
oz: 提高速度超过限速，确保你进入
提高你的速度以配合高速公路车流的速度 Keep your speed below that of the freeway until you’ve entered traffic flow 保持你的速度低于高速公路车流的速度，直到你进入车流。
来个全速停车，等待车辆的空挡。
q.why: 从加速车道 (acceleration lane) 汇入高速时，应加速到与主路车流相当的速度再汇入；不能超速，也不应在加速车道停下。
q.flag: 答案疑似应为 C：键答 B 选项内容仅为“.”，属乱码；正确做法是加速到与高速车流速度一致 (C)。
q.why_en: When merging onto a freeway from an acceleration lane, speed up to match freeway traffic before merging; don't exceed the speed limit, and don't stop in the acceleration lane.
q.flag_en: The answer is likely C: keyed answer B's text is just ".", which is garbled; the correct action is to "Increase your speed to match that of the freeway" (C).

q.en: If your vehicle is skidding on ice, when should you pump your brakes?
q.zh: 如果你的车辆在冰上打滑，你应该在什么时候踩下刹车？
oe: When driving a vehicle WHITHOUT ABS (anti-lock) brakes
When driving a vehicle WITH ABS (anti-lock) brakes
Only when there are no other vehicles on the road
oz: 当驾驶没有ABS（防抱死）刹车系统的车辆时
当驾驶有ABS（防抱死）刹车的车辆时
只有在道路上没有其他车辆的时候
q.why: 没有 ABS 的车辆在冰面打滑时应点刹 (pump the brakes) 防止车轮抱死；有 ABS 的车应持续用力踩住刹车，让系统自动点刹。
q.tip: 有 ABS 踩住，无 ABS 点刹
q.why_en: Without ABS, pump the brakes when skidding on ice to keep the wheels from locking; with ABS, apply firm, steady pressure and let the system pump the brakes for you.
q.tip_en: ABS: press and hold; no ABS: pump

q.en: Lines that separate two or more lanes of traffic traveling in the same direction are
q.zh: 将两个或更多的同向行驶的车道分开的线是。
q.why: 分隔同向车道的是白线：白色虚线可变道，白色实线不鼓励/不允许变道。黄线用于分隔对向车流。
q.why_en: Lanes traveling in the same direction are separated by white lines: broken white lines allow lane changes, solid white lines discourage or prohibit them. Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions.

q.en: The driver in front of you has his arm out the window, bent at 90 degrees pointing down. What is the driver’s intention?
q.zh: 你前面的司机将手臂伸出窗外，弯曲成90度，指向下方。该司机的意图是什么？
q.why: 手臂向下弯成 90 度表示减速或停车；向上弯表示右转；平直伸出表示左转。
q.why_en: An arm bent down at 90 degrees means slow or stop; bent up means right turn; straight out means left turn.
q.tip_en: Up = right, straight = left, down = stop

q.en: Which of the following can affect a driver’s ability to drive safely?
q.zh: 以下哪种情况会影响司机的安全驾驶能力？
q.why: 感冒药、违禁药物、减肥药都可能引起嗜睡、反应迟钝或紧张，都会影响安全驾驶。
q.why_en: Cold medications, illegal drugs and diet pills can all cause drowsiness, slowed reactions or nervousness, and all affect safe driving.

q.en: You may not park within ____ feet of a crosswalk or intersection.
q.zh: 你不能在距离人行道或十字路口 ____ 英尺以内停车。
q.why: 新泽西规定：不得在路口人行横道 25 英尺内停车。其他：消防栓 10 英尺内，停车标志 50 英尺内，铁路道口 50 英尺内。
q.tip: 人行道/路口 25，消防栓 10，停车标志 50
q.why_en: New Jersey law: no parking within 25 feet of a crosswalk at an intersection. Others: within 10 feet of a fire hydrant, within 50 feet of a stop sign, within 50 feet of a railroad crossing.

q.en: Solid lines on the edge of the road:
q.zh: 道路边缘的实线
oe: Are only present on multi-lane roads.
Tell you where the edge of the road is.
Are on either side of a no-passing zone
oz: 只存在于多车道的道路上
告诉你道路的边缘在哪里
q.why: 路边的白色实线 (edge line) 标示车行道的边缘，提示路边在哪里，夜间或恶劣天气尤其有用。
q.why_en: The solid white edge line marks the edge of the roadway, showing where the road ends; it's especially helpful at night and in bad weather.

q.en: In a weave lane, who is given the right-of-way?
q.zh: 在进出交叉车道上，谁享有通行权？
oe: The vehicle that is going faster
q.why: 交织车道 (weave lane) 同时用于驶入和驶出，驶入高速的车辆必须让行驶出的车辆。
q.why_en: A weave lane is used both to enter and to exit, and traffic entering the expressway must yield to traffic exiting.

q.en: You are driving on a highway with a posted speed limit of 65 mph. Most of the traffic is traveling at 70 mph, so you should be driving no faster than ____.
q.zh: 你在一条高速公路上行驶，规定的限速为65英里/小时。大多数车辆以每小时70英里的速度行驶，所以你的速度不应超过。
q.why: 无论别人开多快，都不得超过标示限速 65 mph。
q.why_en: No matter how fast others are going, you must not exceed the posted 65 mph limit.

q.en: The best way to adjust your speed when approaching a curve is to
q.zh: 在接近弯道时，调整速度的最好方法是。
oe: Slow down to the posted speed limit
Begin braking once in the curve
q.why: 应在进入弯道之前减速，弯道中急刹容易打滑失控；出弯时可轻踩油门。
q.why_en: Slow down before entering the curve; hard braking in a curve can cause a skid and loss of control. Accelerate gently as you come out of it.

q.en: An intersection where the traffic control lights are not working is treated ____.
q.zh: 交通控制灯不工作的路口处理：
oe: As if it is blocked off. Choose another route for travel.
So that vehicles on the larger of the two roads has right-of-way
As though there is a flashing yellow light.
oz: 如同被封锁了一样。选择另一条路线出行。
就像一个四向停车标记路口
因此，两条道路中较大的一条道路上的车辆拥有路权
仿佛有一个闪烁的黄灯。
q.why: 交通信号灯失灵 (lights not working) 时，按四向停车 (all-way stop) 处理：每辆车都先停车，再按顺序通行。
q.why_en: When traffic lights are not working, treat the intersection as an all-way (four-way) stop: every vehicle stops first, then proceeds in turn.

q.en: How do you know when it is safe to merge back in front of a large truck you have just passed?
q.zh: 你怎么知道什么时候在你刚刚通过的大卡车前面并入是安全的？
oe: The vehicle’s headlights and entire cab are visible in your rear view mirror
You do not see the vehicle out your side window
The driver beeps to let you know it is safe to merge back in
You can make eye contact with the driver in your side mirror
oz: 在你的后视镜中可以看到车辆的大灯和整个驾驶室
你没有从你的侧窗看到该车辆
驾驶员发出提示音，让你知道可以安全地并入。
你可以在你的侧镜中与司机进行眼神交流
q.why: 超过卡车后，当你能在车内后视镜 (rearview mirror) 中看到整辆卡车的车头和前大灯时，才可以安全并回其前方。
q.tip: 后视镜看到大灯再并线
q.why_en: After passing a truck, it's safe to merge back in front of it only when you can see the whole cab and its headlights in your rearview mirror.
q.tip_en: See its headlights in your mirror, then merge

q.en: If an oncoming vehicle does not dim its high beam headlights, you should ____.
q.zh: 如果迎面而来的车辆没有调暗其远光灯，你应该。
oe: Look at your dashboard until the driver has passed
Look to toward the right edge of your lane
Try make eye contact with the driver
oz: 看你的仪表盘，直到司机通过
看向你车道的右侧边缘
尝试与司机进行眼神交流
q.why: 对向车不调低远光灯时，把视线移向本车道右侧边缘 (right edge) 来保持方向，避免被晃眼；不要直视大灯，也不要以远光回敬。
q.why_en: If an oncoming driver doesn't dim the high beams, look toward the right edge of your lane to stay on course and avoid being blinded. Don't look directly at the headlights or retaliate with your own high beams.

q.en: The primary traveling aids for a blind person include:
q.zh: 盲人的主要出行辅助工具包括。
oe: A white cane or a trained guide dog
A red cane or a trained guide dog
A red cane or a trained guide cat
oz: 一根白手杖或一只训练有素的导盲犬
一根红色手杖或一只训练有素的导盲犬
一根红手杖或一只训练有素的导盲猫
q.why: 盲人的主要出行辅助是白色手杖 (white cane) 或导盲犬 (guide dog)。见到使用者必须让行。
q.why_en: The main traveling aids for blind people are a white cane or a guide dog. You must yield to anyone using them.

q.en: When turning left from a two-way street onto a one-way street, you must ____.
q.zh: 当从双向街道左转到单行道时，你必须。
oe: Begin the turn with your right wheel as close as possible to the yellow dividing line
Begin the turn with your left wheel as close as possible to the yellow dividing line
Swing wide to the left before turning
oz: 开始转弯时，你的右轮要尽可能靠近黄色分界线
开始转弯时，你的左轮要尽可能靠近黄色分界线
q.why: 从双向街左转进单行道时，应靠近黄色中线、左侧车轮尽量贴近中线开始转弯，转入单行道最近的合法车道。
q.why_en: When turning left from a two-way street onto a one-way street, begin the turn with your left wheels as close as possible to the yellow center line, and turn into the nearest legal lane of the one-way street.
q.tip_en: Turn left hugging the center line

q.en: The first rule of a safe and legal turn is:
q.zh: 安全和合法转弯的第一条规则是。
oe: To give a proper turn signal
To move into the proper lane well before the turn
oz: 在转弯前就进入适当的车道
q.why: 安全合法转弯的第一步是提前驶入正确车道，然后再打转向灯、减速。
q.why_en: The first step in a safe, legal turn is to move into the proper lane well ahead of the turn, then signal and slow down.
q.tip_en: Get in lane first, then signal

q.en: Making U-turns is not legal in which of the following areas?
q.zh: 调头在以下哪个地区是不合法的？
oe: Near a crest of a hill or in a curve
oz: 靠近山顶或曲线的地方
q.why: 在高速公路、坡顶或弯道附近、铁路道口等视线受限或危险地点都不得调头 (U-turn)。
q.why_en: U-turns are not allowed on highways, near the crest of a hill or in a curve, at railroad crossings, or anywhere else with limited visibility or danger.

q.en: When an animal suddenly runs in front of your vehicle, you must ____.
q.zh: 当一只动物突然跑到你的车辆前面时，你必须 ____。
oe: Concentrate on retaining control of your vehicle
Apply the brakes as hard as you can
oz: 专注于保持对车辆的控制
q.why: 动物突然窜出时，首要是保持对车辆的控制；急转避让 (swerve) 可能导致冲出道路或撞上对向车，后果更严重。
q.why_en: When an animal suddenly runs out, your first priority is keeping control of your vehicle; swerving can send you off the road or into oncoming traffic, with worse results.

q.en: When entering an interstate highway from the acceleration lane, you must ____.
q.zh: 当从加速车道进入州际公路时，你必须。
oe: Keep pace with other traffic or obey posted speed limits
Stop and wait for the space to merge
Increase your speed beyond posted speed limit to merge
oz: 与其他车辆保持同步或遵守规定的速度限制
提高你的速度，超过规定的速度限制，以便合并
q.why: 从加速车道进入州际公路时，应跟上车流速度但不超过限速，找空隙汇入；不要停下或超速。
q.why_en: When entering an interstate from the acceleration lane, keep pace with traffic without exceeding the speed limit and merge into a gap; don't stop or speed.

q.en: If you begin to skid on an icy road, the proper action is to
q.zh: 如果你在结冰的道路上开始打滑，正确的行动是。
oe: Step on the gas and turn the wheel to the right
Turn the front wheels in the direction of the skid and ease your foot off the gas
Turn the front wheels in the direction of the skid and step on the gas
Keep the wheels straight and let up on the accelerator
oz: 踩下油门，将方向盘转到右边
将前轮转向打滑的方向，并将你的脚从油门上放下来
将前轮转向打滑的方向，并踩下油门
保持车轮平直，松开油门
q.why: 冰面打滑时，松开油门，并把前轮转向车尾滑动的方向 (steer into the skid)，不要急刹或踩油门。
q.tip: 车尾往哪滑，方向往哪打
q.why_en: If you skid on ice, ease off the gas and turn the front wheels in the direction the rear is sliding (steer into the skid). Don't slam the brakes or step on the gas.
q.tip_en: Steer where the rear is sliding

q.en: If you are driving at a slower speed than other traffic on a highway or freeway, stay in the lane ____.
q.zh: 如果你在高速路或高速公路上以比其他车辆更慢的速度行驶，请留在车道上 ____。
oe: Nearest to the left side of the road
Farthest from the shoulder of the road
Nearest to the center of the road
Nearest to the right side of the road
q.why: 在高速上比其他车慢时，应留在最右侧车道 (right lane)。
q.why_en: If you are slower than other traffic on a highway, stay in the right lane.

q.en: What should you do if another driver tailgates your vehicle?
q.zh: 如果另一个司机追尾你的车辆，你应该怎么做？
oe: You must pull over to the side and allow the driver to pass
You must not allow the tailgater to pass you
You should raise your speed to discourage the tailgater
oz: 你必须把车停在一边，让司机通过
你必须不允许追尾者超过你
应提高车速，以阻止追尾者
q.why: 被后车紧跟 (tailgate) 时，应靠右或在安全处让其超过，不要加速或踩刹车“报复”。
q.why_en: If someone tailgates you, move right or let them pass where it is safe. Don't speed up or brake-check them.

q.en: are made to stop runaway vehicles safely without injuring drivers and passengers on steep mountain grades.
q.zh: 是为了在陡峭的山路上安全地阻止失控的车辆，而不伤害司机和乘客。
q.why: 避险车道 (escape ramp) 设在陡峭长下坡处，用于让刹车失灵的失控车辆安全停下。
q.why_en: An escape ramp is placed on long, steep downgrades so runaway vehicles (e.g., with brake failure) can stop safely.

q.en: If you see a solid white line between lanes of traffic, you must ____.
q.zh: 如果你看到车道之间有一条白色实线，你必须。
oz: 不停留在自己的车道上
q.why: 车道间的白色实线表示不鼓励/不允许变道，应留在本车道。
q.why_en: A solid white line between lanes means lane changes are discouraged or prohibited; stay in your lane.

q.en: When you see a triangle-shaped road sign while driving, you must ____.
q.zh: 当你在开车时看到三角形的路标，你必须。
q.why: 倒三角形标志是让行标志 (YIELD)：减速，必要时停车，让行行人和其他车辆。
q.why_en: A downward-pointing triangle is a YIELD sign: slow down, stop if necessary, and yield to pedestrians and other vehicles.

q.en: If someone is following you too closely, you must ____.
q.zh: 如果有人太过紧跟你，你必须。
oe: Slow down and encourage the driver to pass
Move on to the left lane
Discourage this action and not allow the driver to pass
oz: 放慢速度并鼓励司机通过
劝阻这种行为，不允许司机通过
q.why: 被紧跟时，应适当减速并靠右让对方超车，与其拉开距离；加速或阻挡对方都更危险。
q.why_en: If someone follows too closely, slow down a bit and move right to let them pass, increasing your distance from them. Speeding up or blocking them is more dangerous.

q.en: A driver must for a school bus that is stopped with its red lights flashing on the opposite side of the road.
q.zh: 司机必须为在道路对面停着的红灯闪烁的校车
q.why: 新泽西：对向停靠并闪红灯的校车，在没有安全岛/隆起隔离带的道路上，你也必须在至少 25 英尺外完全停车。
q.why_en: New Jersey: for a school bus stopped with red lights flashing on the opposite side of the road, if there is no safety island or raised median, you too must come to a complete stop at least 25 feet away.

q.en: are the most frequent type of crashes on interstates.
q.zh: 是高速公路上最常见的车祸类型
q.why: 州际公路上最常见的事故是追尾 (rear-end collisions)，多因跟车太近。（选项 B 中 Read-end 为 Rear-end 拼写错误。）
q.why_en: Rear-end collisions are the most common crashes on interstates, mostly caused by following too closely. ("Read-end" in option B is a typo for "Rear-end.")

q.en: When making a U-turn, you must NOT:
q.zh: 调头时，你不能
oe: Make it on a curve in the road or near a hill
Yield the right-of-way to oncoming vehicles
oz: 在道路的转弯处或靠近山丘的地方做
向迎面而来的车辆让出路权
q.why: 不得在弯道或坡顶附近调头，因为其他驾驶者看不到你。打灯、让行来车和行人都是调头时必须做的。
q.why_en: Don't make a U-turn on a curve or near a hill, because other drivers can't see you. Signaling and yielding to oncoming vehicles and pedestrians are all required when making a U-turn.

q.en: In preparing to leave a parallel parking spot, a driver should ____.
q.zh: 在准备离开平行停车位时，司机应该 ____。
oe: Look in the rear view mirror
q.why: 驶离平行停车位前要打灯示意、看后视镜、回头检查盲区，三者都要做。
q.why_en: Before pulling out of a parallel parking spot, signal, check your rearview mirror, and look over your shoulder for blind spots; do all three.

q.en: Traffic warning signs in work zones are usually:
q.zh: 工作区的交通警告标志通常是
q.why: 施工区 (work zone) 的警告标志通常为橙底黑字 (black on orange)。
q.why_en: Work zone warning signs are usually black on orange.

q.en: When approaching or driving through a work zone, you must not
q.zh: 当接近或驶过工作区时，你不得
oe: Keep up with the flow of the traffic
q.why: 经过施工区时不得在车道间穿插 (weave)；应减速、注意降低的限速，跟随车流。
q.why_en: Don't weave from lane to lane in a work zone; slow down, watch for reduced speed limits, and keep up with the flow of traffic.

q.en: If you are signaled by a flag person at/near a railroad crossing or construction site, you must ____.
q.zh: 如果你在铁路道口或建筑工地上/附近得到旗手的信号，你必须 ____。
oe: Follow signals if you are in the left lane
Follow signals if you are in the right lane
Follow signals, no matter which lane you are in
oz: 如果你在左边的车道上，请遵守信号
如果你在右边的车道上，请遵守信号
遵守信号，无论你在哪条车道上
q.why: 旗手 (flag person) 的指挥与交通信号同等效力，无论你在哪条车道都必须服从。
q.why_en: A flag person's signals carry the same authority as traffic signals; you must obey them no matter which lane you are in.

q.en: When a vehicle in front of you stops for a pedestrian:
q.zh: 当你前面的车辆为行人停车时
oe: You may pass the vehicle if there is lane to do so
You must not pass the vehicle
You may pass the vehicle only if you can see the pedestrian
You may pass the vehicle on the right only
oz: 如果有车道可供通行，你可以超过该车辆
只有在你能看到行人的情况下，你才能通过该车
q.why: 前车为行人停车时，你不得超越它，因为前车可能挡住了正在过马路的行人。
q.why_en: When a vehicle ahead stops for a pedestrian, you must not pass it, because it may be hiding a pedestrian who is crossing.

q.en: When driving a vehicle, unbalanced tires and low tire pressure can cause ____.
q.zh: 在驾驶车辆时，不平衡的轮胎和低轮胎压力会导致 ____。
q.why: 轮胎不平衡和胎压过低会导致轮胎更快磨损 (faster tire wear)，同时还会增加油耗、影响操控。
q.why_en: Unbalanced tires and low tire pressure cause faster tire wear, and also increase fuel use and hurt handling.

q.en: The likelihood of an accident increases if a driver is under the influence of
q.zh: 如果一个司机受到以下因素的影响，发生事故的可能性就会增加
q.why: 酒精、毒品和部分处方药都会降低判断力和反应速度，大大增加事故风险。
q.why_en: Alcohol, drugs and some prescription medications impair judgment and slow reactions, greatly increasing crash risk.

q.en: If you approach an intersection with a yellow light, you must ____.
q.zh: 如果你接近一个有黄灯的十字路口，你必须 ____。
oe: Slow down and proceed with caution, if a stop cannot be made safely
Increase your speed and clear the intersection
Stop and wait for the red light
Stop, look for the pedestrians, and proceed with caution
oz: 放慢速度，谨慎前行，如果不能安全地停车
停下来，寻找行人，并谨慎前进
q.why: 黄灯表示即将变红：能安全停车就应停车；若已无法安全停下（太靠近路口），应谨慎通过。不要加速抢灯。
q.why_en: A yellow light means the signal is about to turn red: stop if you can do so safely; if you're too close to stop safely, proceed with caution. Don't speed up to beat the light.

q.en: When it looks like a collision may happen, drivers must take an immediate step to
q.zh: 当看起来可能发生碰撞时，司机必须立即采取措施，以
oe: Stop or slow down their vehicles
oz: 停下或放慢他们的车辆
q.why: 避免碰撞时可以采取三种方式：停车或减速、转向避让、必要时加速，按情况选择，所以选“以上任何一种”。
q.why_en: To avoid a collision you can stop or slow down, steer away, or speed up if necessary, depending on the situation, so the answer is "Any of the above."

q.en: Which of the following are two types of speed signs?
q.zh: 以下哪种是速度标志的两种类型
oe: Accident speed signs and advisory speed signs
Advisory speed signs and informational speed signs
Speed limit signs and advisory speed signs
Speed limit signs and accident speed signs
oz: 事故速度标志和建议速度标志
建议性速度标志和信息性速度标志
限速标志和提示性速度标志
限速标志和事故速度标志
q.why: 速度标志分两类：法定限速标志 (speed limit signs，白底黑字) 和建议速度标志 (advisory speed signs，黄底，常配合弯道警告)。
q.why_en: There are two types of speed signs: speed limit signs (black on white) and advisory speed signs (yellow, often paired with curve warnings).

q.en: When you see an elderly person crossing an intersection, you should ____.
q.zh: 当你看到一个老人穿过一个十字路口时，你应该 ____。
oe: Stop your vehicle and yield the right of way
Increase the speed of your vehicle and cross the intersection quickly
Blow the horn to stop the person
oz: 停下你的车辆并让出路权
加快你的车速，迅速穿过十字路口
按响喇叭以阻止该行人
q.why: 看到老人或行人过路口时，应停车并让行 (yield)，耐心等待，不要按喇叭催促。
q.why_en: When an elderly person or any pedestrian is crossing an intersection, stop and yield the right-of-way. Be patient and don't honk to rush them.

q.en: When approaching an intersection to make a right turn, you must keep ____ to the right curb.
q.zh: 当接近十字路口准备右转时，你必须保持 ____ 靠近右路边。
oe: As far to the left as possible
As far to the right as possible
q.why: 右转前应尽量靠右，贴近右侧路缘 (curb)，从最右侧车道转入最右侧车道。
q.why_en: Before a right turn, keep as far right as possible, close to the right curb, turning from the right-most lane into the right-most lane.

q.en: A highway work zone can be easily identified by immediately preceding the work zone.
q.zh: 高速公路工作区可以通过紧接在工作区之前的方式来轻松识别
oz: 一个绿色的三角形符号
一个红色八角形的标志
q.why: 施工区前方会设置橙底黑字 (black-on-orange) 的警告标志，用以识别施工区。
q.why_en: A black-on-orange warning sign is placed ahead of a work zone to identify it.

q.en: A ____ on a two-way road allows you to cross over into the oncoming lane temporarily to pass a vehicle, if it is safe to do so.
q.zh: 双向道路上的 ____ 允许你在安全的情况下，暂时越过对面的车道来超过一辆车。
q.why: 双向道路上的黄色虚线 (broken yellow line) 表示在安全时可以越线超车。黄色实线则禁止超车。
q.why_en: A broken yellow line on a two-way road means you may cross it to pass when it is safe. A solid yellow line prohibits passing.
q.tip_en: Broken yellow may pass; solid yellow no passing

q.en: When slowing down or stopping, you must:
q.zh: 在减速或停车时，你必须
oe: Use an arm signal to alert the driver behind you
Use the brake-operated signal lights to alert the driver behind you
Both a & B Either A or B
oz: 使用手臂信号来提醒你后面的司机
使用刹车信号灯提醒后面的司机
任一的 indicates the outside edge of the traffic lane, and may be crossed only by traffic moving to or from the shoulder.
q.why: 减速或停车时，可以用刹车灯或手势信号（手臂向下）任一方式提醒后车。
q.flag: 答案疑似应为 C：选项 D 为空，C 文本“Both a & B Either A or B”为乱码合并；正确意思是“A 或 B 皆可 (Either A or B)”。
q.why_en: When slowing or stopping, you may alert drivers behind you with either your brake lights or a hand signal (arm down).
q.flag_en: The answer is likely C: option D is blank, and C's text "Both a & B Either A or B" is a garbled merge; the intended meaning is "Either A or B."

q.en: A ____ indicates the outside edge of the traffic lane, and may be crossed only by traffic moving to or from the shoulder.
q.zh: ____ 表示交通车道的外侧边缘，只能由进出路肩的车辆穿过。
q.why: 白色实线边线 (solid white edge line) 标示车道外侧边缘，只有驶入或驶出路肩 (shoulder) 的车辆可以越过。
q.why_en: A solid white edge line marks the outside edge of the traffic lane; only traffic moving to or from the shoulder may cross it.

q.en: Drivers must maintain a constant speed when passing and reentering the lane in front of trucks or buses, since trucks/buses require ____.
q.zh: 驾驶员在超过和重新进入卡车或公共汽车前面的车道时必须保持恒定的速度，因为卡车/公共汽车需要 ____。
oe: Shorter distances to slow down than cars
Longer distances to slow down than cars
oz: 减速的距离比小汽车短
比小汽车有更长的减速距离
q.why: 卡车和巴士比小汽车需要更长的减速/停车距离，所以超车后并回其前方时要保持速度，不要突然减速。
q.why_en: Trucks and buses need longer distances to slow down or stop than cars, so keep your speed when you pull back in front of them after passing; don't slow down suddenly.
q.tip_en: Big vehicles need longer to stop

q.en: At an unmarked crosswalk, drivers are required to
q.zh: 在没有标志的人行横道上，司机需要：
oe: Yield the right-of-way to the pedestrians
Stop and request the pedestrians to cross quickly
Increase the speed of their vehicle and cross before the pedestrians
oz: 示意他们的意图并继续前进
停车并要求行人快速通过
加快他们的车速，在行人之前过马路
q.why: 在没有标线的人行横道 (unmarked crosswalk，路口处也算) 上，司机同样必须让行行人。
q.why_en: At an unmarked crosswalk (an intersection counts too), drivers must still yield to pedestrians.

q.en: Drivers must be cautious if it starts to rain on a hot day, because pavement can be very slippery for the first few minutes due to
q.zh: 如果在热天开始下雨，司机必须谨慎，因为路面在最初的几分钟内可能会非常湿滑，这是由于
q.why: 炎热天气刚下雨的最初几分钟，沥青路面中的油 (oil in the asphalt) 浮到表面，与水混合非常湿滑。
q.why_en: In the first few minutes of rain on a hot day, oil in the asphalt rises to the surface and mixes with water, making the pavement very slippery.
q.tip_en: Roads are slickest when rain first starts

q.en: If another driver is passing your vehicle, you must ____.
q.zh: 如果另一个司机正在超过你的车辆，你必须 ____。
oe: Pull your vehicle to the right and do not increase your speed
Stay in the lane and do not increase your speed
oz: 将你的车辆停在右边，不要提高你的速度
保持在车道上，不要增加你的速度
q.why: 被超车时，保持在本车道并不要加速，让对方顺利完成超车。
q.why_en: When someone is passing you, stay in your lane and don't speed up, so they can complete the pass.

q.en: If you have already started through an intersection when the signal light changes, you must ____.
q.zh: 如果你在信号灯变化时已经开始通过一个交叉路口，你必须 ____。
oe: Follow through and proceed to clear the intersection
Change your direction and make a left or right turn
q.why: 如果信号变化时你已经进入路口，应继续行驶，尽快安全地驶离路口，不要停在路口中间。
q.why_en: If you're already in the intersection when the signal changes, keep going and clear the intersection safely; don't stop in the middle.

q.en: You must NOT pass a vehicle on the right when ____.
q.zh: 在下列情况下，你不得在右侧超过车辆 ____。
oe: Oncoming vehicles are not making a left turn
You are driving on a one-way road with two lanes of traffic
The vehicle ahead is making a right turn
The vehicle ahead is going straight
oz: 迎面而来的车辆没有进行左转弯
你正在一条有两条车道的单行道上行驶
前方车辆正在进行右转弯
q.why: 前车正在右转时不得从其右侧超车，会与其转弯路径冲突。
q.why_en: Don't pass on the right of a vehicle that is turning right; you'd cut across its turning path.

q.en: It is against the law to make a left turn on red light EXCEPT ____.
q.zh: 在红灯时左转是违法的，但以下情况除外 ____。
oe: From a one-way street to a two-way street
From a two-way street to a one-way street
From a two-way street to a two-way street
oz: 从单行道到另一个单行道
q.why: 新泽西红灯左转只允许从单行道转入另一单行道 (one-way to one-way)，且需先停车让行，并无禁止标志。
q.tip: 红灯左转：单行道→单行道
q.why_en: In New Jersey, a left turn on red is allowed only from one one-way street onto another, after stopping and yielding, and only if no sign prohibits it.
q.tip_en: Left on red: one-way to one-way

q.en: Which of the following does not generally lead to loss of driving privileges in the state of New Jersey?
q.zh: 以下哪项通常不会导致新泽西驾驶权的丧失？
oe: A single speeding conviction 单次超速
Driving with a suspended license 以暂停的驾照驾驶
Failure to appear in court 未能出庭
Failure to provide proof of insurance 未能提供保险证明
q.why: 单次超速通常只记分、罚款，不会直接导致丧失驾驶权；而以被暂停的驾照驾驶、未出庭、未能提供保险证明都可能导致驾照被暂停。
q.flag: 选项中英文混在同一栏（中文栏为空），不影响答案 A。
q.why_en: A single speeding conviction usually brings only points and a fine, not loss of driving privileges. Driving with a suspended license, failure to appear in court and failure to provide proof of insurance can all lead to suspension.
q.flag_en: The Chinese option text is merged into the English column (the Chinese column is empty); this does not affect answer A.

q.en: Double solid yellow lines on the road separate two lanes of traffic ____.
q.zh: 道路上的双实心黄线将两条车道分隔开来 ____。
q.why: 双黄实线分隔对向 (opposite direction) 行驶的车流，两个方向都禁止越线超车。
q.why_en: Double solid yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions; passing across them is prohibited in both directions.

q.en: Which of the following must NOT be done if your vehicle’s tire blows out?
q.zh: 如果你的车辆的轮胎爆裂，以下哪项不能做
q.why: 爆胎时不要立即急刹，否则容易失控；应紧握方向盘、保持直行、松开油门让车慢慢减速后再轻踩刹车。
q.flag: 选项 C 为空，不影响答案 B。
q.why_en: After a tire blowout, don't brake immediately or you may lose control. Hold the steering wheel tightly, steer straight ahead, and ease off the gas to let the car slow down before braking gently.
q.flag_en: Option C is empty; this does not affect answer B.

q.en: If you are having vehicle trouble, and need to stop, first step your should do is
q.zh: 如果你的车辆有问题，需要停下来，你应该做的第一步是。
oe: Lift the hood of signal an emergency
Check your driver’s manual for help
Pull off the road and away from traffic
Stop your vehicle over a hill or just around a curve for visibility
oz: 掀开引擎盖，发出紧急信号
查看你的驾驶手册以获得帮助
把车停在路边，远离交通车辆
在一个山坡上或在一个弯道上停车，以保证能见度
q.why: 车辆故障需停车时，第一步是驶离道路，远离车流；然后再开双闪、抬起引擎盖等求助。不要停在坡顶或弯道后。
q.why_en: If you have vehicle trouble and need to stop, first pull off the road and away from traffic; then turn on your hazard lights, raise the hood, etc. to get help. Don't stop just over a hill or around a curve.

q.en: On a multi-lane roundabout, if you intend to exit the roundabout less than halfway around it, use
q.zh: 在一个多车道的环岛上，如果你打算在环岛的一半以内离开环岛，请使用
q.why: 多车道环岛中，若在环岛不到一半处（如右转）驶出，应使用右侧车道。左转或调头用左侧车道。
q.why_en: In a multi-lane roundabout, if you will exit less than halfway around (e.g., a right turn), use the right lane. Use the left lane for left turns or U-turns.

q.en: When driving on a road with no center line, where vehicles come from each direction, drivers must ____.
q.zh: 在没有中心线的道路上行驶，车辆来自各个方向时，驾驶员必须 ____。
oe: Always drive on the left of the center lane
Use the full lane when there is no oncoming traffic
Give at least half the road to others going in the opposite direction
oz: 始终在中间车道的左侧行驶
在没有来车的情况下，使用全车道
将至少一半的道路让给相反方向的车
q.why: 没有中心线的道路上，必须至少给对向来车留出一半路面。
q.why_en: On a road with no center line, you must give oncoming traffic at least half the road.

q.en: A steady red arrow means:
q.zh: 一个稳定的红色箭头意味着。
oe: You must come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so
You can safely turn in the direction of the arrow
You must stop and you cannot go in the direction of the arrow
You should prepare to stop and give the right of way to oncoming traffic before turning
oz: 你必须完全停止，然后在安全的情况下继续前进
你可以安全地沿着箭头的方向转弯
你必须停下来，你不能往箭头的方向走
你应该在转弯前准备好停车并将路权让给迎面而来的车辆
q.why: 红色箭头 (steady red arrow) 表示必须停车，不得向箭头方向转弯，直到出现绿灯或绿色箭头。红箭头不允许红灯右转式的“停后再转”。
q.why_en: A steady red arrow means you must stop and may not turn in the direction of the arrow until a green light or green arrow appears. Unlike right on red, you may not stop and then turn.

q.en: In a roundabout intersection, drivers must , whether they need to make a right turn, left turn, a U-turn or continue forward.
q.zh: 在一个环形交叉路口，司机必须如何，他们是否需要右转、左转、调头或继续前进。
oe: Turn right and then turn left
Turn left and then turn right
Turn right and merge into the circle
Turn left and merge into the circle
q.why: 美国环岛为逆时针行驶，进入时一律右转汇入环岛 (turn right and merge)，无论最终去哪个方向。
q.why_en: U.S. roundabouts run counterclockwise, so you always turn right and merge into the circle, whatever direction you're ultimately headed.
q.tip_en: Always turn right into a roundabout

q.en: When you are turning from a one-way street onto a two-way or divided street, always turn from ____.
q.zh: 当你从单行道转入双行道或分叉道时，总是从 ____。
oe: The lane farthest from the curb
The lane nearest to the curb
oz: 离路边最远的那条车道
q.why: 从单行道转入双向或分隔道路时，应从最靠近路缘 (curb) 的车道转弯：右转从最右车道、左转从最左车道。
q.why_en: When turning from a one-way street onto a two-way or divided street, turn from the lane nearest the curb on that side: right turns from the right-most lane, left turns from the left-most lane.

q.en: If an approaching vehicle has its turn signal on, you must and then start your turn if it is safe.
q.zh: 如果接近的车辆打开了转向灯，你必须在安全的情况下，再开始转弯
oe: Wait until the other driver actually starts to turn
oz: 等到对方司机真正开始转弯
q.why: 对向车打了转向灯并不代表它一定会转，应等对方实际开始转弯后，确认安全再开始你的转弯。
q.why_en: An oncoming driver's turn signal doesn't guarantee they will turn; wait until they actually start turning, then begin your turn when it is safe.
q.tip_en: A signal isn't a turn; wait for the move

q.en: Black on orange signs on a highway identify:
q.zh: 高速公路上的橙底黑字标识
oe: Specific information and directions to drivers in work zones
oz: 前方有特殊情况或危险
在工作区向司机提供具体信息和指示
q.why: 高速上的橙底黑字标志用于施工区，提供施工区内的特定信息和指示。
q.why_en: Black-on-orange signs on highways are used in work zones to give drivers specific information and directions.

q.en: When two or more lanes of travel are permitted in the same direction, a broken white lane is used ____.
q.zh: 当允许在同一方向有两条或更多的车道行驶时，要使用虚白色车道 ____。
oe: To indicate the right edge of the roadway
To divide each side of the highway into separate lanes for vehicles traveling in the same direction
To divide each side of the highway into separate lanes for vehicles traveling in different direction
To indicate the left edge of the roadway
oz: 将高速公路的每一侧划分为独立的车道，供同方向行驶的车辆使用
将高速公路的每一侧划分为不同的车道，供不同方向的车辆行驶。
q.why: 同向多车道时，白色虚线将道路一侧分隔成多条同向车道，可在安全时变道。
q.why_en: With two or more lanes in the same direction, broken white lines divide each side of the road into separate lanes; you may change lanes when safe.

q.en: Which of the following is not a true statement regarding railroad crossings?
q.zh: 以下哪项不是关于铁路交叉口的真实陈述？
oe: It is always important to check for more than one track before crossing
Never start to cross if there is not room for your vehicle on the far side
Drivers must yield to crossing trains
It is wise to shift gears when crossing railroad tracks
oz: 在穿越之前，检查是否有一个以上的轨道始终是很重要的。
如果远处没有空间容纳你的车辆，千万不要开始过马路。
司机必须礼让过路列车
在穿越铁轨时，明智的做法是换挡
q.why: 过铁路道口时不应换挡，以免车辆熄火停在轨道上，因此 D 是错误说法。其他三项都正确。
q.why_en: Don't shift gears while crossing railroad tracks, or you may stall on the tracks, so D is the false statement. The other three are true.

q.en: If a New Jersey driver is convicted of consuming an alcoholic beverage while operating a vehicle, he or she will receive an additional fine of for the first offence.
q.zh: 新泽西司机在驾驶时饮酒，初犯将被处以 罚款。
q.why: 新泽西规定驾驶时饮酒 (consuming alcohol while driving)，初犯罚款 $200。
q.why_en: In New Jersey, a first offense for consuming alcohol while driving carries a $200 fine.

q.en: Upon a NJ driver’s third DUI conviction, he or she could spend up to days in jail.
q.zh: 新泽西司机第三次酒驾将被拘役 天。
q.why: 新泽西第三次酒驾 (DUI) 定罪可被判最多 180 天监禁。
q.why_en: A third DUI conviction in New Jersey can bring up to 180 days in jail.

q.en: Which of the following are alternatives to drinking and driving?
q.zh: 以下哪种可替代酒后驾车？
oe: All of these answers are correct
q.why: 指定司机 (designated driver)、叫出租车、乘公共交通都是替代酒后驾驶的方法。
q.why_en: A designated driver, a taxi and public transportation are all alternatives to drinking and driving.

q.en: If ice falls from a NJ driver’s vehicle and results in property damage, he or she could be fined up to:
q.zh: 如果冰从新泽西司机的车辆上掉落并导致财产损失，其可能被处以最高 罚款。
q.why: 新泽西规定：车上冰雪掉落造成财产损失或人身伤害，普通车辆司机可被罚最高 $1,000。
q.why_en: New Jersey law: if ice or snow falls from a vehicle and causes property damage or injury, a non-commercial driver can be fined up to $1,000.

q.en: What should you do, if you miss your exit on an expressway?
q.zh: 在高速公路错过了出口怎么办？
oe: You must back up to reach your exit
You must stop and ask for help
You must try to turn around
You must continue on to the next exit
oz: 必须继续开走下一个出口
q.why: 在高速错过出口时，继续开到下一个出口；绝不可倒车、停车或掉头。
q.why_en: If you miss your exit on an expressway, continue to the next exit; never back up, stop or turn around.

q.en: According to the New Jersey Driver Manual, if a driver has a BAC of 0.05% or higher, his or her chance of causing an accident .
q.zh: 根据新泽西司机手册，如果司机的血液酒精含量为 0.05%或更高，其造成事故的可能将会 。
q.why: NJ 司机手册指出：血液酒精含量 (BAC) 达到 0.05% 时，造成事故的几率约为清醒时的两倍 (doubles)；BAC 越高风险上升越快。
q.why_en: The NJ Driver Manual says that at a BAC of 0.05%, a driver's chance of causing a crash roughly doubles compared with being sober; the risk climbs faster as BAC rises.

q.en: Failing to stop at a crosswalk will result in the additional of ____ points to a New Jersey driving record.
q.zh: 未能停在人行横道将导致增加 分到新泽西驾驶记录里。
q.why: 未在人行横道为行人停车/让行 (failure to stop for pedestrian in crosswalk) 记 2 分。
q.why_en: Failing to stop for a pedestrian in a crosswalk adds 2 points.

q.en: If a NJ driver is convicted of driving while in possession of drugs, his or her license will be lost for:
q.zh: 新泽西司机驾驶时持有毒品将被吊销驾照
q.why: 驾驶时持有毒品 (possession of drugs while driving) 定罪后吊销驾照 2 年。
q.why_en: A conviction for possession of drugs while driving costs you your license for 2 years.

q.en: Which of the following does not generally lead to loss of driving privileges in the state of New Jersey:
q.zh: 以下哪项通常不会导致新泽西驾驶权的丧失：
oe: Failure to provide proof of insurance
q.why: 单次超速通常只记分、罚款，不会直接导致丧失驾驶权；而无照(暂停期)驾驶、未出庭、未能提供保险证明都可能导致驾照被暂停。
q.why_en: A single speeding conviction usually brings only points and a fine, not loss of driving privileges. Driving with a suspended license, failure to appear in court and failure to provide proof of insurance can all lead to suspension.

q.en: A hit and run conviction may result in which of the following penalties:
q.zh: 肇事逃逸的处罚是
oe: Loss of license for one year
All of these answers are correct
q.why: 肇事逃逸（事故致人受伤后离开现场）初犯可被罚款最高 $5,000、拘役 180 天、吊销驾照 1 年，所以选"以上皆是"。
q.why_en: Leaving the scene of a crash involving injury (hit and run), first offense: fine up to $5,000, 180 days in jail and loss of license for 1 year — so "All of these answers are correct."

q.en: If a NJ driver who is under the age of twenty-one is convicted of purchasing or consuming alcohol in a business, he or she could be fined up to     and lose his or her license for up to   months.    21
q.zh: 岁 以 下 的新泽西司机在驾驶时购买或饮用酒精将被处以最高 罚款并吊销驾照最长 个月。
q.why: 未满 21 岁者在营业场所购买或饮用酒精，可被罚款最高 $500，并暂停（或推迟取得）驾照最长 6 个月。
q.why_en: A person under 21 convicted of buying or drinking alcohol in a licensed establishment can be fined up to $500 and have their license suspended (or postponed) for up to 6 months.

q.en: NJ drivers who abandon their vehicles along the roadside of limited access highways for more than ____ hours may be penalized.
q.zh: 新泽西司机将自己的车辆遗弃在出口有限的告诉路边超过  小时可能被处罚。
q.why: 在限制出入的高速公路 (limited-access highway) 路边弃车超过 4 小时可被处罚（驾照可被暂停）。
q.why_en: Abandoning a vehicle on the roadside of a limited-access highway for more than 4 hours can be penalized (including license suspension).

q.en: Driving eleven miles per hour over the posted speed limit will result in the addition of ____ points.
q.zh: 超过限速 11 英里时速将增加 ____ 分。
q.why: 超速 1–14 mph 记 2 分；超 11 mph 属于这一档。
q.why_en: Speeding 1–14 mph over the limit is 2 points; 11 mph over falls in this range.

q.en: Driving twenty-seven miles per hour over the posted speed limit will result in the addition of ____ points.
q.zh: 超过限速 27 英里时速将增加 ____ 分。
q.why: 超速 15–29 mph 记 4 分；超 27 mph 属于这一档。
q.why_en: Speeding 15–29 mph over the limit is 4 points; 27 mph over falls in this range.

q.en: Driving thirty or more miles per hour over the posted speed limit will result in the addition of ____ points.
q.zh: 超过限速 30 英里时速或更多将增加 ____ 分。
q.why: 超速 30 mph 及以上记 5 分（最高一档）。
q.why_en: Speeding 30 mph or more over the limit is 5 points (the top tier).

q.en: points removed from his or her driving record.
q.zh: 成功完成批准的驾驶员改进计划，新泽西司机可以从其驾驶记录中删除   分。
q.why: 完成 MVC 批准的驾驶员改进计划 (Driver Improvement Program) 可从记录中减去 3 分；而自愿参加的防御性驾驶课 (defensive driving course) 只减 2 分，注意区分。
q.tip: 改进计划 3 分，防御驾驶 2 分
q.flag: 英文题干缺失前半句（应为"成功完成批准的驾驶员改进计划后，可从记录中删除几分"），答案 A 正确。
q.why_en: Completing an MVC-approved Driver Improvement Program removes 3 points from your record; a voluntary defensive driving course removes only 2. Don't mix them up.
q.flag_en: The English stem is missing its first half (it should ask how many points are removed after successfully completing an approved Driver Improvement Program). Answer A is correct.

q.en: If a New Jersey driver fails to comply with a police officer’s request to illuminate the inside of his or her vehicle during a traffic stop, he or she will be fined    .
q.zh: 如果新泽西司机不服从警务人员在交通中止期间对其照亮车辆内部的要求，他/她将被处以   罚款。
q.why: 按题库所依据的手册，交通拦截时拒绝按警察要求打开车内照明，罚款 $50。
q.why_en: Per the manual this question bank is based on, refusing a police officer's request to illuminate the inside of your vehicle during a traffic stop carries a $50 fine.

q.en: If a driver is convicted of consuming alcohol while operating a vehicle a second time, he or she will be required to complete     days of community service.
q.zh: 被第二次定罪为驾驶时饮酒将被要求完成   天的社区服务。
q.why: 驾驶时饮酒 (consuming alcohol while operating a vehicle) 属单独违法：初犯罚款 $200，再犯罚款 $250 或 10 天社区服务。注意与第二次酒驾 (DUI) 的 30 天社区服务区分。
q.tip: 边开边喝再犯 = 10 天社区服务
q.why_en: Consuming alcohol while operating a vehicle is a separate offense: $200 fine for a first offense; $250 fine or 10 days of community service for a second. Don't confuse it with the 30 days of community service for a second DUI.
q.tip_en: Drinking while driving, 2nd offense = 10 days community service

q.en: A conviction of driving without insurance will result in up to a ____ loss of driving privileges.
q.zh: 驾驶没有保险的车辆将导致驾驶权丧失最高 ____。
q.why: 无保险驾驶初犯：罚款 $300–$1,000、社区服务，并丧失驾驶权 1 年。
q.why_en: Driving without insurance, first offense: $300–$1,000 fine, community service, and loss of driving privileges for 1 year.

q.en: What is the legal BAC limit for New Jersey drivers who are under the age of twenty-one? 21
q.zh: 岁以下的新泽西司机合法血液酒精含量(BAC)为 。
q.why: NJ 对 21 岁以下司机实行"零容忍"：BAC 达到 0.01% 即违法（手册原文为 0.01% or more）。题库以"合法 = 0.00%"作答，即完全不能有酒精。
q.flag: 选项 C (0.01%) 是手册原文中的违法门槛；若题目问"违法界限"应选 C，按"可合法的含量"理解则为 D (0.00%)。考试中若出现 0.01% 一般选 C。
q.why_en: NJ has zero tolerance for drivers under 21: a BAC of 0.01% or more is illegal (the manual's wording). The question bank treats the legal level as 0.00%, i.e., no alcohol at all.
q.flag_en: Option C (0.01%) is the manual's illegal threshold; if the question asks for the illegal limit, pick C. Read as "the amount you may legally have," it's D (0.00%). On the exam, if 0.01% appears, it's usually C.

q.en: What is the legal BAC limit for individuals who are 21 years of age or older in the state of New Jersey? 21
q.zh: 岁及以上的新泽西司机合法血液酒精含量(BAC)为 。
q.why: NJ 规定 21 岁及以上司机 BAC 达到 0.08% 或以上即构成酒驾 (DUI)。题库给的 0.07% 是把"合法"理解为"0.08% 以下"。
q.flag: 答案疑似应为 B：NJ 法定限值 (legal limit) 是 0.08%，真实考试通常选 0.08%。
q.why_en: In NJ, drivers 21 and older are DUI at a BAC of 0.08% or more. The bank's 0.07% reads "legal" as "below 0.08%."
q.flag_en: The answer is likely B: NJ's legal limit is 0.08%, and the real test usually expects 0.08%.

q.en: Upon his or her second DUI conviction, a driver could spend up to days in jail.
q.zh: 第二次酒驾的司机将被拘役 天。
q.why: 第二次酒驾 (2nd DUI)：拘役 48 小时至 90 天，罚款 $500–$1,000，30 天社区服务。
q.why_en: Second DUI: 48 hours to 90 days in jail, $500–$1,000 fine, 30 days of community service.

q.en: A second DUI conviction will result in up to a year loss of license.
q.zh: 第二次酒驾将被吊销驾照最长 年。
q.why: 第二次酒驾吊销驾照 1–2 年（并需安装点火互锁装置 IID），最长 2 年。
q.why_en: Second DUI: license loss of 1–2 years (plus an ignition interlock device), so up to 2 years.

q.en: The maximum fine for a second DUI in the state of NJ is:
q.zh: 新泽西州对第二次酒驾的最高罚款为
q.why_en: Second DUI fine is $500–$1,000, so the maximum is $1,000.

q.en: To cause the loss of license, multiple DUI offences must occur within years.
q.zh: 年内发生多次酒驾违法行为将被吊销驾照。
q.why: 多次酒驾按 10 年期计算：若两次违法间隔超过 10 年，第二次可按初犯处理 (step-down)。
q.why_en: Repeat DUIs are counted over a 10-year window: if more than 10 years pass between offenses, the second can be treated as a first (step-down).

q.en: The penalty for a first refusal charge may include loss of driving privileges for up to:
q.zh: 第一次拒绝（化学测试）的处罚可能包括丧失驾驶全长达 。
q.why: 首次拒绝化学测试 (refusal) 处罚按该题库手册为丧失驾驶权 7 个月至 1 年，最长 1 年。
q.why_en: Per this bank's manual, a first refusal (to submit to chemical testing) brings loss of driving privileges for 7 months to 1 year, so up to 1 year.

q.en: If a New Jersey driver is convicted of a third DUI charge within a ten year period, his or her driving privileges may be lost for up to years.
q.zh: 新泽西司机在 10 年内第三次被定罪酒驾将丧失驾驶权最长 年。
q.why: 按旧版手册，10 年内第三次酒驾丧失驾驶权 10 年、拘役 180 天。（2019 年后新法改为 8 年，但选项中没有 8，题库答案为 10。）
q.why_en: Under the older manual, a third DUI within 10 years means loss of driving privileges for 10 years and 180 days in jail. (The 2019 law changed this to 8 years, but 8 isn't an option; the bank's answer is 10.)

q.en: A conviction of racing on a highway in the state of New Jersey will result in the addition of ____ points.
q.zh: 在新泽西高速上赛车将导致增加 分。
q.why: 在公路上赛车 (racing on highway) 记 5 分。
q.why_en: Racing on a highway adds 5 points.

q.en: Tailgating is a dangerous practice that will result in a point addition upon conviction.
q.zh: 紧贴跟车是一种危险的做法，将导致增加 分。
q.why: 紧贴跟车 (tailgating) 定罪记 5 分。
q.why_en: A tailgating conviction adds 5 points.

q.en: If there is another driver tailgating you, you should NOT:
q.zh: 如果另一个司机紧贴跟着你的车，你不应该
oe: Provide more space to allow them to pass
q.why: 被人紧跟时不应加速，那样更危险；应保持车速或适当减速、靠右让其超车。
q.why_en: Don't speed up when someone is tailgating you — that makes it more dangerous. Keep your speed or slow down a bit, and move right to let them pass.

q.en: Following too closely behind a vehicle is also known as:
q.zh: 太近的跟车也被称为
q.why: 跟车太近称为紧贴跟车 (tailgating)。
q.why_en: Following too closely is called tailgating.

q.en: When driving on freeways, the condition that makes you feel that you are going slower than your actual speed is known as:
q.zh: 在高速公路上行使，你感觉到的速度比实际速度低的情况被称为
q.why: 长时间高速行驶后会觉得车速比实际慢，这叫 velocitizing（速度错觉）；要常看车速表。公路催眠 (highway hypnosis) 是指单调驾驶导致昏沉，不是一回事。
q.why_en: After long stretches at high speed, you feel slower than you really are — this is velocitizing, so check your speedometer often. Highway hypnosis is drowsiness from monotonous driving; it's a different thing.

q.en: occurs on wet roads when your front tires start to ride on water instead of the road.
q.zh: 在潮湿的道路上，当你的前轮胎开始在水面上而不是在路面上行驶时，就会发生这种情况
q.why: 湿滑路面上轮胎骑在水膜上而非路面，称为湿路打滑 (hydroplaning)。
q.why_en: When your tires ride on a film of water instead of the road surface on wet pavement, that's hydroplaning.

q.en: In a standard passenger car, partial hydroplaning can begin at speeds as low as:
q.zh: 标准乘用车，导致部分湿路滑胎的速度可低至
q.why: NJ 手册：普通乘用车在约 35 mph 时就可能开始部分滑水，到约 55 mph 时轮胎可能完全浮在水面上。
q.why_en: NJ Driver Manual: a typical passenger car can start partially hydroplaning at about 35 mph, and by about 55 mph the tires may ride completely on the water.

q.en: If you are driving on a highway in heavy rain, you must slow down your vehicle to avoid:
q.zh: 如果你在大雨中行驶在高速公路上，你必须减速以避免
q.why: 大雨中减速是防止湿路打滑 (hydroplaning) 的关键。
q.why_en: Slowing down in heavy rain is the key to preventing hydroplaning.

q.en: A reckless driving conviction could result in up to days in jail for New Jersey drivers.
q.zh: 新泽西司机被定罪鲁莽驾驶将被拘役 天。
q.why: 鲁莽驾驶 (reckless driving) 初犯：最高拘役 60 天、罚款 $50–$200，记 5 分。
q.why_en: Reckless driving, first offense: up to 60 days in jail, $50–$200 fine, and 5 points.

q.en: The fine for a first offence of failing to maintain auto insurance is up to:
q.zh: 第一次不买车险将被罚款
q.why: 未维持车险初犯：罚款 $300–$1,000，社区服务，驾照暂停 1 年。
q.why_en: Failing to maintain auto insurance, first offense: $300–$1,000 fine, community service, and 1-year license suspension.

q.en: A second conviction of failing to maintain auto insurance may result in a fine of up to for New Jersey drivers.
q.zh: 新泽西司机第二次不买车险将被处以高达 的罚款。
q.why: 未维持车险再犯：罚款最高 $5,000，拘役 14 天，驾照暂停 2 年。
q.why_en: Failing to maintain auto insurance, second offense: fine up to $5,000, 14 days in jail, and 2-year license suspension.

q.en: A second conviction of failing to maintain auto insurance will result in imprisonment for days.
q.zh: 第二次不买车险将被拘役 天。
q.why: 未维持车险再犯须拘役 14 天。
q.why_en: A second conviction for failing to maintain auto insurance requires 14 days in jail.

q.en: The maximum imprisonment for a first DUI offence in the state of New Jersey is days.
q.zh: 新泽西州对第一次酒驾最高监禁 天。
q.why: 首次酒驾最高可拘役 30 天。
q.tip: 初犯 30 天，二犯 90 天，三犯 180 天
q.why_en: A first DUI can bring up to 30 days in jail.

q.en: Which of the following fees must be paid upon a NJ driver’s first DUI offence:
q.zh: 新泽西司机第一次酒驾必须支付以下哪项费用
oe: All of these answers are correct
q.why: 初次酒驾除罚款外需缴：$100 醉驾执法基金 (Drunk Driving Enforcement Fund)、$100 酒精教育与康复基金 (AERF)、$75 安全社区基金 (Safe Neighborhood Fund) 等，所以选"以上皆是"。
q.why_en: Besides the fine, a first DUI requires paying $100 to the Drunk Driving Enforcement Fund, $100 to the Alcohol Education and Rehabilitation Fund (AERF), and $75 to the Safe Neighborhood Fund, among others — so "All of these answers are correct."

q.en: The minimum ignition interlock device (IID) installation period for a first DUI conviction is:
q.zh: 第一次酒驾定罪的点火互锁装置安装周期最短为
oe: 1 year from the restoration of driving privileges
Six months from the restoration of driving privileges
oz: 从驾驶权恢复起6 个月
q.why: 按该题库手册，初次酒驾须在驾驶权恢复后安装点火互锁装置 (IID) 6 个月至 1 年，最短为"恢复后 6 个月"。注意 C 漏了"从恢复驾驶权起算"。
q.why_en: Per this bank's manual, a first DUI requires an ignition interlock device (IID) for 6 months to 1 year after driving privileges are restored, so the minimum is "Six months from the restoration of driving privileges." Note that C leaves out "from the restoration of driving privileges."

q.en: NJ drivers who accumulate between twelve and fourteen points within a ____ period will receive a Notice of Scheduled Suspension by mail.
q.zh: 在 ____ 期间内累积 12-14 分的新泽西司机将通过邮件收到计划暂时吊销驾照的通知。
q.why: 题库手册：2 年内累计 12–14 分会收到计划暂停驾照通知 (Notice of Scheduled Suspension)；累计 12 分以上即可能被暂停。
q.why_en: Per the bank's manual: accumulating 12–14 points within 2 years gets you a Notice of Scheduled Suspension by mail; 12 or more points can lead to suspension.

q.en: Upon a NJ driver’s conviction of refusing to submit to chemical testing, he or she will be ordered to pay an insurance surcharge of     for three consecutive years.
q.zh: 新泽西司机被定罪为拒绝接受化学测试将被勒令连续三年支付 的保险附加费。
q.why: 拒绝化学测试定罪后，须连续 3 年每年缴 $1,000 保险附加费 (insurance surcharge)。
q.why_en: A conviction for refusing chemical testing carries a $1,000 insurance surcharge each year for 3 consecutive years.

q.en: A conviction of driving the wrong way on a one way street will result in the addition of ____ points on a NJ driving record.
q.zh: 在单行道上错误驾驶将导致新泽西驾驶记录上增加 分。
q.why: 在单行道逆向行驶 (wrong way on one-way street) 记 2 分。
q.why_en: Driving the wrong way on a one-way street adds 2 points.

q.en: If you find yourself driving the wrong way on an interstate ramp, you should:
q.zh: 如果你在洲际公路匝道上发现自己开错路，你应该
oe: Continue until the end of the ramp
Pull onto the shoulder and turn around when it’s safe
Reverse on the ramp to back to the road you came from
oz: 开到路肩并在安全时调头
在匝道上倒车回到你来的路上
q.why: 在匝道上发现逆行，应开到路肩，确认安全后再掉头；在匝道上直接调头或倒车都极危险。
q.why_en: If you find yourself going the wrong way on a ramp, pull onto the shoulder and turn around only when it's safe; making a U-turn or backing up on the ramp is extremely dangerous.

q.en: Which of the following could result in a traffic conviction for driving under the influence in the state of New Jersey?
q.zh: 下列哪项在新泽西州可能导致酒后驾车定罪？
oe: All of these answers are correct
q.why: 酒精、非法毒品以及会影响驾驶能力的处方药都可能导致 DUI 定罪。
q.why_en: Alcohol, illegal drugs, and prescription medications that impair your driving can all lead to a DUI conviction.

q.en: The penalties for a first offence of refusing to submit to chemical testing in the state of New Jersey are equivalent to those for driving with a BAC of    .
q.zh: 在新泽西州对第一次拒绝接受化学测试的处罚等同于那些血液酒精含量为   的司机。
q.why: 首次拒绝化学测试的处罚等同于 BAC 0.10% 以上的初次酒驾（7 个月至 1 年驾照吊销，罚款 $300–$500）。
q.why_en: Penalties for a first refusal to submit to chemical testing equal those for a first DUI with a BAC of 0.10% or higher (7 months to 1 year license loss, $300–$500 fine).

q.en: The insurance surcharge for a NJ driver who has been convicted of three DUI charges within a ten year period will be increased to.
q.zh: 十年内被三次定罪酒驾的新泽西司机的保险附加费将增至 。
q.why: 10 年内第三次酒驾，保险附加费增至每年 $1,500，连续 3 年（初犯/二犯为每年 $1,000）。
q.why_en: For a third DUI within 10 years, the insurance surcharge rises to $1,500 a year for 3 years (vs. $1,000 a year for a first or second offense).

q.en: If a New Jersey driver is convicted of driving with a license suspended for a DUI conviction, his or her license will be suspended for at least an additional ____.
q.zh: 如果新泽西司机被定罪用因酒驾被暂停的驾照驾驶，其驾照将被至少额外暂停 ____。
q.why: 在因酒驾被暂停驾照期间驾驶，会被额外暂停 1–2 年，即至少再加 1 年，另可拘役。
q.why_en: Driving while your license is suspended for DUI brings an additional 1–2 year suspension — at least 1 more year — and possible jail time.

q.en: If a NJ driver is convicted of DUI, s/he will lose his/her license for a maximum of ____ for his/her first offense.
q.zh: 如果新泽西司机第一次被定罪酒驾，他/她将被吊销驾照最长 ____。
q.why: 按题库手册，首次酒驾吊销驾照：BAC 0.08–0.10% 为 3 个月；0.10% 以上为 7 个月至 1 年，所以最长 1 年。
q.why_en: Per the bank's manual, first-DUI license loss is 3 months for a BAC of 0.08–0.10%, and 7 months to 1 year for 0.10% or higher, so the maximum is 1 year.

q.en: If a NJ driver is convicted of a DUI charge, his or her license may be lost for up to:
q.zh: 如果新泽西司机被定罪酒驾，他/她将被吊销驾照长达
q.why: 本题指首次酒驾：最长丧失驾照 1 年（第二次为 1–2 年，第三次更长）。
q.why_en: This refers to a first DUI: license loss of up to 1 year (1–2 years for a second, longer for a third).

q.en: If a New Jersey driver is convicted of driving at a slow speed that impedes traffic,   points will be added to his or her driving record.
q.zh: 如果新泽西司机被定罪因低速驾驶阻碍交通 将增加分到其驾驶记录。
q.why: 低速驾驶阻碍交通 (impeding traffic) 记 2 分。
q.why_en: Driving so slowly that you impede traffic adds 2 points.

q.en: An improper passing conviction will result in the addition of ____ points to a NJ driving record.
q.zh: 不正确超车将导致增加   分到新泽西驾驶记录。
q.why: 不正确超车 (improper passing) 记 4 分。
q.why_en: Improper passing adds 4 points.

q.en: What should you do when you leave your vehicle parked on a uphill slope parallel to the curb?
q.zh: 当你把车停在上坡且与路沿平行的时候，你应该怎么做？
oe: The hand brake should be set and the wheels should be turned toward the curb
The hand brake should be set and the wheels should be kept parallel to the curb
The hand brake should be set and the wheels should be turned away from the curb
Should not set the hand brake, but change the transmission to low
oz: 使用手刹并将车轮转向路沿
使用手刹并将车轮平行于路沿
使用手刹并将车轮远离路沿
不使用手刹但换至低挡
q.why: 有路沿的上坡停车：拉手刹，前轮转离路沿 (away from the curb)，这样车若后溜，前轮后侧会抵住路沿而停住。
q.why_en: Parking uphill next to a curb: set the hand brake and turn the front wheels away from the curb, so if the car rolls back, the rear of the front wheel catches the curb.

q.en: Operating a vehicle on New Jersey’s roadways demonstrates drivers’ implied consent to:
q.zh: 在新泽西道路上驾驶车辆表示司机默认同意
oe: The release of their medical records
None of these answers are correct
q.why: 在 NJ 道路上驾驶即视为默示同意 (implied consent) 接受呼气等化学测试，拒绝会被处罚。
q.why_en: Driving on NJ roads means you've given implied consent to chemical (breath) testing; refusing is penalized.

q.en: Other than alcohol, which of the following is the most common controlled substance that contributes to auto accidents in the state of New Jersey, according to the Driver Manual:
q.zh: 根据驾驶员手册，在新泽西除酒精以外，下列哪项是最常见的造成汽车事故的受管控物质
q.why: NJ 手册指出：除酒精外，大麻 (marijuana) 是导致车祸最常见的受管控物质。
q.why_en: The NJ Driver Manual says that, other than alcohol, marijuana is the controlled substance most often involved in crashes.

q.en: NJ residents between the ages of 13 and 18 may have their license suspended or delayed for ____.
q.zh: 13 岁以上 18 岁以下的新泽西居民，可能因为 ____ 导致其驾照吊销或延迟发放。
oe: None of these answers are correct
q.why: NJ 规定 13–18 岁居民若因涂鸦 (graffiti) 定罪，驾照可被暂停或推迟发放（约 6 个月）。
q.why_en: In NJ, residents aged 13–18 convicted of graffiti can have their license suspended or its issuance delayed (about 6 months).

q.en: In New Jersey, it is illegal for an individual who is 21 years of age or older to drive with a Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of :
q.zh: 在新泽西州，21 岁及以上的司机血液酒精含量不合法的是
q.why: 21 岁及以上司机 BAC 达到 0.08% 或以上即违法。
q.why_en: For drivers 21 and older, a BAC of .08% or more is illegal.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志什么意思？
oe: The maximum speed limit is 50 mph
The minimum speed limit is 50 mph
The speed limit during the day is 50 mph
The recommended speed limit is 50 mph
oz: 最高限速是 50 英里/小时
最低限速是 50 英里/小时
白天限速是 50 英里/小时
建议的限速是 50 英里/小时
q.why: 白底黑字的 SPEED LIMIT 50 是管制标志，表示最高限速 50 mph；最低限速标志会写 MINIMUM。
q.why_en: A black-on-white SPEED LIMIT 50 sign is a regulatory sign showing the maximum speed limit of 50 mph; a minimum speed sign says MINIMUM.

q.en: You are travelling at the speed limit along a 50 mph stretch of road. It starts to rain quite heavily. Which of the following should you do?
q.zh: 当您沿着限速 50 英里/小时的公路前进时开始下大雨，您应该怎么做？
q.why: 大雨时应减速；NJ 法律要求使用雨刷时必须开大灯；湿滑路面不宜使用定速巡航 (cruise control)。所以三项都对。
q.why_en: Slow down in heavy rain; NJ law requires headlights whenever your wipers are on; and don't use cruise control on wet roads. All three apply.

q.en: What must you do at a flashing red traffic signal?
q.zh: 在闪烁的红色信号灯您必须 。
oe: Drive with caution as the traffic light is broken
Stop, you cannot proceed until the light stops flashing
Come to a complete stop, yield and then proceed
Proceed, you do not need to stop or yield at a red flashing signal
oz: 停车，你信号灯停止闪烁前不能前进
完全停住，让行后再前进
继续前进，你不需要在闪烁的红灯前停车或让行
q.why: 闪烁红灯等同停车标志 (STOP sign)：完全停车，让行后再走。
q.tip: 闪红 = 停车牌，闪黄 = 减速注意
q.why_en: A flashing red signal is treated like a STOP sign: come to a complete stop, yield, then proceed.
q.tip_en: Flashing red = STOP sign; flashing yellow = slow down with caution

q.en: A driver approaching a flashing red traffic signal must:
q.zh: 接近闪烁红色信号灯的司机必须 。
q.why: 闪烁红灯处必须在进入路口前完全停车，再在安全时通过。
q.why_en: At a flashing red signal you must come to a complete stop before entering the intersection, then go when it's safe.

q.en: This car’s turn and brake signals have failed, so the driver is using hand gestures to signal instead. What is the driver’s intention?
q.zh: 这辆车的转向制动信号都失效了，所以司机用手势信号来代替。驾驶员的意图是什么？
q.why: 左臂伸出窗外、小臂向上弯曲表示右转；向下弯为减速/停车，平伸为左转。
q.why_en: Left arm out the window with the forearm bent up means a right turn; bent down means slow down/stop; straight out means a left turn.
q.tip_en: Up = right, down = stop, straight = left

q.en: You are following a school bus and its yellow lights start flashing. What should you do?
q.zh: 你正跟在一辆开始闪烁黄灯的公交车后面。你应该怎么做？
oe: You should follow the bus closely so you can pass quickly when it stops
You should maintain your distance and prepare to stop
You should prepare to stop directly behind the bus
oz: 您应该紧跟公交车以便当其停车时可以尽快超过
你应该保持距离并准备停车
你应该准备直接停在公交车后面
q.why: 校车 (school bus) 闪黄灯表示即将停车上下学生，应保持距离并准备停车；闪红灯时才必须停车。（中文"公交车"应为"校车"。）
q.why_en: Flashing yellow lights on a school bus mean it's about to stop to load or unload children: keep your distance and prepare to stop. You must stop once the red lights flash.

q.en: You have parked next to the curb facing up hill. Which way should you point your front wheels to stop your car from rolling if your brakes should fail?
q.zh: 您已经停在上坡的山路边。如果你的刹车出现故障，你应该将你的前轮指向何种方向以免溜车？
q.why: 上坡、有路沿停车时前轮转离路沿，若刹车失灵车会后溜并被路沿挡住。
q.why_en: Parked uphill next to a curb, turn the front wheels away from the curb; if the brakes fail, the car rolls back and the curb stops it.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志什么意思？
oe: Wrong way, turn around and go back
oz: 前方有陡峭的波峰或隆起
q.why: 黄色菱形警告标志中的 U 形箭头表示前方有发夹弯 (hairpin curve)，需大幅减速。
q.why_en: A yellow diamond warning sign with a U-shaped arrow means a hairpin curve ahead; slow down considerably.

q.en: You drive up to an intersection and you see this sign. What should you do?
q.zh: 你开到一个路口看见这个标志。你应该怎么做？
oe: Come to a complete stop and proceed after yielding to any pedestrians and traffic
Slow down and prepare to yield to pedestrians and traffic ahead
Maintain speed as all traffic ahead must yield to you
Slow down and prepare to yield to traffic already on the road ahead; you will definitely not need to stop
oz: 完全停住，礼让行人和车辆后继续前进
减速并准备礼让前方行人和车辆
保持车速，因为所有车辆必须让你
减速并准备礼让前方已在路上的车辆；你肯定不用停车。
q.why: 这是让行标志 (YIELD) 情形：减速并准备让行人和车辆，必要时停车。D 说"肯定不用停车"是错的，A 是停车标志的做法。
q.tip: 让行 = 减速、必要时停
q.flag: 题目缺图，按让行标志 (YIELD) 理解，答案 B 正确。
q.why_en: This is a YIELD sign situation: slow down and be ready to yield to pedestrians and traffic, stopping if necessary. D ("you will definitely not need to stop") is wrong, and A is what you do at a STOP sign.
q.tip_en: Yield = slow down, stop if needed
q.flag_en: The image is missing; read as a YIELD sign, answer B is correct.

q.en: You are turning a corner. No other cars are around. Do you still need to indicate?
q.zh: 你要转弯，附近没有其他车辆。你是否仍需示意？
oe: Yes, for a minimum of 100ft if you are driving below 35 mph and 300ft if you are driving faster
Yes, for at least 300ft if you are travelling over 35 mph
oz: 需要，如果你的车速低于 35英里/小时最少100 英尺；如果你的车速高于35英里/小时最少 300 英尺
需要，最少300 英尺，如果你的车速高于35英里/小时
q.why: NJ 要求转弯前至少 100 英尺打转向灯，即使周围没车也要打。B、D 是其他州的规则。
q.why_en: NJ requires signaling at least 100 feet before a turn, even with no other cars around. B and D are other states' rules.

q.en: Which of the following is most true about parking at an intersection?
q.zh: 关于在路口停车以下哪项最正确？
oe: You must not park within 50ft of a STOP sign and within 25ft of a crosswalk at an intersection
You must not park within 10ft of any STOP sign or crosswalk
You must not park within 5ft of a STOP sign or 50ft of a crosswalk
STOP line or enter the crossing
oz: 你不能在路口停车标志 50 英尺内及人行横道 25 英尺内停车
你不能在路口停车标志或人行横道10 英尺内停车
你不能在路口停车标志 5 英尺内或人行横道 50 英尺内停车 You can park as close to any STOP sign or crosswalk as you want, so long as you don’t pass the
你可以在任何临近路口停车标志或人行横道的地方停车，只要你不停在停车线上或进入路口即可。
q.why: NJ 规定：路口人行横道 25 英尺内、停车标志 50 英尺内不得停车。
q.flag: 选项 C/D 文本有串行（C 末尾混入了 D 的前半句），不影响答案 A。
q.why_en: NJ rule: no parking within 25 feet of a crosswalk at an intersection or within 50 feet of a STOP sign.
q.flag_en: The C/D option text is run together (the end of C contains the start of D); this doesn't affect answer A.

q.en: Two cars arrive at a crossroads at the same time. Which of the following is true?
q.zh: 两辆车同时到达十字路口。以下哪项正确？
oe: Car A can go first because it is turning A
Car B must yield because it is travelling straight through the intersection B
Car A must yield because it is turning left  A
Whoever yields should be decided by the drivers at the intersection
oz: 车先行应为A 车转弯。
车让行因其直行通过路口
车让行 因为A车左转
谁让行应在路口的司机决定
q.why: 图中 A 车左转，B 车对向直行；左转车必须让对向直行车辆 (yield to oncoming traffic)。
q.why_en: In the image, Car A is turning left and Car B is going straight from the opposite direction; a left-turning vehicle must yield to oncoming traffic.

q.en: You have parked facing down a steep hill. If you drive an automatic you should leave your car in ‘park’. What gear should you use with a manual?
q.zh: 你已将车朝下停在一个陡坡上。如果你是自动挡，你应该将车停在 P 档上。如果你是手动挡你应该用什么档位？
oe: Leave your car in first gear
Leave your car in top gear
q.why: 手动挡车车头朝下停在坡上应挂倒挡 (reverse)；车头朝上则挂一挡。
q.tip: 朝下挂倒挡，朝上挂一挡
q.why_en: With a manual transmission, parked facing downhill, leave it in reverse; facing uphill, leave it in first gear.

q.en: You have reached an intersection controlled by a STOP sign. Where must you stop?
q.zh: 你到了一个由停车标志控制的交叉路口。你必须停在那里？
q.why: 在停车标志处：有停止线停在线前；没有则停在人行横道前；都没有则停在进入路口前。题库答案为"以上皆是"。
q.why_en: At a STOP sign: stop before the stop line if there is one; if not, before the crosswalk; if neither, before entering the intersection. The bank's answer is "Before all of the above."

q.en: Car B has entered an intersection to turn right on a red signal. Car A then arrives with a green signal. Which of the following is true?
q.zh: B 车已经在红灯时进入路口右转。A 车到达时是绿灯。以下哪项最正确？
oe: Car A must yield to Car B, as Car B is already in the intersection
Car B should stop and let Car A through    B
Car A should speed up to pass Car B    A
oz: 车必须让 B 车，因为 B 车已经进入路口
车应该停车让A 车通过
车应该加速超过 B 车 None of the above 以上都不对 Two cars arrive at a intersection at the same time. Which of the following is true?
q.why: 已进入路口的车辆有优先权：B 车已在红灯合法右转进入路口，绿灯到达的 A 车仍须让行。
q.flag: 英文/中文选项文本错位（中文被拆到下一个选项，D "None of the above" 混入），正确理解为 A：A 车必须让 B 车。
q.why_en: A vehicle already in the intersection has the right of way: Car B entered legally to turn right on red, so Car A must yield even with a green signal.
q.tip_en: First into the intersection goes first
q.flag_en: The option text is misaligned (the Chinese is split into the next option, and D "None of the above" got mixed in). The intended answer is A: "Car A must yield to Car B, as Car B is already in the intersection."

q.en: Two cars arrive at a intersection at the same time. Which of the following is true?
q.zh: 两辆车同时到达十字路口。以下哪项正确？
oe: Car A is to the left of Car B and therefore must yield    A
Car B must yield because it is on Car A’s right    B
Car B must yield because it is travelling straight through the intersection
oz: 车在 B 车的左侧所以必须让行
车在 A 车右侧所以必须让行
车必须让行  因其直行通过路口 None of the above 以上都不对 New Jersey law requires of passenger vehicles operated in the state to wear seat belts.
q.why: 无信号灯路口两车同时到达时，左侧车辆让右侧车辆 (yield to the vehicle on the right)。A 车在 B 车左侧，所以 A 让行。
q.flag: 选项文本错位（C/D 中文被拆开，混入下一题题干），正确答案仍为 A。
q.why_en: When two cars reach an uncontrolled intersection at the same time, the car on the left yields to the vehicle on the right. Car A is to the left of Car B, so Car A yields.
q.tip_en: Arrive together: yield to the car on the right
q.flag_en: The option text is misaligned (the Chinese for C/D is split, and the next question's stem is mixed in); the correct answer is still A.

q.en: New Jersey law requires of passenger vehicles operated in the state to wear seat belts.
q.zh: 新泽西法律规定行驶的车上 需要系安全带。
oe: The front-seat occupants including the driver
q.why: NJ 法律要求司机和所有乘客（前排和后排）都系安全带。
q.why_en: NJ law requires the driver and all passengers (front and rear) to wear seat belts.

q.en: Which of the following is true about road work zones?
q.zh: 关于道路施工区，下列正确的是？
oe: You must observe work zone speed limits; speeding fines you receive here may be doubled
Road work zone speed limits are not enforced
After being waved through a work zone, you should drive quickly to avoid holding up traffic
oz: 你必须遵守作业区的限速；你收到的超速罚单可能会加倍
道路施工区的限速不是强制的
通过道路施工区后，你应该开快车以免阻碍交通
q.why: 必须遵守施工区 (work zone) 限速；施工区内超速等违章罚款加倍。
q.why_en: You must obey work zone speed limits; fines for speeding and other violations in a work zone are doubled.

q.en: What does this sign mean?
q.zh: 这个标志什么意思？
oe: Wrong way; turn around and go back
q.why: 该警告标志表示前方有 270 度大回环弯道（常见于匝道），需减速。
q.why_en: This warning sign means a 270-degree loop curve ahead (common on ramps); slow down.

q.en: What should you do if fog closes in completely while driving, and visibility is reduced to near zero ____.
q.zh: 如果在行驶中大雾导致能见度降为零，你应该怎么做?
oe: Carefully pull as far off the road as possible, and stop
Increase the speed and take a detour
oz: 小心把车驶离公路，尽可能远离路边停车
q.why: 大雾导致能见度几乎为零时，应小心驶离道路尽量远离车道并停车。大雾中用近光灯，不用远光灯。
q.why_en: If fog cuts visibility to near zero, carefully pull as far off the road as possible and stop. In fog, use low beams, not high beams.

q.en: On some roadways, some lanes reserved as ‘Transit’ are used for:
q.zh: 在一些道路上，有些标记为“公交”的车道是 保留。
q.why: 标有 Transit 的车道只供公交车 (buses) 使用。HOV 车道会标 HOV 或菱形符号。
